title: Dashmoto® Dash 3 Electric Mobility Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Dashmoto Dash 3: Mobility Made Better

We're excited to welcome Dashmoto to Australia and bring its innovative approach to lightweight mobility to local riders for the first time. 

 

The Dashmoto Dash 3 combines a lightweight carbon fibre frame with practical features designed to make everyday mobility easier. Its 500W motor, three-wheel design and four ride modes provide a stable and responsive way to get around, while the folding design makes storage and transport simple.

Lightweight Carbon Fibre Construction

The Dash 3 uses a full T700 carbon fibre frame that offers strength and durability without adding unnecessary weight. At 19.1 kg with the seat fitted, it's designed to be easier to move, store and transport.

500W Power for Everyday Travel

A 500W hub motor delivers reliable power with a top speed of up to 29 km/h. Four ride modes, including Walk, Cruise, Sport and Reverse, let you adjust the ride to suit different situations.

Stable Three-Wheel Design

The three-wheel configuration and low centre of gravity provide balanced handling when navigating corners, tight spaces and uneven paths. Hill-hold control also helps keep the Dash 3 steady on inclines.

Comfortable Everyday Riding

An ergonomic removable seat uses high-density polyurethane with memory foam to provide supportive cushioning for longer journeys. The Dash 3 accommodates riders from approximately 150 cm to 198 cm tall and supports up to 170 kg.

Responsive Braking

Dual hydraulic disc brakes provide reliable stopping power, while electronic active hold adds extra control when coming to a stop.

Folds for Easy Transport

One-click folding allows the Dash 3 to be quickly prepared for storage or transport. The front bar also folds inward, making it easier to position the scooter at tables and café seating.

Ready for Everyday Mobility

The UL2271-certified 48V lithium-ion battery provides up to 24 km of range and takes approximately 2.5 hours to charge. The Dash 3 comes with a standard battery, charger, Velcro strap and user manual.

Turn away from convention.

Re-designed from the ground up, this fundamentally different riding position spreads your weight evenly on either side of the chassis – for unrivalled stability, greater control and advanced safety.

title: Dualtron Sonic Nano Electric Scooter (36V 10.2Ah + 36V 4Ah)
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Dualtron Sonic Nano is made for riders who want a simple, no-fuss way to get around the city. It keeps things light, efficient, and easy to handle, without giving up the solid build quality Dualtron is known for. Whether it’s a quick commute or a short trip across town, it’s designed to fit seamlessly into your daily routine.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 350W motors (2 x 500W peak)
  • 36V 10.2Ah removable battery
  • Mechanical double-sided disc brake with EBS
  • Extra 36V 4Ah battery included

Designed For Practicality

Small in size but capable where it counts, the Sonic Nano delivers smooth acceleration and steady performance for daily commutes and quick errands. Its dual motor setup provides balanced torque without feeling aggressive, making it easy to ride in busy areas.

 

Powered by dual 350W motors, it delivers:

 

  • Up to 1,000W peak output
  • Up to 25 KPH top speed
  • Up to 30 KM range

Paired with a 36V battery system, it’s highly efficient and ideal for short-distance travel without the bulk of larger scooters.

Made for Quick, Everyday Trips

The Sonic Nano makes daily travel easier with its dual motor setup that gives you a steady, predictable push off the line, which is especially useful in crowded streets or shared paths.

 

If you’re after controlled performance that stays within legal limits, this electric scooter is perfect for you.

Easy to Carry, Easy to Live With

At only 20 kg, you won’t think twice about lifting this e-scooter into a car boot or carrying it up a short flight of stairs. When it comes to stability, the folding mechanism locks in firmly when riding, then packs down quickly when you need it out of the way.

Comfortable City Rides

The Sonic Nano’s 8-inch self-sealing tyres help absorb bumps and vibrations from rough roads. They are also self-sealing, which means no punctures and less upkeep, which makes it more practical for everyday use.

Reliable Braking

Disc brakes provide steady, predictable stopping power, while the electronic braking system adds extra control and helps smooth out deceleration.

Simple, Useful Features

The EY2 display shows speed, battery level, and ride mode clearly. Built-in lights improve visibility, and the IPX5 rating of the lighting components means they can handle light rain.

title: Segway Ninebot C2 Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
The new Segway-Ninebot C2 Pro makes scootering a family affair for all ages. Designed for children and teenagers, this reliable and stylish e-kick scooter delivers hours of fun, turning rides into memorable adventures for everyone.

Key Features

  • Adjustable stem
  • Parental control
  • Bluetooth speaker and ambient lights
DESCRIPTION

Kickstart your kids' love of e-scootering

The Segway-Ninebot C2 Pro gives children and young teens the freedom to explore their surroundings confidently and independently. Coming from a brand you can trust, the C2 Pro stands as the best, most reliable choice for your kids.

 

With its 150W brushless motor, the C2 Pro does not overwhelm. Instead, it appropriately offers:

 

  • 16 kph top speed
  • 15 kilometres on a single charge

The new C2 Pro is ideal for kids aged 6 to 14 years old with heights between 115 to 170cm.

 

An electric scooter that grows with your kids

 

Kids grow up fast, and thanks to its adjustable stem, the new C2 Pro grows along with them. This feature also allows the kick scooter to be shared among siblings.

 

The C2 Pro’s stem has three heights:

 

  • 34.8 inches (for little kids)
  • 37.8 inches
  • 40.7 inches (for taller kids)

Whether your kids are 3’8” or 5’6”, they can use the Segway-Ninebot C2 Pro with no difficulty.

 

Plus, thanks to its easy-fold mechanism, the C2 Pro is convenient to store at home or take with you on a family outing.

 

Turn heads with the coolest scooter in the neighbourhood

 

Your kids will amaze everyone with the stylish C2 Pro’s surfing-inspired design and 256-colour RGB ambient light. Not only that, the scooter’s lighting rhythm syncs with the riding speed, making it look even cooler.

 

The C2 Pro also features a Bluetooth speaker for music and intelligent voice assistance. Once the speaker is on, the scooter’s ambient lights sync with the music!

 

Let your kids ride with confidence

 

Beyond its appearance, the Ninebot-Segway C2 Pro is tested for utmost safety and quality. It has undergone:

 

  • 3000 km real scene road test
  • 100 times drop test

It is also rated to have an IPX4 water-resistance rating for the scooter body and an IPX6 rating for the battery pack.

 

The new C2 Pro is a low-maintenance device. Equipped with 7-inch inner hollow tyres, you don’t have to worry about punctures from the road.

 

Furthermore, the C2 Pro features a high-performance mechanical drum brake for efficient stopping and anti-clamp intervals that prevent sudden acceleration.

 

Plus, it has thermo-plastic rubber (TPR) handlebar grips and no sharp edges throughout.

 

Three riding modes for different levels of excitement

 

The C2 Pro is a versatile e-scooter that adjusts to fit the needs of different riders, making it ideal for families with multiple children.

 

Aside from its adjustable stem and handlebars, the C2 Pro features three riding modes with various throttle responsiveness to suit different skill levels:

 

  • Standard Mode for beginners
  • Sport Mode for speedy rides
  • Power-Assisting Mode for cruising

Another layer of safety with parental control

 

Finally, the C2 Pro comes with the official Segway-Ninebot app, where you (the parent or guardian) can control the speed of the device.

 

A steady ride for every child

 

Segway-Ninebot has considered every detail, as evidenced by the new C2 Pro’s features and thoughtful design. By allowing kids to explore freely but safely, the C2 Pro is the perfect first electric scooter to nurture a love for exciting rides.

title: Segway Ninebot MAX G3 Electric Scooter
body_html:
Say hello to the Segway MAX G3: the ultimate upgrade to your ride. A more powerful motor, longer range, and full hydraulic suspension make for a smoother, more efficient commute. Plus, with faster charging and refined features, you’ll spend less time waiting and more time exploring. 

Smoother, faster, and more efficient, it’s built to handle daily commutes and weekend rides.

Key Features:

  • Dual front and dual rear adjustable hydraulic suspensions
  • Segway AirLock and autonomous locking
  • SegRide™ Stability Enhancement System
DESCRIPTION

Next-Level Performance in Every Ride

Introducing the Segway MAX G3: a smarter, smoother way to move. Upgraded in all the right ways, the MAX G3 delivers more power, efficiency, and control.

 

A stronger motor, faster speeds, rapid charging, and an enhanced suspension system make for a smoother, more dynamic ride, while improved ergonomics, longer range, and smarter features make it a top-tier choice for riders who want more out of every trip.

 

Equipped with a 700W motor that produces 2000W of peak power, the Segway MAX G3 can achieve:

 

  • A 30% maximum climbing angle
  • An acceleration rate of only 2.4 seconds (0-25 KPH)
  • Up to 80 KMS of range

Be among the first to own the Segway MAX G3 in Australia and experience a commute like no other.

 

Pre-order now and enjoy a special pre-sale price! 

 

Power that moves your commutes

 

The Segway MAX G3 is not your ordinary commuter e-scooter. With a robust 2000W motor, you can experience exceptional power and acceleration wherever you ride – whether you're navigating city streets or tackling steep inclines up to 30%. 

 

Designed for both urban commutes and outdoor adventures, the MAX G3 provides the strength and reliability you need to go further.

 

Go further, charge faster

 

With Segway’s advanced SegRange™ technology, the MAX G3 takes you on longer rides, as its 597Wh battery delivers an impressive range of up to 80 KMS (or 65 KMS in sport mode). Need even more range? The optional 460Wh battery* extends your journey up to a whopping 135 KMS.

 

When it’s time to recharge, the built-in fast charger makes it quick and easy – just 3.5 hours for a full charge. Want even faster charging? Add an optional DC charger* and power up in as little as 2.5 hours with dual input charging. 

 

*Optional battery and DC charger sold separately. The additional battery will be available in Q3 2025.

 

Upgraded suspension, bigger tyres, smoother rides

 

The MAX G2 set the standard for suspension, but the MAX G3 takes it even further. Now equipped with front and rear double hydraulic suspension, this scooter absorbs shocks effectively to deliver an ultra-smooth ride on city streets and rough roads.

 

Meanwhile, upgraded 11-inch self-sealing tyres provide superior traction and durability so you can confidently handle diverse terrains. The integrated jelly layer automatically seals punctures up to 4mm, which ensures you can ride worry-free. 

 

Plus, stay in full control of your ride with the MAX G3’s upgraded double-action piston disc brakes. Featuring four brake pads – two per caliper – this system improves contact between the pads and rotor for increased braking efficiency and heat dissipation. 

 

Unlock, track, and ride intelligently

 

Take full control of your MAX G3 with intelligent connectivity features. Segway Airlock provides hands-free unlocking, so your scooter is ready to ride the moment you approach. 

 

The Segway Mobility App lets you check battery life, track your ride, update firmware, and easily customise your settings. And for extra security, activate Apple Find My to keep tabs on your scooter’s location anytime. 

 

Safety and stability you can trust

 

Ride confidently knowing the Segway MAX G3 is packed with advanced safety features. The automatic 6W headlight adjusts to your surroundings, while brake lights and front & rear turn indicators keep you seen.

 

Its water-resistance rating has been upgraded to IPX6 (from the MAX G2's IPX5) with an IPX7-rated battery pack, so you can expect it to deliver reliable performance even in wet conditions.

 

For superior control, the SegRide™ Stability Enhancement System ensures a smooth ride at high speeds, sharp turns, and slippery roads. The TCS Traction Control System prevents slipping, while a curved handlebar, steering damping, and optimised trailing distance enhance balance and maneuverability, keeping every ride stable and secure.

 

A smarter way to navigate

 

The 2.4-inch Smart TFT Display keeps you connected and informed at a glance. Get real-time riding stats like speed, battery life, and trip distance while staying focused on the road. Incoming call notifications ensure you never miss an important call, while a future navigation update will make route planning effortless.

 

Elevate your ride with MAX

 

The Segway MAX G3 takes everything great about the already excellent MAX G2 and makes it even better: more power, longer range, smoother suspension, smarter connectivity, and enhanced safety.

 

Whether you're commuting or exploring, this e-scooter is built to perform comfortably and reliably in any condition. 

 

Ride smarter, go further, and experience the best of electric mobility with the MAX G3.

title: Segway Ninebot E3 PRO Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Segway E3 Pro takes everything great about the E2 Pro and adds more power, better range, and improved suspension for a noticeably smoother ride. Whether you’re commuting or cruising around town, the E3 Pro handles it all easily and comfortably.

 

Key Features:

  • Front and Rear Suspension
  • Segride™ Stability Enhancement System
  • Segway Traction Control System

Comfort and confidence for the city

The Segway E3 Pro is a feature-packed city scooter that’s designed to make everyday riding smoother, safer, and more enjoyable. With a stronger motor, extended range, and dual suspension, it’s perfect for those who want more out of their daily commute without paying a premium price.

 

Powered by a 400W motor, the E3 Pro delivers:

 

  • 800W of peak power
  • A top speed of 25 kph
  • Up to 55 km of range
  • A hill grade of up to 18%

Backed by one of the most trusted names in electric mobility, the E3 Pro is a well-rounded choice that brings together performance, safety, and value.

More range, more freedom

Thanks to SegRange™ technology and a 368 Wh battery, the E3 Pro stretches your riding range up to 55 km – 15 km more than the E2 Pro. Perfect for longer commutes, weekend errands, or spontaneous detours!

 

On the other hand, the 800W peak motor provides smooth acceleration with enough torque to handle hills and city slopes alike.

Real-world city riding

Unlike the E2 Pro, the E3 Pro includes front and rear elastomer suspension, more effective in absorbing bumps and vibrations from rougher paths. The 10-inch tubeless tyres also improve grip and shock absorption, giving you a smoother, quieter ride.

 

To make your ride even more secure, Segway’s Traction Control System and SegRide™ Stability Enhancement System work together to minimise skidding, especially in slippery conditions or sharp turns. It’s a level of control you’ll notice, especially if you're upgrading from a more basic scooter.

Stay visible, stay safe

The lighting setup is just as comprehensive as the specs. You get a powerful 4W headlight, bright turn signals, a rear brake light, and even customisable RGB ambient lights under the footboard. 

 

When it comes to water resistance, the E3 Pro is rated higher than the E2 Pro (IPX5 vs. IPX4). Plus, the Segway E3 Pro is compatible with Apple Find My, so you can track and locate it in seconds.

Lightweight but heavy-duty

Lightweight at only 17.9 kg and portable (folding down in two quick steps), the E3 Pro is easy to bring along onto trains, into lifts, or even beside your desk. 

 

Meanwhile, its magnesium-aluminium frame has been stress-tested over thousands of simulated kilometres, so it’s not just compact – it’s built to last.

Smart control at your fingertips

The Segway Mobility App gives you full command over your ride. Check your speed and battery, toggle riding modes, enable the TCS, or lock your scooter remotely. 

The next level of everyday riding

With smooth handling, smart features, and real-world durability, the Segway E3 Pro redefines what a compact city scooter can do. Whether you’re a seasoned commuter or new to scootering, this is the upgrade your routine’s been waiting for.

DESCRIPTION

The latest in the iconic Pure Air series, this next-generation electric scooter brings together tradition, performance, and comfort. An excellent choice for riders who value a dependable, smooth ride, the Pure Air⁵ offers an intuitive experience for everyday journeys and beyond.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Upgraded 840W motor
  • 10" tubeless, puncture-resistant tyres
  • Dual braking system

Embrace the Ride with the Pure Air⁵

Pure Electric continues to redefine urban travel with the new Pure Air⁵, a scooter built for smooth, efficient rides through the heart of the city. If you want a reliable and comfortable way to get around, the Pure Air⁵ makes every journey feel effortless.

 

With its sleek design and powerful motor, this scooter offers a smooth and enjoyable ride, whether you’re heading to work or meeting friends. It’s built for those who value both convenience and performance in their everyday transport.

 

Equipped with a robust 840W motor, the Pure Air⁵ offers:

 

  • 840W of peak power
  • 14% maximum hill-climbing ability
  • Up to 46.9 KMS of range per charge

City Riding Made Better

The Pure Air⁵ brings easy power to your daily commute. With a 840W peak motor, it offers quick acceleration and smooth performance, so your ride through the city streets feels effortless. 

 

Its 37V, 7.2Ah battery gives you a range of up to 30 kilometres on a single charge – enough to get you across town and back without worrying about recharging.

Smooth, Comfortable Rides

Every detail of the Pure Air⁵ has been added for rider comfort. Featuring 10” tubeless and puncture-resistant tyres, it ensures a smooth ride no matter how often you navigate rougher patches or busy streets. Expect a reliable, carefree experience wherever you go.

Safe and Reliable Stopping Power

The dual braking system on the Pure Air⁵ offers precise control for quick, confident stops. A front drum brake delivers excellent performance with low maintenance, while the rear KERS brake adds the benefit of regenerative braking, which helps you save energy and gain more control.

Built for All Weather Conditions

No need to worry about the weather. With an IP65 water resistance rating, the Pure Air⁵ is equipped to handle light rain and splashes, keeping you on the move despite the forecast.

Compact and Foldable

Designed to fit easily into your life, the Pure Air⁵ folds up with a simple click-lock mechanism, making it easy to store and transport. Weighing just 16.2 kg, it’s light enough to carry when you need to.

Smart, Connected Riding Experience

Stay informed with the LCD screen that provides real-time updates on speed, battery life, and maintenance alerts. Plus, connect your scooter to the official Pure app for even more insight into your ride and optimise your experience on the go.

The Razor Crazy Cart XL takes the original Crazy Cart experience and scales it up for bigger riders. Designed for riders aged 16 years and over and supporting up to 109 kg, it combines a powerful 500W motor with responsive controls and a Drift Bar for controlled slides, spins and tight cornering.

Drift Like a Pro

The Crazy Cart XL gives experienced riders multiple ways to control their driving and drifting. Keep the Drift Bar lowered for regular go-kart driving, then lift it to unlock sideways drifts, spins and tight turns.

Take Full Control

Built for Serious Drifting

A pneumatic 200 mm x 50 mm front tyre provides grip and helps smooth out imperfections in the riding surface, while the robust powder-coated steel frame is built for repeated use on suitable private paved surfaces.

Made for Bigger Riders

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

NOTE: FOR RIDERS 16+

Razor Dirt Rocket MX650: Built for Off-Road Excitement

The Razor Dirt Rocket MX650 brings motocross-inspired performance to an electric ride. Designed for off-road riding and tackling uphill terrain, it combines a 650W high-torque motor, dual suspension and pneumatic tyres with responsive controls for an exciting dirt bike experience.

More Power for Off-Road Riding

The 650W variable-speed motor delivers speeds of up to 25 km/h, giving the MX650 the power needed for off-road adventures and inclines. Its chain-driven motor provides strong, responsive acceleration when you're ready to pick up the pace.

Take Control From the Handlebars

A twist-grip throttle gives riders smooth control over acceleration, while the adjustable riser handlebars allow the riding position to be tailored for a more comfortable fit.

Built to Handle the Rough Stuff

The MX650 is equipped with dual suspension to help absorb bumps and uneven terrain. Its 16-inch front and 14-inch rear pneumatic tyres provide traction and help create a smoother ride across suitable off-road surfaces.

Confident Braking

title: Inokim Light 3 Electric Scooter

A whole lot of fun in a lightweight scooter

The Inokim Light 3 takes the lightweight commuter concept and brings it into a new generation. Weighing just 14 kg, it combines 350W motor power with a 36V 12.8Ah battery, so you can move quickly without lugging around a heavy scooter.

 

But the Light 3 isn't just about portability. Built-in Apple CarPlay, an App Store-ready system, a wide smart display and Ghost Shield security bring a level of connectivity rarely seen in such a lightweight scooter.

 

Key Features:

 

  • 350W power with up to 35 km/h top speed

Light enough to take anywhere

At just 14 kg, the Light 3 is made for riders who regularly need to carry, store or transport their scooter. Its lightweight design makes it easy to take into the office, onto public transport or up a flight of stairs.

Small frame, serious pace

The Light 3 can reach speeds of up to 35 km/h, with 350W of power available for responsive urban riding. It's compact and lightweight, but doesn't feel like a compromise when you're on the road.

Your scooter just got smarter

Built-in Apple CarPlay puts connected features directly into the scooter, while the App Store-ready platform opens up further possibilities for apps and functionality. The wide smart display keeps key information easy to see while riding.

Keep your ride protected

Made for everyday movement

The Light 3's compact proportions and lightweight construction make it particularly suited to urban riders who combine different modes of transport throughout the day.

Inokim Light 3: Less to carry. More to do.

title: NIU KQi100 Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Everyday comfort, upgraded.

The NIU KQi100 Pro is designed to make everyday riding smoother, more comfortable and easier to control. Front suspension, wide 9.5-inch tyres and a longer deck help you handle uneven streets with greater confidence, while the powerful 600W motor provides responsive acceleration and enough torque to tackle gradients of up to 15%.


With smart connectivity, integrated safety features and a redesigned steel frame supporting up to 120 kg, the KQi100 Pro is a capable choice for commuting, errands and everyday city riding.


Key Features:


  • 600W peak motor power
  • Up to 25 km riding range
  • 36 mm front suspension

Comfortable on everyday streets

The KQi100 Pro is designed to make daily rides more comfortable. Its 36 mm dual-stroke front suspension helps absorb bumps and vibrations, while the wider 9.5-inch tyres provide additional cushioning and grip across uneven urban surfaces.

More room to ride

A longer, wider deck gives you more space to find a comfortable standing position, while the 52 cm twist-throttle handlebars provide greater control and easier steering. Together, these ergonomic upgrades make the scooter comfortable and intuitive to ride.

Strong performance for city riding

The 600W max-power motor delivers responsive acceleration and can handle gradients of up to 15%. NIU's FOC sine wave controller provides smooth, efficient power delivery with less motor noise, making it well suited to everyday commuting.

Up to 25 km of range

The 243Wh battery provides up to 25 km of riding range on a single charge, giving you enough range for short commutes and everyday trips. A full charge takes approximately 5–6 hours.

Designed with safety in mind

Integrated front and rear LED lights, along with front and rear reflectors, help keep you visible in low-light conditions. The front drum brake is neatly integrated into the wheel, while internal cable routing keeps the design clean and reduces exposed cables.

Smart features at your fingertips

Connect the KQi100 Pro to the NIU app via Bluetooth to access features including ride mode settings, battery charge limits, electronic unlocking and OTA software updates. NIU's Battery Management System also uses 14 layers of protection to help safeguard battery performance and longevity.

Built for everyday use

The redesigned high-grade steel frame supports riders weighing up to 120 kg, giving the KQi100 Pro a solid foundation for daily riding. Five ride modes, including E-Save, Sport, Dynamic, Pedestrian and Cruise Control, let you adjust the scooter to suit different situations.

title: Inokim OXO Dubai Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Dual-motor performance for riders who want more.

The Inokim OXO Dubai is a serious high-performance electric scooter, combining dual motors with a large-capacity 60V 25.6Ah battery.

 

With up to 2600W of peak power, a top speed of up to 65 km/h and up to 109 km of range, it's built for riders who want powerful acceleration and long-distance capability.


Its front and rear suspension, hydraulic brakes and wide pneumatic tyres add the comfort and control needed to make the most of its performance.


Key Features:


  • Dual motors with up to 2600W peak power
  • 60V 25.6Ah battery with up to 109 km range
  • Front and rear suspension with hydraulic brakes

A smarter way to ride

The OXO Dubai combines serious performance with smart technology, featuring built-in Apple CarPlay and an App Store-ready platform for added functionality. The wide smart display keeps important riding information clear and easy to access on the go.

Two motors, serious output

The OXO Dubai's dual-motor setup delivers strong acceleration and increased traction, with up to 2600W of peak power. Whether you're taking on steep climbs or looking for responsive performance on open stretches, there's plenty of power available.

Built for longer rides

A 60V 25.6Ah battery gives the OXO Dubai a maximum range of up to 109 km under suitable conditions. Its substantial battery capacity makes it a strong choice for longer journeys where stopping to recharge isn't always convenient.

Let the suspension do the work

Front and rear suspension helps absorb bumps, impacts and uneven surfaces, creating a smoother and more composed ride. The system works alongside the scooter's wide pneumatic tyres to improve comfort across changing road conditions.

Wide tyres for a more planted ride

The 10 x 3-inch pneumatic tyres provide a broad contact patch and additional cushioning. Together with the suspension, they help the OXO Dubai maintain a stable and comfortable feel over uneven roads.

Braking to match the performance

Hydraulic brakes provide strong, responsive stopping power to complement the OXO Dubai's dual-motor performance and higher top speed.

Strong where it matters

The reinforced aluminium chassis provides a durable foundation for the scooter's high-performance components. Despite its 33.5 kg weight, the OXO Dubai features a folding mechanism for more convenient storage and transport.

Everything you need at a glance

An advanced digital display provides real-time riding information, while front and rear LED lighting helps improve visibility in lower-light conditions. A Ghost Shield is also included.

Inokim OXO Dubai: Go further. Push harder.

With dual motors, 2600W peak power, a 60V 25.6Ah battery and up to 110 km of range, the OXO Dubai is designed for riders who expect more from their electric scooter. High-performance suspension, hydraulic brakes and wide pneumatic tyres complete the package.

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

From folded to ready, in seconds.

The Inokim Quick 4 Super is a practical, performance-focused commuter designed for riders who need plenty of range without giving up portability.

 

Its 600W motor and 52V 16Ah battery provide the power and endurance for longer daily rides, while the signature foot-activated folding system lets you fold the scooter in around four seconds.

 

With dual suspension, 10-inch pneumatic tyres, drum brakes and a spacious deck, the Quick 4 Super is made to keep everyday riding comfortable from start to finish.

  • 600W motor power
  • Up to 70 km range
  • 4-second foot-activated folding system

800W of responsive power

The Quick 4 Super's motor features a 600W motor, which provides smooth acceleration and responsive performance for urban riding. With a top speed of up to 40 km/h, it has plenty of capability for longer commutes and open stretches.

Keep going for up to 70 km

The 52V 16Ah battery provides up to 70 km of range, giving you plenty of capacity for extended daily rides. Actual range will vary depending on rider weight, speed, terrain and riding conditions.

Fold it in four

The Quick 4 Super's signature foot-activated folding mechanism lets you collapse the scooter in around four seconds. It's a simple solution for commuters moving between the road, public transport, the office and home.

Smoother streets ahead

The rear suspension helps absorb bumps and road vibrations, while the 10-inch pneumatic tyres add another layer of cushioning. Together, they make uneven urban surfaces more comfortable to ride over.

A deck made for longer trips

The extended deck gives you plenty of room to position your feet comfortably, helping create a more stable stance during longer journeys.

Reliable braking, less maintenance

Front and rear drum brakes provide consistent stopping performance in a sealed design that requires less maintenance than many exposed braking systems.

Everything you need, right in front of you

The large central display keeps important riding information visible while you're moving, while integrated LED lighting helps improve visibility in lower-light conditions.

Light enough to take with you

At 21.5 kg, the Quick 4 Super is designed to balance its long-range battery and substantial performance with practical portability. Its aluminium construction provides a strong and durable frame without unnecessary bulk.

Inokim Quick 4 Super: Made to move with you

title: Kaabo Mantis King Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Ultimate performance. Uncompromising control.

The Kaabo Mantis King Pro is built for riders who want serious power, long-range capability and confident control. With dual 1200W motors, a 60V 18Ah battery and a top speed of up to 60 km/h (private property), it delivers the performance to take on demanding city rides and beyond.

 

With adjustable hydraulic suspension, hydraulic brakes, a removable battery and smart app connectivity, the Mantis King Pro combines high-performance riding with practical everyday features.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 1200W motors
  • Up to 60 km/h top speed (private property)
  • Up to 80 km range

Dual-motor power

Two 1200W motors deliver strong acceleration and responsive power, giving the Mantis King Pro the performance to handle steep streets and demanding riding conditions. Dual 60V 25A controllers help deliver smooth, controlled power from both motors.

Go further with up to 80 km of range

The 60V 18Ah battery provides up to 80 km of range under Kaabo's test conditions. The removable battery can also be unlocked and taken out of the scooter for independent charging, making charging more convenient without having to move the entire scooter.

Built for a smoother ride

The Kaabo C-type hydraulic suspension system features 132mm front and rear suspension with adjustable damping. Designed to absorb impacts efficiently, it helps maintain stability and comfort across uneven roads and changing surfaces.

Hydraulic braking confidence

Front and rear hydraulic brakes with 140mm rotors provide strong, controlled stopping power. Combined with EABS, the braking system gives you greater confidence when slowing down from higher speeds or navigating demanding terrain.

Smart control at your fingertips

The 3.5-inch colour smart display keeps key ride information clearly visible, including speed and battery status. Through the Kaabo App, you can also customise speed limits and control selected scooter functions.

Protection for changing conditions

title: Fiido Air Carbon Fiber Bike (Fiido C31)
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Redefining Urban Electric Riding

The Fiido Air Carbon Fibre electric bike sets a new standard in urban mobility. Engineered for daily commuting, it meets the demands of the modern rider through its award-winning lightweight design and cutting-edge technology. 

 

With its 250W motor, the Fiido Air achieves: 

 

  • A 25 KPH top speed
  • An 80-KM max range
  • A 120-KG maximum capacity

At just 13.75 KG, the Fiido Air delivers a perfect balance of form, function, and features.

 

Ultra-Lightweight Form

 

The Fiido Air is one of the lightest electric bikes on the market today and boasts a Red Dot Award-worthy rhomboid design. The sleek carbon frame not only ensures durability but also provides an agile riding experience.

 

To further minimise bulk, the Fiido keeps a clean and streamlined look thanks to hidden wiring integrated into the bike.

 

Engineered for Urban Performance

 

Equipped with an advanced MIVICE torque sensor and a low-resistance motor, the Fiido Air delivers naturally smooth rides. By providing intuitive power delivery and assistance, the sensor allows you to remain in control of your e-bike.

 

Range-wise, the Air’s 208.8Wh battery allows you to cover up to 80 KMS on a single charge. Furthermore, the Fiido Air also features a Gates Carbon Drive CDN belt that does not require frame disassembly, thus removing the hassle of traditional chain maintenance. 

 

Safe and Comfortable Rides

 

The Fiido Air’s award-winning form is only complimented by its overall comfortable design. Specifically, the VELO vacuum full-fit saddle and adjustable seat height allow you to relax on your commute.

 

Meanwhile, hydraulic brakes are added to guarantee safe and secure stopping, even when you're riding at top speed.

 

In addition, you can effortlessly keep track of your riding states with a smart display that clearly shows your speed and battery levels.

 

Finally, bright headlights and taillights keep you visible at nighttime or during low-light weather conditions.


A Refined Riding Experience

 

The Fiido Air prioritises rider experience through thoughtful design choices. From the minimalist aesthetic to the intuitive torque sensor, every ride feels effortless on this electric bike.

title: Fiido M1 Pro Folding Fat-Tyre Electric Bike
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

*For offroad/private property use only*

The new Fiido M1 Pro 2025 is built for riders who refuse to be limited by terrain. Whether it’s sand, gravel, snow or city streets, this folding fat-tyre e-bike is designed to handle it all – now with major upgrades for even better performance and comfort.

 

Key Features for 2025:

 

  • Mivice S200 torque sensor
  • Hydraulic disc brakes
  • 80mm front suspension fork and rear shock absorber
  • 20" x 4.0" puncture-resistant fat tyres

Adventure Anywhere

The Fiido M1 Pro brings together the all-terrain power of a fat-tyre e-bike with the convenience of a folding frame. Built for riders who want real off-road ability without giving up portability, the M1 Pro is ready for city streets, beach tracks, forest trails, and everything else you can imagine. 

 

With a new torque sensor for faster pedal response, upgraded suspension for a smoother ride, and hydraulic disc brakes for better control, the 2025 Fiido M1 Pro takes performance and comfort up a notch.

 

Powered by a 500W motor, the Fiido M1 Pro offers:

 

  • 25 KPH top speed
  • 55 Nm of torque
  • 87 KMS max range

From weekend adventures to weekday commutes, wherever you want to go, the Fiido M1 Pro takes you there.

Adventure-Ready Design

The M1 Pro transforms every ride into an adventure. With wide, puncture-resistant tyres and a strong aluminium frame, it’s built to take on tough conditions while folding easily for storage or transport. 

 

Plus, the 2025 version upgrades the front suspension to 80mm travel for better shock absorption, and introduces dual-piston hydraulic disc brakes for quicker, more controlled stops. 

Power and Precision Combined

The 500W motor delivers 55Nm of torque to ensure smooth acceleration even on loose surfaces and steep climbs. Paired with the new Mivice torque sensor, an upgrade from the last version's cadence sensor, the M1 Pro responds instantly to your pedalling – with support kicking in just 0.01 seconds.

 

Meanwhile, Shimano’s 7-speed gearing ensures you can fine-tune your cadence, whether you’re pushing up a slope or flying along a trail.

Range for Bigger Adventures

Equipped with a removable 556.8Wh battery (2025 version), the M1 Pro offers a maximum range of up to 87 kilometres on a single charge. More than enough for day trips, weekend explorations, or commuting with extra detours.

Superior Comfort, Whatever the Surface

A dual-suspension system – featuring an upgraded 80mm oil-damped front fork and a rear shock absorber – efficiently soaks up bumps and vibrations from rugged terrain. 

 

Fat 4.0” tyres provide greater traction and stability so you can ride comfortably across sand, snow, mud or rocky paths. A full-fit VELO saddle is also added on the adjustable seat for reduced pressure on long rides.

Smart, Tough and Built to Last

The M1 Pro is fitted with a waterproof 2.4-inch colour LCD display, readable in direct sunlight and durable enough to withstand heavy rain. The full-bike IP54 rating, combined with the IP67-rated torque sensor, means the M1 Pro is ready for year-round riding.

Retro-Inspired Style

With its bold colour accents, skin-tone tyre sidewalls, and robust frame, the M1 Pro’s design nods to classic off-road motorbikes from the '60s to '80s. It's a look that stands out, whether you’re in the city or far from it.

title: Fiido C11 Pro Electric Bike
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Fiido C11 Pro is the upgraded version of the Fiido C11 commuter e-bike, a favourite among thousands of riders. With a smoother, more responsive sensor, longer range, and upgraded components, this bike offers an even better riding experience.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Mivice S200 dual-sided torque sensor
  • Hydraulic disc brakes
  • Oil-damped suspension fork

The Ultimate Commuter Experience

The Fiido C11 Pro takes city commuting to the next level. The upgraded version of the Fiido C11, it introduces cutting-edge technology for a near-natural cycling experience. Plus, with improved responsiveness, durability, and range, the C11 Pro delivers effortless rides in any weather.

 

Now featuring a dual-sided torque sensor and upgraded drivetrain, an extended range for longer rides, and hydraulic brakes for superior stopping power, the C11 Pro redefines what a commuter e-bike can be.

 

With its 250W motor, the Fiido C11 Pro achieves:

 

  • 25 KPH top speed
  • 55 Nm of torque
  • 104 KMS max range 

If you're navigating busy streets or cruising open paths, experience the best in e-bike technology with the Fiido C11 Pro!

Enhanced Performance

With 55 Nm of torque, the Fiido C11 Pro delivers smooth acceleration while remaining energy-efficient and quiet. Meanwhile, an upgraded Mivice S200 dual-sided torque sensor ensures an ultra-responsive riding experience.

 

Paired with a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, the C11 Pro also offers optimised gearing for both fast cruising and hill climbing.

Extended Range for More Freedom

Thanks to its 499.2Wh removable battery, the C11 Pro offers a remarkable 104 KM maximum range – 35% longer than your standard commuter e-bike.

 

This battery is also equipped with BMS technology for excellent safety and durability, which ensures consistent performance in all weather conditions.

Superior Comfort and Control

Built for city riding, the Fiido C11 Pro features an oil-damped suspension fork that absorbs road bumps and vibrations. Its step-through frame makes mounting and dismounting effortless, while the adjustable saddle and handlebars ensure a comfortable fit for different riders.

 

On the other hand, hydraulic dual-piston disc brakes provide precise stopping power with minimal effort for safer, more controlled riding.

Safety and Smart Features

Stay visible and safe with the C11 Pro’s integrated lighting system, featuring an ultra-bright front light and an automatic brake light. 

 

The C11 Pro is also equipped with a 1.47-inch LCD display that provides clear, real-time data. These sync with the Fiido app and the Fiido Mate smartwatch (sold separately), which tracks heart rate and blood oxygen.

Built for the City Life

Designed to handle various conditions, the Fiido C11 Pro boasts an IP54-rated water-resistant build. Puncture-proof tyres are added to reduce the risk of flats on urban roads.

 

Additionally, the bike’s one-touch walk assist mode helps you push it effortlessly uphill or when carrying items.

title: Fiido Kidz Balance Bike
body_html:
The Fiido Kidz opens up a world of thrilling adventures and lifelong memories for little kids. Packed with features, functions, and safety settings, this electric balance bike creates a joyful riding experience while fostering children’s confidence and love for the outdoors!

Key Features:

  • Parental app control
  • Three riding modes
  • Toothed motor and clutch
DESCRIPTION

Designed for Growing Champions

Start your kids’ cycling journey with the Fiido Kidz Electric Balance Bike. Watch them learn, grow, and unlock a world of exciting adventures!

Equipped with thoughtful features and safety measures, the Fiido Kidz empowers young riders to explore on their own. But this isn’t just about fun today—it’s about building strong family bonds that will last a lifetime.

Ideal for riders 2 years old and above, the Fiido Kidz does not overwhelm. It achieves moderate top speeds of 5 to 12 kph, while its toothed motor and clutch deliver a smooth ride even with the power turned off.

Let your budding rider grow in confidence and tackle new challenges with the Fiido Kidz.

Parental control at your fingertips

Keep your child safe with adjustable riding modes and maximum speed settings that you can control directly from your smartphone.

Fiido has gone the extra mile to keep your little riders safe and secure, with the app that gives you access to detailed settings like power-assisted time and the option to enable or disable the throttle.

Lightweight champion

Our lightest e-ride yet, the Fiido Kidz weighs only 7.2 kg, allowing your child to easily manoeuvre and conveniently pick it up.

Despite being a featherweight, the Kidz is sturdy enough to accommodate up to 80 kg of rider weight. That’s right—even adults can join the fun!

Three riding modes for growing confidence

The Fiido Kidz offers three riding modes to suit every rider:

  • Push mode - Ideal for beginners, this mode allows your child to develop balance and coordination by propelling themselves.
  • Power-assist - For more confident little riders, this mode delivers a gentle boost to extend playtime and encourage exploration.
  • Full throttle - Skilled kids and older riders will have a lot of fun on the full-throttle mode, which offers a more exhilarating speed.

Learn and grow with pulse assist

This electric balance bike also features an innovative Pulse Assist mode, which detects your child’s pushing power and delivers a short burst of assistance. This helps budding riders maintain balance while encouraging legwork.

Long-lasting adventures

A single charge allows your child—or you—to play for up to 1-2 hours with the throttle engaged. The Fiido Kidz is not just a toy. It’s a first companion, an investment that encourages healthy habits and a lifelong love for cycling.

title: Fiido C11 Electric Bike
body_html:
Say hello to effortless city rides! The Fiido C11 excels on urban terrain, from smooth pavement to light gravel tracks, even uphill climbs, thanks to its powerful motor. Built with premium quality throughout, the C11 delivers a strong, impressive performance and ensures a smooth and easy ride every time.

Key Features:

  • Hydraulic disc brakes
  • Hydraulic front shock
  • 500Wh removable battery
DESCRIPTION

*For offroad/private property use only*

The Commuter Ride You Deserve

Fiido raises the bar once again with the Fiido C11! This commuter electric bike offers exceptional value, premium quality, and top-of-the-line performance at an attractive price tag. Designed for city riders, the C11 refines your e-bike experience and elevates every ride.

 
With its 500W motor, the Fiido C11 achieves:

 

  • 55 Nm of torque
  • 25 kph top speed (40 kph for off-road use)
  • Up to 90 kms on a single charge

Whether you prioritise design, features, or value, get the most out of your city commutes with the Fiido C11!

 
Elevated performance


The Fiido C11 is equipped with a 500W motor that delivers 678W of peak power and 55 Nm of torque so you can conquer urban roads and city streets. With adjustable power assistance from 5 Pedal Assist (PAS) modes, you can also effortlessly climb hills or navigate headwinds.


This force is balanced out by high-performance hydraulic disc brakes, ensuring you experience superior stopping power and control in any condition.


Extended range for every adventure


Using an efficient 500Wh battery, you can explore further and cover up to 90 kilometres on a single charge (on Power Assist).

 
Experience further convenience, as the battery is removable for easy and safe charging anywhere. Furthermore, you can expand your range with additional batteries (sold separately).

 
Unmatched comfort and versatility


The Fiido C11 delivers smooth and comfortable rides thanks to a front suspension fork that absorbs bumps and vibrations. Beyond that, a step-through frame, an ergonomic Velo saddle, and adjustable handlebars ensure you’re in the perfect riding position.


Meanwhile, you can boost the e-bike’s practicality with the included rear rack and adding optional accessories.

 
Advanced safety features


Stay safe and visible with the Fiido C11 commuter e-bike’s lighting system, which includes a brake light, reflective tyres, and a headlight that swivels with your movements.

 
Plus, a loud horn has been added to increase your presence on the road.


Smart and convenient functionalities


Designed to address your every need as a commuter, the C11 also features a concealed USB charging port so you can charge your phone on the go. A backlit display, on the other hand, allows you to stay informed on key metrics like speed and battery life.


Furthermore, you can connect your e-bike to the Fiido app for additional features and data tracking. You also have the option to connect the C11 to your Fiido Mate smartwatch (sold separately).

body_html:
Introducing the Fiido Titan: the ultimate cargo electric bike built for covering extended distances and exploring new horizons. This powerful fat-tyre electric cargo bike combines extended range, rugged construction, and innovative features to turn every ride into an adventure.

Key Features:

  • Powerful 750W motor
  • Fiido’s torque sensing technology
  • Oversized 26" x 4" fat tyres
DESCRIPTION

*For offroad/private property use only*

The Ultimate Electric Cargo Bike

The Fiido Titan cargo electric bike is a relentless machine. Oversized tyres glide over the toughest of terrains, while a powerful motor makes hill-climbing a breeze. It has the capacity to accommodate heavy cargo, while an advanced torque sensor ensures effortless handling.

Cover more ground with the Titan's efficient battery, or go even further with the Fiido Titan Extender Battery Combo (sold separately) to cover almost thrice the distance! 

With its 750W motor, the Fiido Titan achieves:

  • 70 Nm of torque
  • 45 kph top speed (off-road use)
  • Up to 115-km in range (346 kms with the 3-battery option)

When it comes to speed, range, power, and performance, the Fiido Titan does not leave any stone unturned. 

Expandable range

Explore further with the Fiido Titan’s efficient torque sensor, which maximises the 696Wh battery to reach an impressive 115-km range on a single charge.

Add two additional batteries using the Titan Extender Battery Combo (sold separately) and you can more than double this range, covering journeys up to a whopping 346 kilometres.

Reliable power and control

The Fiido Titan cargo electric bike is equipped with a powerful 750W motor and features up to 5 pedal assist levels (PAS) to tailor your ride to any terrain.

Plus, you can count on Fiido’s advanced torque sensor to deliver smooth and responsive power while extending your battery life.

Heavy-duty capacity

The Titan boasts a robust frame design with a staggering 200-kg total load capacity—120 kg on the saddle and 80 kg on the rear rack. If you’re looking to haul cargo, the Titan cargo e-bike is an ideal choice.

Comfort and convenience

The Fiido Titan’s plush Vedo saddle keeps you comfortable on extended journeys so you can focus on the adventure ahead.

Meanwhile, its sleek IP68-rated IPS display gives you access to all your ride information. In addition, this also doubles as the key to unlocking your removable battery.

Built to dominate

The Fiido Titan sets itself apart from other cargo electric bikes in the market with its powerful fat-tyre advantage. Its wide 26” by 4” fat tyres with one-piece wheels deliver superior grip and stability so you can explore even the most challenging territories.

Explore more with Fiido

Fiido is passionate about creating exceptional electric bikes and scooters that cater to every rider’s needs. By combining customer focus, innovative design, and efficient manufacturing, they are able to create exceptional and functional rides that blend unique artistry with everyday practicality.

Introducing the Fiido E-Gravel C21, a lightweight gravel electric bike that combines classic design with premium components for a smooth ride on both urban streets and gravel paths. Versatile and elegant, the C21 is praised by Forbes for its "exquisite craftsmanship, beautiful appearance, and precise riding experience."

  • Mivice torque sensor

    Description

    Understated Elegance Meets Urban Grit

    Fiido crafted the C21 with your needs in mind. Built for riders and praised by experts, the Fiido E-Gravel C21 boasts a design that keeps wiring hidden and a beautifully crafted aluminium alloy frame that keeps it lightweight yet robust.


    By utilising torque sensing technology, this electric bike is the perfect choice for riders who seek a stylish and affordable ride that delivers a precise and intuitive riding experience.


    With its 250W motor, the Fiido C21 achieves:

     

    • 40Nm of torque
    • 25 kph top speed
    • Up to 80 kms on a single charge

    Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or a curious newcomer, the Fiido C21 offers a serious e-bike experience that won't compromise on quality.

     

    Sleek and elegant aesthetic


    Ultra lightweight at only 17.9 kg, the Fiido C21 delivers a comfortable ride, effortless manoeuvrability, and incredibly easy handling.

     
    Plus, the ebike maintains a classic aesthetic thanks to its design that hides the wiring—keeping the frame clean and clutter-free, hence enhancing the C21’s sleek look.


    Intelligent power delivery

     

    The Fiido E-Gravel C21 is equipped with the Mivice Torque Sensor System, which precisely measures and syncs with your pedalling effort. This ensures the motor delivers exactly the right amount of power for a natural and dynamic ride.


    Gravel-ready geometry and features

     

    One look at the Fiido C21 and you can see how it sports the geometry of traditional gravel bikes. With a longer wheelbase for stability, a lower handlebar height, and an aggressive riding stance for quick manoeuvring, the Fiido C21 clearly prioritises great handling and performance over rough terrain.

     

    The C21 is also equipped with deep-tread gravel-style tyres that dig into loose surfaces for smooth and confident traction.

     

    Impressive performance

     

    Enjoy smooth, quiet assistance with the Fiido C21’s powerful zero-resistance motor that allows you to reach speeds up to 25 kph. 


    The electric bike also boasts a 120-kg maximum capacity, and with its 40 Nm torque, you can tackle hills and challenging terrains with ease.


    Top-tier safety features

     

    The Fiido E-Gravel C21 is fitted with high-performance Yanhao hydraulic brakes, allowing you to experience confident stopping power in any riding condition. In addition, an aluminium alloy fork with E-thru axle helps ensure a smooth ride.


    Efficient battery

     

    The Fiido C21’s 208.8 Wh battery offers an impressive 80-kilometre range on a single charge. Beyond its extended range, you can count on quick charging, as the battery fully charges in only 3 hours!

     

    Smart technology integration

     

    Because it is designed for riders, you can count on the Fiido E-Gravel C21 to have a mid-mounted crystal-clear display. The central position is aligned with most riding habits, while its IP67 water-resistance rating gives you access to easy-to-read information regardless of weather conditions.

title: Fiido T2 Longtail Cargo eBike
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

*For offroad/private property use only*

A Comfortable Ride for Everyday Use

Meet the Fiido T2 cargo electric bike, a bike built for everyday utility and strength. Designed for riders who need serious carrying capacity, it features practical storage solutions and reliable performance for everything from grocery runs to school pickups.

 

With its 750W motor, the Fiido T2 achieves: 

  • A 25 KPH top speed (33 KPH for off-road use)
  • A 136-KM max range
  • A 200-KG maximum capacity

A true workhorse, the Fiido T2 delivers the perfect balance of comfort, performance, and capacity.

 

Updates for 2025:

 

  • New Mivice S200 torque sensor (from the previous 12-magnet speed sensor)
  • Longer 136-km range (from the previous 111 km)

 

Built for Heavy Duty Performance

 

Powered by a robust 750W brushless geared motor and equipped with a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, the Fiido T2 promises responsive rides even with heavy cargo. Five levels of pedal assist, on the other hand, ensure the right amount of support in specific riding conditions. 

 

Thanks to an aluminium front fork and integrated suspension, this cargo e-bike smooths out bumps, whether you’re riding empty or loaded. Meanwhile, 4-piston hydraulic brakes with 230mm motors provide confident stopping power.

 

Capable Design

 

Constructed to be efficient and functional, the T2’s longtail design maximises cargo space while maintaining stability. A sturdy rear rack allows for multiple cargo configurations, from panniers and child seats, while the footrest offers full support and stability.

 

Overall, the frame has been tested to safely carry up to a whopping 200 KGS of total weight.

 

Extended Range

 

Using its 998Wh battery, the Fiido T2 cargo electric bike can cover up to 136 kilometres on a single charge. Because it is removable, it is safe and convenient to charge. Plus, it can be swapped for a fully-charged spare to extend your range even further.

 

Safe and Comfortable Rides

 

The Fiido T2 focuses on rider comfort, which makes it ideal for extended use. It features an adjustable handlebar and ergonomic Velo saddle to make sure you’re comfortable, while synthetic leather grips provide secure control.

 

Furthermore, super bright headlights and brake lights keep you safe and visible, especially during low-light riding conditions. Finally, a smart LCD display shows real-time data and keeps you informed of speed, battery level, and other vital stats at a glance.

title: Razor Dirt Rocket MX350 Kids Electric Dirt Bike
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Big Adventures Start Here

The Dirt Bike Every Young Rider Dreams Of

The Razor Dirt Rocket MX350 is the perfect choice for kids who are ready to experience the excitement of riding their very own electric dirt bike. Inspired by full-sized motocross bikes, it delivers the look and feel of off-road riding in a size that's built for younger riders.

 

Whether they're exploring private dirt tracks, riding around open paddocks or simply enjoying the outdoors, the MX350 helps young riders build confidence while creating unforgettable adventures.

Built for Off-Road Fun

Powered by a high-torque, chain-driven rear-wheel motor, the MX350 delivers smooth acceleration and plenty of grip on loose dirt, gravel and grass. With a top speed of 22 km/h, it offers an exciting ride that's fast enough to put a smile on their face while remaining easy to control as their skills grow.

 

A 24V rechargeable battery system provides up to 30 minutes of continuous ride time, giving kids plenty of time to explore before heading back for a recharge.

Just Like a Real Motocross Bike

The MX350 isn't just styled like a dirt bike, it rides like one too. Its authentic motocross frame geometry gives young riders a natural riding position, helping them feel comfortable and in control from the moment they twist the throttle.

 

Large 305 mm pneumatic knobby tyres provide excellent grip on dirt and uneven ground while softening bumps along the way, making every ride smoother and more enjoyable.

Easy to Learn, Fun to Ride

Simple motorcycle-style controls make the MX350 easy for young riders to get the hang of. The twist-grip throttle delivers smooth, predictable power, while the hand-operated rear brake gives them the confidence to slow down safely whenever they need to.

 

Adjustable riser handlebars allow the bike to feel comfortable as riders grow, while folding metal foot pegs, durable plastic fairings and a retractable kickstand mean it's ready for plenty of weekends filled with outdoor fun.

Made for Future Motocross Stars

Suitable for riders aged 8 years and over, the Razor Dirt Rocket MX350 supports riders up to 64 kg. Its sturdy 22 kg frame gives the bike a stable, confidence-inspiring feel that's perfect for young riders who are ready to step up to bigger off-road adventures.

 

Whether they're pretending to race through the bush or simply enjoying time outdoors with family and friends, the Razor Dirt Rocket MX350 brings the excitement of motocross to every ride.

title: Razor Crazy Cart (Black)
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Ultimate Drifting Machine

Drift Like a Pro

The Razor Crazy Cart is unlike anything else on wheels. Part go-kart, part drift machine, it lets young drivers cruise, slide, spin and carve their way around suitable private paved areas with complete control.

 

Drive it like a traditional go-kart, or pull up the patented Drift Bar to unlock sideways drifts, tight donuts and incredible 360-degree spins. Every ride is different, making the Crazy Cart just as exciting the hundredth time as it is the first.

Take Control of Every Slide

The signature Drift Bar is what sets the Crazy Cart apart. Keep it lowered for smooth, controlled driving, then lift it to break the rear wheels loose and transition into controlled drifting whenever you're ready.

 

Whether you're linking corners together or mastering your first full spin, the Crazy Cart gives you the freedom to create your own driving style.

Power That Keeps the Fun Going

A rechargeable 24V battery system delivers plenty of punch, reaching speeds of up to 19 km/h while providing up to 40 minutes of continuous ride time on a full charge.

 

That means more time perfecting your drifting skills and less time waiting to get back behind the wheel.

Built for Precision Driving

The Crazy Cart's innovative steering system allows for incredibly tight turns, reverse driving and full 360-degree manoeuvres, opening up a level of control that traditional ride-ons simply can't match.

 

A foot-operated accelerator gives riders smooth, variable speed control, making it easy to transition from cruising to drifting with confidence.

Engineered for Performance

A large pneumatic front tyre delivers excellent grip and helps smooth out imperfections in the riding surface, while the front stabilising posts keep the Crazy Cart balanced during more aggressive driving.

 

Built around a robust frame, it's made to handle countless drifting sessions and hours of outdoor fun on suitable private paved surfaces.

Ready for the Next Drift Champion

Designed for riders aged 9 years and over, the Razor Crazy Cart supports up to 64 kg and includes a battery charger, so you'll have everything you need to get started once assembly is complete.

 

If you're looking for a ride that's packed with action, creativity and endless opportunities to master new tricks, the Razor Crazy Cart delivers one of the most unique riding experiences you'll find.

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Ultimate Drifting Machine for Young Drivers

Learn to Drift, Spin and Slide

The Razor Crazy Cart Shift brings all the excitement of drifting into a package that's perfectly sized for younger riders. With its smaller frame, intuitive controls and simplified drift system, kids can quickly learn the skills that make the Crazy Cart one of Razor's most exciting rides.

 

Whether they're mastering their first controlled slide or perfecting smooth 360-degree spins, the Crazy Cart Shift delivers endless fun on private property.

Built to Grow with Young Drivers

The Crazy Cart Shift makes it easy for children to build confidence at their own pace thanks to two parent-selectable speed modes.

 

New riders can begin in LOW mode, where speeds are limited to 4 km/h for safe learning and maximum ride time. Once they're ready for more excitement, simply switch to HIGH mode to unlock speeds of up to 13 km/h.

 

Powered by a 90W Power Core™ hub motor, the Crazy Cart Shift delivers smooth acceleration with fewer moving parts, eliminating the need for chains or belts and keeping maintenance to a minimum.

Drift Made Easy

Unlike traditional ride-ons, the Crazy Cart Shift is purpose-built for drifting. Its simplified drift system automatically helps the rear wheels break traction, making controlled slides and spins easy to learn while allowing young drivers to keep both hands firmly on the steering wheel.

 

The responsive 1:1 steering ratio reacts instantly to every turn, creating a driving experience that's playful, predictable and incredibly rewarding as confidence grows.

More Time Behind the Wheel

A rechargeable 12V battery keeps the fun going with up to 80 minutes of continuous ride time in LOW mode, or up to 40 minutes in HIGH mode.

 

That means plenty of opportunities to practise drifting techniques, challenge friends or simply enjoy hours of outdoor play before it's time to recharge.

Comfortable, Durable and Ready to Ride

The lightweight, high-impact polymer frame is built to withstand regular use while remaining easy for younger riders to handle. A supportive bucket-style seat keeps drivers comfortably in position, while the airless front wheel and rear caster wheels strike the perfect balance between grip and controlled drifting.

 

The Crazy Cart Shift also arrives fully assembled with a battery charger and safety flag included, so it's ready for action straight out of the box.

Perfect for Future Drift Champions

Suitable for children aged 6 years and over in LOW mode and 8 years and over in HIGH mode, the Razor Crazy Cart Shift supports riders up to 54 kg.

 

For young drivers who dream of spinning, sliding and drifting like the pros, the Crazy Cart Shift offers a fun, approachable way to develop their skills while enjoying one of Razor's most iconic rides.

title: Razor PowerCore XLR150 Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

More Power for Every Ride

Built for Bigger Adventures

Ready to take the next step up from a beginner electric scooter? The Razor PowerCore XLR150 delivers extra power, higher speeds and a smoother ride for older kids and teens who want to explore with confidence.

 

Whether it's cruising around the neighbourhood, riding to the local park or enjoying weekends outdoors, the PowerCore XLR150 combines responsive performance with a simple, low-maintenance design that's built for everyday fun.

More Power, Less Maintenance

At the heart of the XLR150 is a 150W Power Core rear hub motor that delivers smooth, consistent acceleration up to 19.5 km/h. With no chains or belts to adjust, there are fewer moving parts to maintain, so riders can spend more time enjoying the ride.

 

A rechargeable 24V lead-acid battery provides up to 40 minutes of continuous ride time, making it ideal for after-school rides and weekend adventures.

Smooth, Stable and Confidence Inspiring

The rear-wheel drive system gives the scooter excellent traction under acceleration while creating a stable, predictable feel through corners and on everyday riding surfaces.

 

A large 200 mm pneumatic front tyre helps absorb bumps and cracks in the path, while the flat-free rear tyre removes the worry of punctures and keeps maintenance to a minimum.

Ride with Confidence

The PowerCore XLR150 is designed to be easy to control as riders build their confidence. A thumb-operated throttle delivers smooth acceleration, while the hand-operated front caliper brake and rear-fender brake work together to provide responsive stopping power whenever it's needed.

 

Soft rubber grips and an anti-slip deck add comfort and security, while the retractable kickstand makes parking quick and convenient between rides.

Ready for Older Riders

Designed for riders aged 13 years and over, the Razor PowerCore XLR150 supports up to 70 kg and weighs 12.2 kg, giving it a reassuringly solid feel without being difficult to handle.

 

With its combination of extra performance, stable handling and low-maintenance design, the Razor PowerCore XLR150 is the perfect companion for riders who are ready to venture a little further and enjoy every journey along the way.

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Big Fun for Young Riders

The Perfect First Electric Scooter

The Razor PowerCore E90 Black Label is a fantastic introduction to electric scooters for young riders who are ready to take the next step. Smooth, easy to control and built for everyday fun, it's equally at home cruising around the neighbourhood, riding through the park or exploring paved paths with family.

 

Powered by Razor's innovative Power Core hub motor technology, the E90 delivers reliable performance with fewer moving parts, so kids spend more time riding and less time waiting for maintenance.

Smooth Power That Keeps the Fun Going

A high-torque 90W rear hub motor delivers quiet, responsive acceleration at the push of a button, reaching speeds of up to 16 km/h. Without a chain or chain tensioner, the PowerCore drive system requires less maintenance while providing a smoother, more reliable ride.

 

Paired with a rechargeable 12V battery, the PowerCore E90 offers up to 65 minutes of continuous ride time, giving young riders plenty of opportunities to enjoy every charge.

Stable, Comfortable and Easy to Control

The rear-wheel drive layout improves traction during acceleration, helping the scooter feel balanced and predictable as riders build confidence.

 

Simple controls make getting started easy. A push-button throttle delivers smooth acceleration, while the hand-operated front brake provides reliable stopping power whenever it's time to slow down.

Built for Everyday Adventures

An all-steel frame and fork give the PowerCore E90 the durability needed for regular riding, while the flat-free rear tyre eliminates punctures and removes the need for pumping up tyres.

 

A retractable kickstand keeps the scooter upright when parked, making it easy to store between rides or while taking a break.

Ready for Years of Fun

Suitable for children aged 8 years and over, the Razor PowerCore E90 supports riders up to 54 kg. Weighing 9.8 kg, it's solid enough to inspire confidence on every ride while remaining practical for everyday family use.

 

Whether it's after-school laps around the block or weekend adventures at the local park, the Razor PowerCore E90 is built to deliver reliable electric fun ride after ride.

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Note: This is NOT an electric scooter.

The Perfect First Scooter for Little Riders

Build Confidence Through Play

The Razor Rollie DLX is a fun and versatile first scooter that helps little riders build balance, coordination and confidence from an early age. Starting out as a seated ride-on before converting into a stand-up scooter, it grows alongside your child as their skills develop.

 

Bright LED wheels and a glowing deck bring every ride to life, turning a trip around the driveway, footpath or local park into an adventure they'll look forward to every day.

Two Ways to Ride, Years of Fun

Young children can begin by using the comfortable padded seat while they learn the basics of steering and movement. As their confidence grows, simply remove the seat to transform the Rollie DLX into a traditional three-wheel kick scooter.

 

Both the handlebars and seat are height adjustable, making it easy to keep the scooter comfortable as your child grows.

Stable, Safe and Easy to Control

The three-wheel design offers excellent stability for beginner riders, helping reduce tipping while encouraging natural balance and coordination.

 

Instead of turning the handlebars, the Rollie DLX uses intuitive tilt-to-turn steering. Children simply lean in the direction they want to go, creating smooth and natural turns that are easy to learn.

 

Soft foam grips provide a comfortable hold, while the wide rear wheel and durable polypropylene deck create a stable platform for everyday riding.

Bright Lights Make Every Ride More Exciting

The Rollie DLX adds plenty of excitement with multi-colour LED lights built into both the front wheels and the deck. The lights automatically illuminate as the scooter moves, making every ride feel a little more magical.

 

To help preserve battery life, the deck lighting switches off automatically after 30 seconds of inactivity.

Perfect for Little Riders

Made for children aged 30 months to 4 years, the Razor Rollie DLX supports riders up to 19.5 kg while weighing just 3 kg, making it easy for parents to carry, transport and store when playtime is over.

 

Whether they're taking their first ride seated or confidently scooting on their own, the Rollie DLX is built to make those early riding adventures safe, fun and memorable.

title: Inmotion C10 Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Inmotion C10 Pro brings smart technology and practicality together in one electric scooter. Designed for both commuters and recreational riders, it combines dual-motor performance, all-day comfort, and app connectivity to create a more personalised riding experience from start to finish.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 350W motors (700W x 2 peak)
  • InMotion app connectivity
  • Dual spring suspension
  • Front dual-disc + electronic brakes

Connected Rides for the Modern Rider

The Inmotion C10 Pro is the perfect ride if you want more than just point-to-point transport. Through the InMotion app, you can monitor ride data, check battery levels, access scooter settings, and stay up to date with firmware updates. It’s a smarter way to manage every journey.

 

Powered by dual 350W motors, the Inmotion C10 gives you:

  • 1400W peak power
  • Up to 35 KPH speed (unlocked)
  • Up to 40 KMS range

 

Whether you're heading to work, meeting friends, or exploring your local area, the C10 Pro provides the power and range to get there comfortably.

Comfort for Daily Travel

City streets aren't always smooth, which is why the C10 Pro is equipped with dual spring suspension and large 10-inch pneumatic tyres. Together, they help soften bumps, improve stability, and reduce rider fatigue during longer trips.

Responsive Performance

Dual 350W brushless motors provide smooth acceleration and consistent power delivery, helping you maintain momentum through the busy city. The setup also offers the climbing capability needed for steeper streets and varied terrain.

Reliable Braking Control

A combination of front dual-disc brakes and electronic braking delivers great stopping performance in a wide range of riding conditions. The system offers strong braking confidence without feeling abrupt or difficult to manage.

Designed Around Everyday Use

The C10 Pro is designed to make every ride simple and intuitive. A spacious deck, clear integrated display, and responsive thumb throttle provide a comfortable riding experience, while InMotion app connectivity lets you track ride data, monitor battery levels, and manage scooter settings from your phone. 

Stylish, Durable, and Ready to Go

Built from lightweight aluminium alloy, the C10 Pro weighs just 25.3 KG while supporting riders up to 120 KG. Its clean cable-free design gives it a modern appearance, while front and rear lights improve visibility when riding after dark. With IPX5 water resistance, it's ready for the demands of everyday commuting.

title: Aventon Soltera 3 ADV Electric Bike
body_html:
Simple, lightweight, and built for everyday city riding, the Aventon Soltera 3 ADV focuses on practicality and low maintenance performance. With a Gates Carbon Belt Drive, torque sensor, hydraulic disc brakes, and an integrated battery, it delivers a smooth, reliable ride for commuting, errands, and general urban travel.

Key Features for 2026:

  • 250W rear hub motor 
  • Gates Carbon Belt Drive 
  • Integrated lights with turn signals
DESCRIPTION

Practical City Riding Made Easy

The Aventon Soltera 3 ADV is designed for straightforward urban transport. It keeps things simple with a lightweight frame, single-speed belt drive, and responsive pedal assist, making it easy to use day to day without ongoing maintenance requirements.

 

The motor provides smooth assistance that responds to your pedalling through a torque sensor, helping with acceleration, hills, and headwinds while keeping the ride natural and controlled.

 

With its 250W motor, the Soltera 3 ADV achieves:

 

  • 25 kph top speed
  • 540W peak motor output
  • Up to 112 km range on a single charge

It is designed for riders who want a basic, reliable e-bike for regular city use without unnecessary complexity.

Low Maintenance Belt Drive System

A key feature of the Soltera 3 ADV is the Gates Carbon Belt Drive. Unlike a traditional chain, it does not require lubrication or regular adjustment, and runs quietly with minimal upkeep.

 

The single-speed setup keeps operation simple, reducing parts that wear over time and making it easier to maintain long term.

 

Hydraulic disc brakes provide consistent stopping power in wet and dry conditions, supporting safe everyday riding in traffic.

Range for Daily Use

The integrated 366.8Wh battery provides up to 112 km of range depending on terrain and assist level. It is built into the frame for a clean setup and can be removed for charging if needed.

 

Charging takes approximately 3-4 hours, making it suitable for regular overnight or daytime top-ups.

City-Focused Design

The Soltera 3 ADV uses 700c wheels with 38C tyres to balance speed and stability on sealed roads and bike paths. A rigid aluminium fork keeps weight down and improves efficiency for commuting.

 

The frame geometry is designed for a comfortable but practical riding position, suitable for daily transport without being overly upright or aggressive.

 

Hydraulic disc brakes are fitted front and rear to provide reliable stopping performance in urban traffic conditions.

Simple, Connected Features

A built-in display provides basic ride information including speed, assist level, and battery status. Integrated front and rear lights improve visibility, with rear turn signals included for clearer communication in traffic.

 

The torque sensor adjusts assistance based on how hard you pedal, keeping power delivery smooth and predictable without abrupt changes.

Safety and Certification

The Soltera 3 ADV meets recognised safety standards, including UL 2849 for the electrical system and UL 2271 for the battery. It is designed for daily use with a focus on reliability and compliance.

Perfect for the City Rider

The Aventon Soltera 3 ADV is a practical e-bike for riders who want simple transport without extra complexity. It focuses on core features that matter for commuting and everyday travel, with minimal upkeep and consistent performance.
