title: Aventon Pace 5 REC Electric Bike
body_html:
Enjoy every ride with the Aventon Pace 5 REC. Designed around a relaxed riding position, intuitive technology, and a 250W motor, this premium cruiser e-bike makes everything from daily errands to weekend rides feel effortless.

Key Features for 2026:

  • 250W rear hub motor with Boost Mode
  • Comfortable upright riding position
  • 4G connectivity, GPS tracking and smart security features
DESCRIPTION

Cruise Further in Total Comfort

Built around a low step-through frame, swept-back handlebars, and an adjustable stem, the new Aventon Pace 5 REC promotes a relaxed upright riding position that reduces strain on your back, shoulders, and wrists. 


Combined with Aventon's latest smart technology and a powerful new motor system, it delivers an effortless riding experience whether you're commuting, exercising, or simply exploring your local area.


With its 250W motor, the Aventon Pace 5 REC achieves:


  • Up to 25 kph top speed
  • 80Nm of torque (96Nm in Boost Mode)
  • Up to 121 kilometres on a single charge

Combining comfort, power, and intelligent connectivity, the Pace 5 REC makes every ride your favourite ride.

Power when you need it

The Pace 5 REC features Aventon's most powerful cruiser motor to date. The 250W rear hub motor delivers smooth acceleration and confident performance across a variety of riding conditions, while Boost Mode unlocks up to 1440W of peak power when extra assistance is needed.


Whether you're climbing hills, riding into headwinds, or accelerating away from traffic lights, the motor provides responsive support that feels natural and easy to control.


Paired with an 8-speed Shimano drivetrain and torque sensor, the Pace 5 REC delivers a riding experience that feels both powerful and intuitive.

Ride your way

The Pace 5 REC combines advanced technology with simple everyday usability. Aventon's Ride Tune system allows you to personalise motor performance and assistance levels through the Aventon app, helping you tailor the bike to your preferred riding style.


Additional features such as Cruise Control, Sensor Switch, and regenerative braking further enhance the riding experience, giving you more flexibility, efficiency, and control every time you ride.


The customisable A280 display keeps ride information clearly visible, while Apple Watch connectivity adds another convenient way to stay connected on the go.

Comfort comes first

Every aspect of the Pace 5 REC has been designed around rider comfort. Its redesigned frame geometry creates a more upright seating position, while the swept-back handlebars bring controls naturally within reach.


The adjustable stem allows you to fine-tune your riding position, helping you find the perfect fit for longer rides. A wide comfort saddle and ergonomic contact points further improve support, making the Pace 5 REC ideal for recreational riding, fitness rides, and everyday transport alike.


The low step-through frame also makes mounting and dismounting easier, improving accessibility for a wider range of riders.

Smarter security and connectivity

The Pace 5 REC features Aventon's latest connected security platform, giving you greater peace of mind whenever your bike is parked.


Integrated GPS tracking, 4G connectivity, remote notifications, unusual activity detection, and E-Lock functionality work together to help protect your bike. For added security, the bike also features integrated rear wheel lock, keyless battery access, and password protection.

What's new on the Pace 5 REC?

The Pace 5 REC introduces a completely redesigned frame, with an updated geometry that provides a more upright riding position and accommodates a broader range of rider heights.


Swept-back handlebars and an adjustable stem return to further enhance rider comfort, while the 250W motor delivers the right amount of power. Combined with regenerative braking and a more efficient electrical system, the Pace 5 REC offers longer range, stronger acceleration, and a smoother riding experience overall.

Comfort. Power. Simplicity.

Whether you're heading to the café, exploring local bike paths, or simply getting outside more often, the Pace 5 REC is ready to help you ride further in comfort.

title: Aventon Current REC Electric Bike
body_html:
Ride further, climb higher, and explore more with the Aventon Current REC. Combining a powerful mid-drive motor, long-range battery, full suspension, and everyday practicality, this versatile electric mountain bike is equally at home on rugged trails and daily commutes.

Key Features for 2026:

  • Aventon Ultro S+ mid-drive motor with 100Nm torque
  • 140mm front and rear suspension travel
  • 800Wh battery with up to 168km range
DESCRIPTION

Trail capability meets everyday practicality

The new Aventon Current REC is built for riders who want one bike that can do it all. Designed around a powerful mid-drive platform and full-suspension chassis, it delivers the confidence and control of a modern eMTB while retaining the practicality needed for everyday riding.

 

Whether you're gliding over tracks, exploring trails, commuting to work, or heading into town, the Current REC provides smooth assistance, impressive comfort, and dependable performance across a wide variety of terrain.

 

With the new Aventon Ultro S+ motor, the Current REC can achieve:

 

  • 100Nm of torque
  • 250W motor
  • Up to 168 kilometres on a single charge

If you're looking for an electric mountain bike that balances trail performance with real-world versatility, the Current REC is ready for wherever the ride takes you.

Powerful mid-drive performance

Powering the new Current REC is Aventon's Ultro S+ mid-drive motor. Delivering up to 100Nm of torque and support levels up to 400%, it provides smooth, responsive assistance exactly when you need it.

 

The mid-drive design creates a more natural riding feel than traditional hub motors, helping you maintain traction, control, and efficiency on steep climbs and technical terrain. Whether you're navigating rocky ascents or cruising along bike paths, power delivery feels intuitive and predictable.

 

Paired with a Shimano CUES 10-speed drivetrain, the Current REC is ready to tackle everything from challenging climbs to fast-flowing descents.

Built to conquer rough terrain

Designed as a true full-suspension eMTB, the Current REC features 140mm of travel front and rear to help absorb impacts and smooth out rough trails.

 

The X-Fusion suspension system keeps the bike steady over rocks, roots, and uneven terrain while improving comfort on longer rides. Combined with large 29-inch wheels and confidence-inspiring geometry, it delivers stable handling and excellent rollover capability across a wide range of conditions.

 

Powerful Magura hydraulic disc brakes with oversized 203mm rotors provide strong and consistent stopping performance, giving you greater confidence when descending or riding in changing conditions.

Explore further with a massive 800Wh battery

The Current REC is equipped with a high-capacity 800Wh removable battery designed to support longer rides and bigger adventures.

 

Offering up to 168 kilometres of range, it gives you the freedom to spend more time exploring and less time worrying about charging. Whether you're heading deep into the trails or using the bike throughout the week for commuting and recreation, the Current REC has the capacity to keep up.

 

When it's time to recharge, the battery can be fully replenished in approximately six hours.

Smart technology for added confidence

The new Current REC combines trail-ready performance with advanced connectivity features designed to enhance security and convenience.

 

GPS tracking and 4G connectivity help you stay connected to your bike, while security features such as alarm notifications and password protection add another layer of protection when parked.

 

The integrated touchscreen display keeps key ride information easily accessible and provides a clean, modern cockpit experience.

Ready for every ride

Unlike many electric mountain bikes, the Current REC comes fully equipped for life beyond the trail. Integrated lights improve visibility, while full-length mudguards help keep you clean in changing conditions.

 

A sturdy rear rack makes carrying gear simple, whether you're transporting work essentials, shopping, or extra equipment for your next adventure. A fitted kickstand adds everyday convenience, making the Current REC as practical as it is capable.

One bike. Endless possibilities.

From weekday commutes to weekend adventures, the Current REC is ready for whatever comes next.

title: Aventon Level 4 REC Step Through Electric Bike
body_html:
Confident commuting meets cutting-edge technology with the Aventon Level 4 REC. Featuring a 250W rear hub motor, regenerative braking, smart security features, and up to 121 kilometres of range, it’s designed to make everyday travel easier, safer, and more efficient.

Key Features for 2026:

  • 250W motor
  • Regenerative braking technology
  • 4G connectivity, GPS tracking and smart security features

Also available in Step-Over

DESCRIPTION

Level Up: The Next Generation of Commuting Has Arrived

The Aventon Level 4 REC combines powerful performance, intelligent technology, and everyday practicality into one capable commuter e-bike. Whether you're riding to work, running errands, or exploring further from home, it's built to deliver a smooth, comfortable, and dependable experience.


Powered by a 250W rear hub motor, the Level 4 REC offers strong acceleration, impressive hill-climbing capability, and enough range to handle longer rides with confidence. Integrated smart features, including GPS tracking, remote notifications, e-lock functionality, and unusual activity detection, guarantee peace of mind both on and off the bike.


With its 250W motor, the Aventon Level 4 REC can achieve:


  • 25 kph top speed
  • 80Nm of torque
  • 121 kilometres on a single charge

If you're looking for an all-in-one commuter e-bike that’s comfortable, smart, and highly capable, look no further than the new Level 4 REC.

Smarter security and connectivity

Stay connected to your bike wherever you are. The Level 4 REC's integrated smart platform combines 4G connectivity, GPS tracking, and advanced security features to help protect your ride when you're away from it.


Features such as E-Lock, Hold Mode, unusual activity detection, and remote notifications allow you to monitor your bike and receive alerts if unexpected movement is detected. Combined with cloud-based connectivity, you'll always know where your bike is and what it's doing.

More power for every commute

Compared to previous generations, the Level 4 REC delivers a significant increase in performance thanks to its 250W motor and impressive peak output.


With 80Nm of torque as standard and up to 96Nm available in Boost Mode, acceleration feels responsive and confident, whether you're navigating city streets, tackling hills, or carrying extra cargo. The result is a ride that feels effortless, even on more demanding routes.

Go further with regenerative braking

One of the standout features of the Level 4 REC is its regenerative braking system. Every time you slow down, energy is captured and fed back into the battery, helping maximise efficiency and extend your riding range.

 

Paired with the large 733Wh battery, this technology allows the Level 4 REC to travel up to 121 KM on a single charge, making it ideal for longer commutes and all-day adventures.

Comfort built into every ride

Designed for daily use, the Level 4 REC ensures comfortable rides. An 80mm suspension fork helps smooth out rough roads, while the suspension seatpost absorbs vibrations and impacts for a more enjoyable ride.


An adjustable stem also allows you to customise your riding position, while the upright geometry promotes comfort and visibility during longer journeys. 

Fully equipped and ready to go

The Level 4 REC arrives equipped with everything you need for everyday riding. Integrated front and rear lights improve visibility in low-light conditions, while fenders help keep you clean and dry throughout the year. 


The rear rack also comes fitted as standard, making it easy to carry groceries, work essentials, or extra gear.

Ride farther, ride smarter with the Aventon Level 4 REC

Comfortable, capable, and intelligently connected, the Level 4 REC is the perfect e-bike for getting where you need to go every day.

title: Dualtron Forever Electric Scooter (60V 27Ah)
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Dualtron Forever is a proper upgrade from your old scooter – still compact enough to manage day to day, but with a big jump in power and range compared to entry-level models. If you want something that can handle longer rides and steeper roads without struggling, this is a solid step up.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 900W motors
  • 60V 27Ah battery
  • Hydraulic brakes

Stronger Performance for Longer Rides

The Forever is great for every kind of ride – from short trips to longer travels. With dual motors and a higher voltage system, it delivers stronger acceleration and better pulling power when you need it.

 

Powered by dual 900W motors, it delivers:

 

  • Up to 2 x 1100W peak output
  • Up to 25 km/h top speed
  • Up to 80 km range

The Forever is the best choice for riders who cover more distance or want a scooter that doesn’t feel underpowered.

More Than Just a Commuter

This is a scooter you can rely on beyond quick errands. The extended range means you won’t be charging as often, and the dual motor setup makes it more capable across different terrain. It feels more stable at speed and less strained when riding uphill or carrying extra weight.

Practical Storage

At around 27 KG, it’s not as light as smaller models, but still manageable for storage and transport. The folding system keeps it compact enough for a car boot or tight storage spaces.

Comfort That Holds Up

Adjustable suspension and 10-inch air-filled tyres make a noticeable difference over longer distances. It smooths out rough roads and keeps the ride more controlled, even when the surface isn’t perfect.

Stronger Braking

Hydraulic brakes, combined with electronic braking, give you more stopping power compared to basic setups. Braking feels firm and consistent, which matters more as speed and weight increase.

Display & Lights

The new EY4 display gives you a clear view of speed, battery, and ride settings. It also connects to the app via Bluetooth for added control. Built-in lights, turn signals, and a horn improve visibility and awareness, especially when riding in traffic.

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Dualtron Togo Plus is a step-up from the standard Togo, featuring more power, more range, and a stronger overall feel. It’s still compact enough for everyday use, but better suited if your rides are a bit longer or you want extra headroom in performance.

  • 48V 15.6Ah battery

More Power for Your Rides

The Togo Plus gives you a noticeable boost in performance without becoming difficult to handle. Acceleration feels more responsive, especially when pulling away from a stop or riding on slight inclines.


Powered by an efficient 760W single hub motor, it delivers:


  • Up to 920W output
  • Up to 25 km/h top speed

This scooter is a better fit if your commute is longer or if you just want a bit more flexibility in how you ride.

Ideal for Regular Use

The Togo Plus is designed to handle daily riding without feeling limited. The extra range means fewer charges through the week, and the added power makes it more usable across different routes. This scooter still keeps things predictable, so it doesn’t feel overwhelming even with the added performance.

Solid But Still Portable

At 26.3 KG, it’s slightly heavier than entry-level models but still manageable when needed. The folding system is quick and secure, making it easier to store in smaller spaces or transport when required.

Smooth on City Streets

Front & rear spring and rubber suspension help take the impact out of rough patches, while the 9-inch pneumatic tyres add grip and cushioning. It feels more steady overall, especially at higher speeds.

Controlled Braking

The braking setup combines front and rear drum brakes with electronic assistance, which gives you steady stopping power without sudden jolts. It’s designed to stay stable, even when braking a bit harder.

Display & Lights

The EY2 display shows speed, battery, and ride settings clearly. Lighting is built in for visibility, including a bright headlight and rear brake light. With an IPX5 rating, it’s also fine for riding in light rain.

The Dualtron Dolphin is the perfect choice for riders who want more range and a bit more flexibility in their daily commute. It’s still compact enough to store easily, but with a larger battery and added features that make longer rides more practical.

title: Inmotion C10 Electric Scooter

DESCRIPTION

The Inmotion C10 is your new everyday city companion. Designed for riders who value style, comfort, and performance, the Inmotion C10 is sleek, practical, and built to handle the pace of modern urban life.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 350W motors (700W x 2 peak)

Built for the City

The Inmotion C10 transforms your everyday ride into something smoother, faster, and more enjoyable. Compact in size but full of punch, it delivers reliable speed and handling without compromise.

 

Powered by dual 350W motors, the Inmotion C10 gives you:

  • 1400W peak power

Smooth and Confident Ride

Strong Brakes, Controlled Stops

title: Aventon Aventure M Electric Bike
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

From rocky trails to sandy paths and forest tracks, the Aventon Aventure M is ready for anything. With a powerful mid-drive motor, adaptive power modes, and smart security features, it gives you more control, comfort, and confidence wherever you ride.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Aventon A100 mid-drive motor with AutoShift and Ride Tune
  • Aventon Control Unit with GPS tracking and built-in lock
  • Auto Mode that adjusts power automatically on any terrain

The All-New Aventure M: Smarter Power, Smoother Control

The Aventure M is built to handle anything: from steep tracks to soft sand. Its meticulously designed frame, 4.0" tyres, and 80 mm suspension fork keep you stable and comfortable, while the mid-drive motor gives natural, responsive power when you need it most.

Equipped with a 250W mid-drive motor, the Aventure M delivers:

 

  • 45 kph top speed (unlocked)
  • 100Nm of torque
  • Up to 136 kms on a single charge

Built to adapt, not compromise, the Aventure M gives you total confidence even when the road turns to trail.

Mid-Drive Power That Feels Natural

The A100 mid-drive motor puts out 100 Nm of torque and up to 750W of peak power*, which helps you climb hills and cruise through rough terrain easily. 

 

The motor’s torque sensor also responds to how hard you pedal, giving a smooth, natural feel that keeps you in control on every surface.

 

* The mid-drive motor delivers 250W of sustained power and can generate bursts of power at 750W peak.

Smarter Shifting, Effortless Riding

The Aventure M uses an electronic shifter powered by the main battery, so every gear change is quick and clean. With AutoShift, the bike can shift on its own based on your speed and cadence. No more thinking about gears, just ride and enjoy!

Power For The Trail

Auto Mode adjusts how much motor support you get depending on the terrain. It gives extra help when climbing and then eases off on flat ground, so the power always feels steady and natural.

Security Made Easy

The Aventure M helps protect your ride with an integrated wheel lock, optional startup password, and GPS tracking. You can see where your bike is and get alerts if it’s moved without permission, all through the Aventon app.

Comfort For Long Rides

A suspension seatpost with 50 mm of travel and fat 4.0" tyres absorb bumps and rough ground. Together with the 80 mm fork, they make long or uneven rides much smoother and less tiring.

Always Ready for Adventure

The Aventure M updates itself over the air, so it always runs the latest software without a visit to the shop. It’s IPX6 water-resistant (IPX7 for the motor), UL safety-certified, and built to carry up to 181 kg. Lights, fenders, and a rear rack are integrated so you’re ready to ride straight out of the box.

DESCRIPTION

The Evada Dash 150 is a fun, lightweight scooter made for kids aged 6 and up. It’s easy to handle, safe to ride, and designed to help young riders learn to ride confidently. Compact, sturdy, and simple to use, it’s the ideal everyday companion for neighbourhood play and short adventures.

 

Key Features:

  • 16 KPH top speed

Beginner-Friendly, Parent-Approved

The Evada Dash 150 gives kids a smooth, predictable ride that makes learning feel natural. Powered by a gentle 150W rear motor, it offers steady acceleration and easy handling – just right for young riders getting the hang of scootering.

Gentle Power and Range

A single charge lets them enjoy up to 12 KM of riding, which is perfect for trips to the park or cruising around the neighbourhood. With a top speed of 16 KPH, kids get the excitement they want while staying safely within beginner-friendly limits.

Smooth and Safe Riding

The Dash 150’s compact frame and stable stance help young riders feel secure from the moment they hop on. Its rear-wheel drive setup adds traction and balance, so every ride feels steady and manageable from straight lines to turns.

Lightweight, Strong, and Easy to Carry

At only 8.8 KG, this scooter is light enough for kids to move and parents to carry when needed. The frame supports up to 60 KG, giving it plenty of room to grow with your child through years of play.

Kid-Friendly Design

Everything on the Dash 150 is designed for the budding adventurer. The controls are straightforward, the layout is intuitive, and the size is perfect for smaller riders. It’s a scooter that encourages confidence, independence, and everyday fun, whether it’s their first ride or their favourite daily activity.

title: Inmotion RS Jet Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Meet the newest member of the Inmotion RS family. The Inmotion RS Jet keeps the power and attitude of the original RS but makes it lighter, quicker, and easier to ride with. It’s built for riders who want speed and excitement in a more compact package.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 1200W motors
  • Adjustable suspension
  • Full hydraulic brakes

Smaller Frame, Bigger Fun

The RS Jet brings RS-level performance into a leaner, more lightweight design. With its dual 1200W motors and 72V battery (the first in this price category!), it delivers effortless acceleration, a top speed of 80 KPH (unlocked), and an ultra-smooth ride. 

 

Powered by two 1200W motors, the Inmotion RS Jet gives you:

  • 4600W peak power
  • Up to 80 KPH speed (unlocked)
  • Up to 90 KMS range

 

It’s fast, efficient, and made for riders who want power they can actually use day to day.

Smooth and Adjustable Suspension

Not all roads are equal, and that’s where the RS Jet’s adjustable suspension comes in. With a simple twist, you can adjust your setup whether it’s for more comfort or better performance. 

Tailored for Every Rider

Comfort counts, especially at high speeds. That’s why the RS comes with adjustable handlebars, so riders of any height can find a natural, relaxed stance. Less strain, more control.

Reliable Hydraulic Brakes

When you’re moving fast, control matters. The RS Jet’s full hydraulic brakes with 160mm rotors give you consistent stopping power with less effort. Whether you’re slowing down gradually or stopping suddenly, the feel is solid and predictable every time.

Foldable Dual-Stem Design

Strength and practicality are equally important, which is why the Jet features a foldable dual-stem design. It gives the scooter a sturdier front end for a more stable feel, even at high speeds or on rough ground. At the same time, the folding system is quick, easy, and secure.

Smart Display and Full Lights

The Jet is also equipped with a bright 4.3” touchscreen display that’s clear, responsive, and easy to read even in full daylight. It gives you instant access to your speed, battery, modes, and more.

 

Meanwhile, built-in signal lights and a bright rear taillight make sure you’re seen at night and able to communicate with other road users well.

Ready for Everyday Adventures

From short commutes to weekend rides, the RS Jet is built to handle real-world conditions. Its IPX6 water resistance means you can ride in light rain and through puddles, while 11” tubeless tyres provide grip and comfort wherever you go.

title: Inmotion RS Lite Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Meet the Inmotion RS Lite, a high-powered scooter that’s part race-car, part off-road SUV. With all-terrain capability, extended range, and a world-first adjustable frame, it’s made for riders who want to go places and ride their own way.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 1500W motors
  • 4 adjustable pedal heights
  • Front + rear hydraulic suspension

Transforms to match your ride

The Inokim RS Lite is the world's first electric scooter with a transforming system. Choose from four pedal heights – higher for comfort and ground clearance, or lower for more speed and control – and complete the experience with adjustable suspension and extreme power. 

 

Equipped with dual 1500W motors, the RS Lite delivers:

 

  • 6000W peak power
  • Up to 120 KM range
  • Hill grade of up to 50%

From city streets to rough trails, the RS Lite adapts to every terrain and every ride.

World-First Transforming Frame

Inspired by SUV engineering, the RS Lite features a patented four-level adjustable pedal height system, from 183 mm to 303 mm. This gives you control over your suspension feel and ride height, which can be adjusted for speed, off-road grip, or added comfort. 

Serious Power and Range

With two 1500W motors (6000W peak), the RS Lite handles steep 50% inclines without slowing down. You also get a long-lasting 72V 30Ah battery that can take you up to 120 KM on a single charge, and dual charging ports to cut charging time in half.

Smooth on Rough Roads

Front and rear hydraulic suspension gives you up to 96mm of travel – enough to absorb the vibrations from potholes, bumps, and uneven paths. It also features 11 levels of adjustability, so you can fine-tune the feel to match your ride style.

Grips Like Nothing Else

Big 11×3.5” tubeless tyres offer solid grip and control on all surfaces, from tarmac to dirt trails. They’re built to handle high speeds and sharp turns while keeping you stable at every point.

Brakes That Match the Power

To safely handle its monstrous speed, the RS Lite is fitted with dual 160mm full-hydraulic disc brakes and a regenerative system on both wheels. The stopping power is sharp and controlled even when you’re going full throttle.

Built for Real-World Riding

Rain in the forecast? No problem. The RS Lite is IP67-rated, so you can ride through rain, shallow puddles, and wet roads without worrying about water damage.

Comfort Meets Control

You’ll find a clear 4.2” LCD screen right where you need it, along with raised, comfortable handlebar grips that keep your hands relaxed on long rides. The wide deck gives you more space to move, and the scooter feels stable even at high speed.

Extreme Performance. Innovative Design.

The Inmotion RS Lite sets a new standard in the high-performance scooter world. With its ingenious adjustable frame, serious top speed, and versatile suspension system, there's no other scooter to consider if you want the full riding experience.

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The MATE Fusion is built for riders who want a bike that’s as flexible as their lifestyle. It’s light, foldable, and easy to handle, but still packs enough power and comfort to take you beyond the city streets.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Bafang motor with torque sensor
  • Dual suspension system

MATE Fusion: The Best of Both Worlds

The MATE Fusion brings together the power of an urban commuter with the portability of a folding e-bike. It’s simple, clean, and compact, yet designed to give you the confidence to take on more than just smooth roads.

 

Perfect for commuting, quick errands, or even a weekend ride outside the city, the Fusion folds down in seconds and adjusts to fit riders of almost any height. Easy to carry, store, and ride, it’s a bike made to fit into your everyday routine without holding you back.

 

Powered by a 250W motor, the MATE Fusion offers:

The result is a folding e-bike that feels practical, stylish, and ready for whatever the day throws at you.

Smooth handling

With Bafang’s system running the motor, torque sensor, and display, everything works together smoothly. The torque sensor picks up on your pedalling instantly, so the bike feels responsive whether you’re cruising through traffic or climbing a hill.

Compact, foldable, portable

Weighing just 23.5 kg, the Fusion folds down quickly for carrying on public transport or tucking into a small corner at home. Both the handlebar and seatpost adjust easily, so the bike fits riders from 150 cm up to 210 cm.

Sharp, city-ready look

The Fusion has a clean, modern look that stands out without being flashy. The fenders and seat have been redesigned for a sleeker profile, while the built-in rear rack adds function without clutter. 

 

The bars are also left clean and uncluttered, which leaves you room for the upgrades or accessories you want to add yourself.

Smart and reliable

A Bluetooth-enabled display keeps your ride info accessible, while Tektro hydraulic brakes give you solid stopping power in any weather. Built on a strong aluminium frame and designed for everyday use, the Fusion is a bike that’s meant to last.

It's quick to install at home and is designed to support correct usage and provide added peace of mind. We strongly recommend fitting it as part of your regular safety routine.

title: Inmotion S1 Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Inmotion S1 packs more power, more range, and more features into one tough commuter scooter, perfect for long-distance and heavy use. From long-haul rides to steep climbs and all the bumps in between, it’s built to take it all on.

 

Key Features:

 

  • 1000W peak motor
  • Front and rear wheel suspension
  • Integrated turn signals

Upgrade to bigger rides and better comfort

The Inmotion S1 is a long-range commuter scooter, the ideal choice for those who need a sturdy and heavy-duty daily driver. With dual suspension, 10-inch tyres, and a wide deck, it delivers a smooth and stable ride, whether you're cruising city streets or navigating rougher paths. The powerful motor and smart features make it perfect for heavy riders, hilly areas, and long distances.

 

Powered by a 500W rear motor, the Inmotion S1 delivers:

 

  • Peak output of 1000W
  • Hill climb of up to 30% gradient
  • Up to 95 km of range

For long commutes or all-day exploring, the S1 keeps up.

Unmatched Range for the Long Haul

Equipped with a massive 675 Wh lithium battery, the S1 goes the distance – up to 95 km on one charge. With up to 40% more range than other high-end commuter scooters, you have the freedom to ride more and charge less.

Smooth Over Bumps

With a dual shock absorption system, the S1 cushions your ride with front and rear suspension that smooths out bumps, dips, and rough pavement. It’s the kind of comfort that makes longer rides feel shorter and everyday trips more enjoyable.

Handles Hills Like a Pro

Thanks to its powerful motor, efficient throttle, and strong rear-wheel drive, the S1 can easily climb hills up to 30% grades and glide over varied terrain, even when carrying heavier loads.

Ideal for Bigger Riders

The S1 supports riders up to 140 kg and features a spacious, rubberised deck that’s 20% wider than similar models. Taller riders will also appreciate the 127.5 cm high handlebars, designed to deliver a more relaxed and comfortable stance.

Brighter and Smarter

High-mounted dual LED headlights brighten the road ahead. Automatic turn signals on the sides help alert other road users when you’re making a move, while a rear brake light adds visibility from behind.

Heavy-Duty Tyres

Fitted with 10-inch tubeless pneumatic tyres, the S1 gives you reliable grip, shock absorption, and durability. They’re built to handle everyday use and take on imperfect roads and rougher everyday conditions.

Go Anywhere With the S1

With its long range, high-performance motor, and ergonomic design, the Inmotion S1 is an excellent choice for commuters who want more comfort, more speed, and fewer compromises.

title: Inmotion RS Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Say hello to Inmotion’s fastest, most robust electric scooter. The Inmotion RS is engineered for extreme speed and power, with groundbreaking features that make every ride smoother, safer, and more exciting.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 2000W motors
  • 4-level adjustable suspension
  • Adjustable handlebar height

Extreme performance from groundbreaking technology

The Inmotion RS is built for riders who want to go all out. With dual 2000W motors and a massive 72V battery, it delivers breathtaking acceleration and smooth power across any terrain. From comfortable rides to steep climbs, the RS handles it all.

 

Powered by two 2000W motors, the Inmotion RS gives you:

 

  • 8400W peak power
  • Up to 160 KMS range
  • Hill grade of up to 50%

If you're after incredible comfort, long range, and serious overall performance, the RS is your ride.

One Scooter, Four Setups

The Inmotion RS is the first scooter in the world with a 4-level adjustable suspension system. Using a simple lever or knob, you can quickly switch shock absorption levels to match your current riding conditions: 183mm for city streets, 213mm for slight bumps, 253mm for rough roads, and 303mm for off-road adventures.

Tailored for Every Rider

Comfort counts, especially at high speeds. That’s why the RS comes with adjustable handlebars, so riders of any height can find a natural, relaxed stance. Less strain, more control.

Zoom Hydraulic Brakes with Electric Assist

Reliable braking is a must, and the RS uses dual Zoom hydraulic brakes with 160 mm discs, supported by an electric braking system that slows the motors themselves. This setup not only boosts stopping power but also reduces wear and helps keep things smooth.

Smart Controller for a Smooth Ride

An advanced onboard controller keeps power delivery consistent and responsive. It adjusts in real time for better handling, smoother acceleration, and smarter battery use. The result is nothing less than a ride that always feels sharp and stable.

Confident Riding in Any Weather

The RS has an IP67-rated frame – that means no stress over puddles, splashes, or even heavy rain. 

Connected and Customisable via App

With the companion app, you can check your stats, track battery health, and fine-tune your settings on the go. It’s simple, powerful, and built to help you ride smarter every day.

DIY-Friendly and Easy to Upgrade

The RS gives you room to make it your own. Thanks to its plug-and-play layout, it’s easy to swap in your own throttle, grips, tyres, or suspension. No special tools needed!

The Fastest, Most Customisable Ride Out There

The Inmotion RS is more than just fast; it’s a one-of-a-kind ride with top-notch power, flexibility, and tech. Whether you're after exciting adventures or looking for a high-end daily driver, this is the scooter that delivers it all.

title: Inmotion Climber Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Engineered to power through hills, rain, and long days on the road, the Inmotion Climber is a performance-grade electric scooter made for serious riders. Dual motors, tough construction, and smart design give it the muscle and reliability you need for demanding urban commutes.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 450W motors
  • Up to 56 KM of range
  • IPX6 water resistance 

Take on the toughest commutes

The Inmotion Climber isn’t your average city scooter. With dual motors and real climbing power, it tackles hills and inclines that other scooters can’t. The weather won’t be a problem either, as it’s built with a high waterproof rating and rugged components to keep you moving, no matter the conditions.

 

Powered by dual 450W motors, the Climber delivers:

 

  • Peak output of 1500W
  • Hill climb of up to 36% gradient
  • Up to 56 KM of range

It’s strong, quick, and ready for real-world riding.

Dominate the Hills

With a motor in each wheel and serious torque, the Climber handles steep streets and hilly suburbs easily, even with a full 130 kg load. Its hill grade capability of 36% is high for its class, which makes it a top choice for riders who need power without compromise.

Waterproof and Ready

The Climber is built with an IPX6-rated body, which offers excellent protection against rain and wet weather. The battery, motor, and controller are all safely sealed, so you can keep riding without worries when it rains.

Easy Maintenance

Thanks to its modular design and split-rim motor, changing a tyre on the Climber is refreshingly simple. No specialised tools or complicated steps necessary: just a straightforward 10-minute swap when needed, so you're back on the road sooner.

Built to Last

Constructed with aircraft-grade aluminium, the Climber is strong enough to support heavier riders while staying portable and manageable. At just over 20 kg, it's robust without being overly bulky – perfect for serious use that still fits your everyday life.

Smart Battery Management

The 36V battery is backed by a Smart BMS that monitors each cell for better safety, efficiency, and longevity. A built-in balancer ensures the cells charge evenly, extending battery life and maintaining peak performance over time.

Responsive Braking System

For safety even at speed, the Climber uses dual electronic brakes paired with a rear disc brake. It reacts in just 0.01 seconds and offers excellent control and precision during sudden stops, even on wet or uneven ground.

Ride at Night Confidently

A bright headlight lights the way ahead, while rear brake lights make sure others see you coming to a stop. Day or night, visibility is a priority, especially at higher speeds.

Comfort and Grip

The Climber’s 10-inch pneumatic tyres come with extra-thick inner tubes, which reduce the risk of flats while improving shock absorption. Meanwhile, a wider deck and anti-slip footpad give you the stance and stability you need on longer rides.

Big Power, Zero Compromises

If you need a scooter that promises power, control, and durability without compromising on portability, look no further than the Inmotion Climber. From steep inclines to rainy streets, it’s built to perform where other scooters fall short.

title: Inmotion Air Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Powerful, fast, and practical, the Inmotion Air Pro upgrades your commute with stronger acceleration, longer range, and a fuss-free riding experience. Whether you’re climbing hills, gliding through streets, or weaving through traffic, the Air Pro makes every part of your journey smoother.

 

Key Features:

 

  • 400W motor with 750W peak power
  • Up to 48 KM of range
  • Dual braking system

Faster and smarter city commutes

The Inmotion Air Pro is made for riders looking for a scooter that can handle their daily trips and more. With a high peak power and an impressive range, this sleek and capable scooter turns everyday travel into something to look forward to.

 

Powered by a 400W rear brushless motor, the Inmotion AIR Pro delivers:

 

  • 750W of peak power
  • 25 KPH top speed (unlockable to 35 KPH for private property use)
  • Up to 48 KM of range 

Whether you’re racing the clock or just riding for fun, the Air Pro does it with ease.

Conquer Hills, No Sweat

Thanks to its rear-wheel drive and high torque motor, the Inmotion Air Pro can scale inclines of up to 20%. It accelerates confidently and maintains speed on varied terrain, so you’re not slowed down by slopes or tricky surfaces.

Comfort Meets Convenience

The Air Pro’s tyre setup is meant for both comfort and safety. A 10-inch pneumatic tyre at the front absorbs bumps for a smoother ride, while the rear features a 10-inch PU-filled tyre that’s resistant to punctures. That means less maintenance, fewer flat tyres, and more time on the road.

Braking Made Safer

Inmotion’s dual-brake system uses smart Anti-Roller tech to activate the rear regenerative brake before the front drum brake, distributing braking force for stable and controlled stops. Even when you're in less-than-perfect riding situations, the Air Pro’s braking system gives you the confidence to ride safely.

Bright, Clear, and Visible

The ultra-bright front headlight projects up to 15 metres ahead to keep your path clearly lit. Rear brake lights boost your visibility to others, while front and rear LEDs ensure you’re seen at all angles, even after dark.

Ergonomic Details

An LCD display shows speed, battery, and ride mode at a glance. Two riding modes let you switch between efficiency and power with a double-tap of the power button. The wide anti-slip footpad offers more stability, and the generous footrest adds comfort for longer rides.

Sleek Design With Hidden Wiring

With its clean frame and hidden wiring design, the Inmotion Air Pro looks just as good as it performs. The minimalist style also keeps things practical, as fewer exposed wires mean less risk of damage or snags when folding or storing.

Rethink The Entry-Level Scooter

Blending speed, range, and real-world practicality, the Inmotion Air Pro is set to create a new standard for what an everyday electric scooter can be. Whether you're a commuter or casual rider, it's the perfect mix of fun, function, and freedom.

title: Inmotion Air Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Compact, comfortable, and built for city life, the Inmotion Air is a great choice for anyone after a reliable everyday scooter. It’s lightweight enough to carry, powerful enough to climb hills, and packed with practical features that make daily riding easier and safer.

 

Key Features:

 

  • 15.6 kg unit weight
  • 35 km of range and 18% hill grade
  • Dual braking system

Smart and simple everyday travel

The Inmotion Air is a compact electric scooter built to make city riding easy. With a rear-mounted motor, road-ready pneumatic tyres, and a reliable braking system, it offers both performance and comfort on everyday rides. Lightweight and easy to store, it’s ideal for short commutes, spontaneous trips, or simply getting around with less effort.

 

Powered by a 350W brushless motor, the Inmotion AIR delivers:

 

  • 25 KPH top speed
  • Hill climbing up to 18% gradients
  • A range of up to 35 km

It’s perfect for the daily run or your weekend cruise around town!

Lightweight and Portable

At just 15.6 kg, the Inmotion Air is easy to carry onto trains, up staircases, or into your office. The quick-folding design collapses the scooter in seconds, so you can store it without hassle in tight spaces. At the same time, it’s built with a tough aluminium frame that supports riders up to 120 kg.

City Commutes Covered

The Inmotion Air’s 270Wh battery allows you to travel up to 35 kilometres on a single charge so you can confidently complete your daily routes without needing to recharge midday. And with overcharge, overheat, and short-circuit protection built in, the Smart BMS keeps your battery healthy and safe ride after ride.

Comfort and Stability

Fitted with 10-inch pneumatic tyres front and rear, the Air can handle uneven streets and city paths. The larger tyres absorb bumps and give you better grip, which makes every ride feel stable and smooth. Whether you're cruising across town or weaving through rush-house traffic, it’s a ride that feels solid under your feet.

Safety Features You Can Trust

The AIR features a dual braking system: a front drum brake for dependable mechanical stopping power, and a rear regenerative brake that helps slow you down while feeding power back into the battery. 

 

Plus, equipped with a high-lumen headlight, the Air keeps you visible in low-light conditions.

Clear Display, Easy Control

The built-in LCD display keeps you in the know by showing your speed, battery level, and current mode. Meanwhile, three riding modes let you switch between efficient cruising and quicker commuting, depending on your needs for the day. 

The Perfect Ride for Urban Life

The Inmotion Air brings together power, comfort, and portability in a sleek, city-ready scooter. Whether you're commuting to work, running errands, or just enjoying the ride, the Air is a smart way to move through your day.

title: Kaabo Wolf King GTR Max Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Wolf King has evolved to become much stronger and more powerful. Meet the GTR Max, which features a larger removable motor, upgraded suspension, and better handling across any surface. Every part is built for real-world use: fast, powerful, and easy to maintain.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Powerful dual 2000W motors
  • Front motorcycle + rear damping oil pressure shock absorber
  • Front and rear hydraulic brakes

GTR Max: Maximum Build for a Maximum Ride

Designed to handle extreme performance without sacrificing ride feel, the Wolf King GTR Max delivers an experience that’s smooth, stable, and built for riders who want more than speed. With excellent power delivery, smarter shock absorption, and better rider ergonomics, the GTR Max elevates every aspect of your ride.


From brutal hills to winding roads, this is a scooter made to conquer them all. Thanks to a refined motor system, long-range battery, and upgraded components, you'll always be in command, no matter the terrain.

Enhanced Motor, Greater Efficiency

The Wolf King GTR Max now features a removable 7" diameter motor that is larger, more powerful, and easier to service. The increased size boosts torque and climbing ability, while improving heat dissipation and motor lifespan. Maintenance-wise, it’s incredibly easy to just pop it off and go.

Custom Suspension for Real-World Riding

Your ride gets a major upgrade with an all-new suspension setup. Up front, you get an adjustable dual-arm motorcycle-grade shock absorber, with increased travel for smoother handling. In the rear, an oil-damped spring shock adds better response and more comfort. 

Durable Battery with Smart Protection

The GTR Max is also equipped with a high-performance lithium battery pack enclosed in a sealed aluminium casing for added waterproofing and safety. Easy to carry, it powers extended rides and includes advanced protection against:

 

  • Overcharge
  • Over-discharge
  • Short circuit
  • Overcurrent
  • Low and high temperatures

Bigger Deck, Lower Centre of Gravity

The newly expanded deck on the Wolf King GTR Max gives you a more stable riding stance, perfect for high-speed runs or rougher paths. And with a lower deck height (down from 258mm to 224mm), you benefit from a reduced centre of gravity that gives you sharper handling and improved balance at speed.

Precision Performance from the 2-in-1 FOC Controller

Kaabo’s 2-in-1 FOC controller delivers instant acceleration and throttle response. Backed by dual-layer design, smart chip integration, and improved algorithms, this advanced controller ensures faster power delivery and better heat management – ideal for riders pushing performance to the edge.

Five Smart Ride Modes

Adapt your ride with five modes tailored for any scenario:

 

  • Sport Mode for full-throttle fun
  • ESP Mode for safety-enhanced control
  • Pedestrian Mode for low-speed manoeuvring
  • Anti-Theft Mode to protect your scooter when parked
  • Gears Memory Mode for quick starts with your preferred settings

Upgraded All-Terrain Tyres from CST

Co-developed with CST, the new 100-55-7 vacuum tyres deliver more surface contact and a stronger grip across all terrains. They keep the ride smooth, fast, and confidently stable, even at high speeds.

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

For riders who demand what’s best and need more range, more power, and more comfort, the Pure Air⁵ Ultra Suspension is the ultimate ride. Designed to handle longer rides and tougher terrain, it delivers advanced performance without compromising on control or ride quality.

 

Key Features:

 

  • GlideMotion dual suspension system
  • Active Steering Stabilisation

Go beyond the everyday

The Air⁵ Ultra Suspension is Pure Electric’s most capable e-scooter to date: built for long-distance riders, weekend explorers, and anyone who wants a smoother, more confident ride across all kinds of terrain. With best-in-class power and long-range capability, it’s ready to take on more than just the daily commute.

 

Climbing steep hills, crossing town, or heading off the beaten path? Whatever it is, the Air⁵ Ultra Suspension delivers serious performance and comfort. 

 

Powered by a 500W motor, the Pure Air⁵ Ultra delivers:

 

  • 1201W of peak power
  • A 19% maximum hill-climbing ability
  • Up to 93.8 KMS of range per charge

From its dual suspension to its powerful motor and improved steering control, every detail is there to make long journeys feel effortless.

Long-distance, high-power

Equipped with a high-capacity battery, the Air⁵ Ultra Suspension offers up to 93.8 KM on a single charge so you can explore further, worry-free. And with a peak power output of 1201W, this scooter handles hills and all the difficult roads in your route.

Next-level comfort and control

At the core of the Ultra is Pure’s GlideMotion suspension system: front telescopic forks and rear twin shock absorbers that absorb uneven surfaces and reduce vibration. Whether it’s cobblestones, curbs, or potholes, the Ultra smooths out the ride so you stay comfortable and in control.

Confident handling, wherever you go

Steering feels more precise thanks to built-in Active Steering Stabilisation, Pure's anti-wobble tech that centres your handlebars after you turn to keep you balanced and steady. Paired with 10” grippy tyres and a sturdy steel frame, the Air⁵ Ultra Suspension is built for real-world roads and everyday adventure.

Ready for all-weather rides

With an IP65 water resistance rating, this scooter is prepared for unexpected showers and wet surfaces. Combined with bright lighting, indicators, full reflectors, and durable construction, it’s a ride you can trust, rain or shine.

Designed to do more

The Pure Air⁵ Ultra Suspension brings together power, comfort, and endurance in one sleek package. With dual suspension, complete safety features, and stabilisation tech, there is nothing this e-scooter cannot do.

DESCRIPTION

Pure Electric’s Air line, now with suspension. The new Pure Air⁵ Pro+ Suspension is engineered to take on everyday roads while providing a smoother-than-ever ride. Say hello to a smoother ride!

The Pure Air scooter range has always stood out for its sleek design and user-friendly handling, perfect for gliding over smooth city streets. But until now, one thing was missing: suspension. 

 

Well, you asked, and Pure Electric delivered. The new Pure Air⁵ Pro+ is here and introduces a precision-engineered dual suspension system that transforms the way you ride.

 

Powered by a 350W motor, the Pure Air⁵ Pro+ delivers:

 

  • 924W of peak power

City-ready performance

With a peak power of 924W and a top speed of 25 KPH, the Air⁵ Pro+ offers reliable performance across city terrain. It climbs hills up to 14% and delivers smooth acceleration every time.

Pure Electric has developed the GlideMotion system, which pairs front telescopic forks with twin adjustable rear shocks to help the scooter stay composed and responsive across a variety of road surfaces. You can also adjust the rear suspension to better match your weight or riding preferences.

Solid where it counts

From its steel frame to its dependable folding design, every detail of the Air⁵ Pro+ is made for daily use. With no app gimmicks or flashy extras, this is a ride built for people who value comfort, reliability, and control.

Ready to roll

The Pure Air⁵ Pro+ Suspension redefines what an everyday scooter can be: smooth, capable, and ready for whatever’s ahead.

title: Aventon Aventure 3 Off-Road Step Over Electric Bike
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The next-gen Aventon Aventure 3 brings smarter tech, improved comfort, and better security. Now, it's easier than ever to venture out without losing the rugged performance the Aventure is known for.

 

Key Features for 2025:

 

  • Aventon Control Unit with 4G & GPS
  • Rear wheel lock and cross-model keyless battery
  • New suspension seatpost

Also available in Step-Through version

The All-New Aventure: Ready for anything, connected like never before

With the new Aventure 3, you aren’t just getting off the beaten path – you’re owning it. Thanks to fat tyres, a suspension fork, and now an added suspension seatpost, it soaks up rough ground so you can explore without hesitation.

 

Plus, built-in GPS tracking, 4G connectivity, and a new rear wheel lock ensure you’re in full control no matter where you go.

 

Equipped with a 250W motor, the Aventure 3 delivers:

 

  • 25 kph top speed
  • 80Nm of torque and 1188W peak power
  • Up to 104 kms on a single charge

No matter where you ride, the Aventure 3 is ready. 

All-terrain ability, now smarter

Aventon’s most rugged ebike now comes with bigger brains to match its brawn. The all-new Aventon Control Unit (ACU) lets you track your bike, get alerts if it’s moved, and even lock it down remotely all from your phone. 

 

Meanwhile, a cleaner, keyless battery setup allows cross-model compatibility. Now, your Aventure 3 battery will also work on the Abound SR, Abound LR, Level 3, and Pace 4.

New sensor switch

Get the best of both worlds with Aventon’s Sensor Switch. Toggle between Torque and Cadence sensor to match your riding style. Whether you prefer natural pedal power or smooth cruising, the choice is always yours.

Power where it counts

The 250W rear hub motor delivers 80Nm of torque and a peak output of 1188W – more than enough to conquer steep inclines and soft surfaces like sand or snow. Paired with Aventon’s efficient torque sensor, the ride feel is always natural and responsive.

 

When it comes to range, with the Aventure 3’s 733Wh battery, you’ll get up to 104 kilometres on a full charge – a full upgrade from the Aventure 2’s 96-km limit.

Upgraded for a better riding experience

A new suspension seatpost with 50mm of travel adds a noticeable boost in comfort over long or rugged rides. Combined with the existing 80mm fork and fat tyres, the Aventure 3 makes even the roughest tracks feel butter-smooth.

A customised ride with Ride Tune

Personalise your assist settings, torque response, and ride feel using the Aventon app. Whether you want snappy acceleration or a more laid-back cruise, Ride Tune lets you set your preferences and save them. 

 

And with over-the-air updates, your bike automatically upgrades – no trip to the shop required.

More than just tough – it’s safe

The Aventure 3 weighs in at 34.5 kg and is rated to carry up to 181 kg. It features integrated lights and hydraulic disc brakes, and includes fenders and a rear rack. Built to IPX5 water-resistance standards, it’s fine in light rain or wet trails.

Aventure 3 vs Aventure 2: What’s changed?

The Aventure 2 brought impressive range and performance to the trail, but the Aventure 3 takes things further. Upgrades include:

 

  • Bigger battery (733Wh vs 720Wh)
  • Smarter security (GPS, alerts, app-based lock)
  • More comfort (added suspension seatpost)
  • A keyless battery system shared across models

The All-New Aventure: Ready for anything, connected like never before

With the new Aventure 3, you aren’t just getting off the beaten path – you’re owning it. Thanks to fat tyres, a suspension fork, and now an added suspension seatpost, it soaks up rough ground so you can explore without hesitation.

 

Plus, built-in GPS tracking, 4G connectivity, and a new rear wheel lock ensure you’re in full control no matter where you go.

 

Equipped with a 250W motor, the Aventure 3 delivers:

 

  • 25 kph top speed
  • 80Nm of torque and 1188W peak power
  • Up to 104 kms on a single charge

No matter where you ride, the Aventure 3 is ready. 

All-terrain ability, now smarter

Aventon’s most rugged ebike now comes with bigger brains to match its brawn. The all-new Aventon Control Unit (ACU) lets you track your bike, get alerts if it’s moved, and even lock it down remotely all from your phone. 

 

Meanwhile, a cleaner, keyless battery setup allows cross-model compatibility. Now, your Aventure 3 battery will also work on the Abound SR, Abound LR, Level 3, and Pace 4.

Power where it counts

The 250W rear hub motor delivers 80Nm of torque and a peak output of 1188W – more than enough to conquer steep inclines and soft surfaces like sand or snow. Paired with Aventon’s efficient torque sensor, the ride feel is always natural and responsive.

 

When it comes to range, with the Aventure 3’s 733Wh battery, you’ll get up to 104 kilometres on a full charge – a full upgrade from the Aventure 2’s 96-km limit.

New sensor switch

Get the best of both worlds with Aventon’s Sensor Switch. Toggle between Torque and Cadence sensor to match your riding style. Whether you prefer natural pedal power or smooth cruising, the choice is always yours.

Upgraded for a better riding experience

A new suspension seatpost with 50mm of travel adds a noticeable boost in comfort over long or rugged rides. Combined with the existing 80mm fork and fat tyres, the Aventure 3 makes even the roughest tracks feel butter-smooth.

A customised ride with Ride Tune

Personalise your assist settings, torque response, and ride feel using the Aventon app. Whether you want snappy acceleration or a more laid-back cruise, Ride Tune lets you set your preferences and save them. 

 

And with over-the-air updates, your bike automatically upgrades – no trip to the shop required.

More than just tough – it’s safe

The Aventure 3 weighs in at 34.5 kg and is rated to carry up to 181 kg. It features integrated lights and hydraulic disc brakes, and includes fenders and a rear rack. Built to IPX5 water-resistance standards, it’s fine in light rain or wet trails.

Aventure 3 vs Aventure 2: What’s changed?

The Aventure 2 brought impressive range and performance to the trail, but the Aventure 3 takes things further. Upgrades include:

 

  • Bigger battery (733Wh vs 720Wh)
  • Higher peak power (1188W vs 1130W)
  • Smarter security (GPS, alerts, app-based lock)
  • More comfort (added suspension seatpost)

title: Pure Air⁵ Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Pure Air⁵ Pro builds on the trusted design of the Pure Air series, adding more range and comfort for everyday riders. It's made for those who rely on their scooter day in, day out – and want a little extra from every charge.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Extended 66.3-KM range
  • Upgraded 840W motor
  • Dual braking system
  • IP65 water-resistance rating

Embrace the Ride with the Pure Air⁵

Pure Electric raises the bar again with the Pure Air⁵ Pro – a next-gen city scooter built for those who need more from their everyday ride. With an upgraded range and the same dependable performance, it’s designed to keep pace with life in motion.

 

Its clean, modern design makes it a natural fit for daily travel, while the improved battery power means you can go further with fewer stops. From morning commutes to weekend plans, it’s a smooth, capable ride you can count on.

 

Equipped with a 350W motor, the Pure Air⁵ Pro delivers:

 

  • 840W of peak power
  • 14% maximum hill-climbing capability
  • Up to 66.3 KMS of range per charge

More Distance, Less Effort

The Pure Air⁵ Pro is made to go the extra distance. With a bigger battery fitted into its sleek and lightweight frame, it’s ideal for longer rides across town or fewer top-ups between trips.

 

The 840W peak motor gives you strong acceleration when you need it, while the 9.6Ah battery extends your range to up to 66.3km on one charge. It’s smooth, responsive, and made to move with your day.

City Riding, Made Comfortable

Whether you're navigating potholes or cruising down smoother paths, the large 10” tubeless tyres absorb bumps and vibrations from the road. They're also resistant to punctures, which gives you more peace of mind on busy streets.

 

The braking system includes a low-maintenance front drum brake and a regenerative rear KERS brake, so you’re in control at every stop.

Portable and Ready for Any Weather

No need to park your scooter when the rain starts. The Pure Air⁵ Pro is IP65-rated to handle splashes and showers with no risk of water damage. 

 

Weighing just 17.2kg, it’s still easy to carry and store when you’re off the road. Then, when you arrive, it folds down fast using the secure click-lock mechanism.

Smarter Ride, Right at Your Fingertips

A clear LCD display keeps key riding info in sight: speed, battery level, riding mode and alerts. Need more control? Connect to the Pure app to track your journeys and monitor performance over time.

Your packaging might show older range or power figures. The scooter hasn't changed — we've just updated how we measure performance.

1 Max. one-charge range:

Tested at Evesham VeloPark in the UK, summer 2025 we achieved a range of 66.3km. Tested under these conditions: Ambient temperature of 26°C +/-6°C ridden on a flat, level asphalt surface, on a closed loop circuit. Wind conditions <7m/s, ridden at a constant speed of 15km/h maintained with cruise control, total rider weight 75kg (+/-5kg). The tyres were inflated to the maximum pressure stated on the tyre. The scooter was set to ECO mode and the headlight turned off.

2 Max. power:

The max motor power is determined by multiplying the full state of charge battery voltage of 42V by the maximum motor input current of 20A. 840W

title: Aventon Pace 4 Step Through Electric Bike
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Meet the Aventon Pace 4: your new go-to for relaxed city rides, scenic weekend loops, and afternoon cruises through the neighbourhood. Upgraded to boast improved connectivity, better comfort, and enhanced security, this new generation cruiser delivers more freedom and peace of mind – all without losing the casual vibe that made the Pace a favourite.

 

Key Features for 2025:

 

  • Aventon Control Unit with 4G connectivity
  • Electronic rear wheel lock and keyless battery
  • Integrated suspension seatpost

The All-New Pace: Familiar, Comfortable Feel With Upgraded Features

Cruise your way with the all-new Pace 4, Aventon’s most advanced and connected cruiser yet. Built for commutes, daily errands, and laid-back rides, it blends easygoing style with practical upgrades that make every trip smoother and more secure.

 

With the new Aventon Control Unit (ACU) onboard, you get built-in GPS tracking, 4G connection, remote locking, and movement alerts – all controlled from your phone. The same upright frame geometry works with the new suspension seatpost to keep things relaxed, while the new long-range battery gives you even more mileage.

 

Equipped with a 500W motor, the Pace 4 delivers:

 

  • 25 kph (45 kph off-road use)
  • 60Nm of torque and 864W peak power
  • Up to 112 kms on a single charge

 

Whether you're cruising the boardwalk or rolling through town, the Pace 4 keeps it easy. Just hop on and enjoy the ride.

Easygoing meets high-tech

The Pace 4 upgrades casual cruising and makes it even better with intelligent features. With Aventon’s new Control Unit (ACU), you're always connected to your bike. GPS tracking and 4G keep your ride in sight, even when you’re not around. Lock it remotely, set geofencing limits, and customise a passcode to protect your bike. 

New sensor switch

Get the best of both worlds with Aventon’s Sensor Switch. Toggle between Torque and Cadence sensor to match your riding style. Whether you prefer natural pedal power or smooth cruising, the choice is always yours.

Cruise – even more comfortably

The Pace 4 keeps things smooth thanks to a new suspension seatpost with adjustable preload that allows you to adjust the level of bump absorption that you need. In addition, ergonomic grips, a relaxed riding position, and BMX-style handlebars make long rides feel effortless.

 

While the Pace line has always been known for comfort, the Pace 4 introduces more customisation options and refined geometry for better fit and posture on the go.

Responsive power with a natural feel

Powered by a 500W motor with 60Nm of torque and a new, bigger 733Wh battery, the Pace 4 lets you go farther – up to 112 kilometres per charge. That’s a noticeable jump from the Pace 500.3’s 614Wh battery and max 96 km range. 

 

Meanwhile, Aventon’s torque sensor technology reacts intuitively to your pedaling, delivering smooth, natural assist at all three customisable levels.

Smarter security, less worry

Unlike older models, the Pace 4 features a built-in rear wheel lock, unusual movement alerts, and a completely keyless battery system. With a few taps in the Aventon app, your ride is locked down and monitored, whether you’re parked at the café or out running errands.

Stay in tune with your ride

With Ride Tune, you can adjust the bike through the app to match how you ride, whether you want max efficiency or a more relaxed ride. And with over-the-air software updates, you don’t have to go to the shop to keep your bike up to speed.

Made for your pace

Weighing just 26 kg and rated to carry up to 136 kg, the Pace 4 is light, stable, and suitable for riders from 4’11” to 6’1” ( 150 cm to 185 cm). The bike is equipped with 27.5" tyres and includes front and rear integrated lights, hydraulic disc brakes, and a removable battery. Water-resistant to IPX5, it’s built to handle the elements and keep going.

Pace 4 vs. Pace 500.3: What’s better?

While the Pace 500.3 offered solid range and dependable power, the Pace 4 takes it a step further with a larger battery (733Wh vs. 614Wh), advanced security features thanks to the new ACU, and the addition of a suspension seatpost that smooths out rough road.

TECHNICAL OVERVIEW

The Pace 4 ships as a Class II ebike, with pedal assist and throttle. The Pace will also operate with the throttle unplugged and removed, should you want to ride in an area that only allows Class I ebike or throttles are prohibited. Aventon ebikes are built to the IPX5-rated standard. An IPX5 rating means the bike is protected against low-pressure water jets from any direction. This provides a moderate level of water resistance, allowing you to ride in light to moderate rain or through small puddles. However, IPX5 does not mean waterproof—Aventon ebikes are not designed for full submersion. Avoid using a pressure washer or high-pressure sprayer to clean your ebike, as pressurized water can still damage components.

title: Kaabo Mantis Urban (2026) Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Designed for commutes and city rides, the Kaabo Mantis Urban is the most compact and lightweight model in the Mantis lineup. At just 20 KG, it's easy to carry, quick to fold, and built to move with you, whether you're hopping on a train or navigating busy sidewalks.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Mechanical Disc Brakes + EABS
  • Front and Rear Adjustable Spring Suspension
  • Embedded display with NFC

Amazing Performance in Compact Form

The Kaabo Mantis Urban is built for city living: compact, lightweight, and easy to manoeuvre. Weighing just 20 KG, it’s the most portable model in the Mantis lineup so it’s perfect for short commutes, quick errands, and easy storage.

 

But don’t be fooled by its size. Beneath the portable frame is a powerful motor that reaches high speeds and handles steep inclines, as well as an efficient battery that delivers an extended range per charge. The Kaabo Mantis Urban is, indeed, the ideal electric scooter for daily urban travel.

Power for Everyday Riders

The Mantis Urban comes equipped with a 500W motor (900W peak), which offers more than enough torque to handle slopes up to 20° and a top speed of up to 40 KPH (on private property). Meanwhile, a 48V 10.4Ah battery will get you up to 40 KM on a single charge – ideal for daily commuting or quick errands around town.

Smooth Handling on City Streets

An adjustable front and rear spring suspension system efficiently absorbs everyday road bumps and vibrations. Combined with 8.5-inch tubeless pneumatic tyres, the ride stays stable and comfortable, even on older pavement or uneven surfaces.

Responsive Braking System

The Mantis Urban features mechanical disc brakes paired with an EABS system, which offer reliable stopping power while reducing wear on key components. Whether you're slowing down in traffic or stopping on a hill, the brakes respond quickly and smoothly.

Built-In Display with NFC

The ultra-bright embedded display shows everything you need at a glance – speed, battery, distance, and more. Unlock your scooter securely and effortlessly using NFC tags for quick access and added peace of mind.

Complete Lighting System

Front and rear LED lights illuminate your path and improve your visibility, while brand new bar-end turn indicators allow you to communicate with fellow road users. Side reflectors add another layer of safety and ensure you're seen from all angles.

Style Meets Function

Available in black, blue, yellow, and green, the Mantis Urban adds personality to your daily ride. Choose the colour that fits your style and stand out wherever your commute takes you.

Kaabo Mantis Urban: Go Light, Go Smart

The Kaabo Mantis Urban is your go-to for everyday riding: lightweight, portable, and smartly equipped. Whether you're a student, commuter, or just need a reliable way to get around, this scooter makes short-distance travel simple and fun.

Integrated lights for visibility

Why choose Inokim?

 

As a global leader in the industry, Inokim has earned acclaim for innovative and long-lasting electric scooters for adults. From commuters to off-roaders, Inokim has something for you.

 

Indeed, anyone looking for a powerful yet ultra-portable commuter scooter should not overlook the Light 2 MAX.

title: Aventon Abound LR Electric Cargo Bike (2026)
body_html:
Description

The Abound LR is the ultimate cargo e-bike, designed to handle heavy loads while keeping comfort and control at the forefront. With a powerful motor, a sturdy frame, and an extended rear rack, this bike is ready for anything – whether it’s a grocery run, a family outing, or hauling gear for your next adventure.

 

Key Features:

 

  • Aventon Control Unit (ACU) with 4G and GPS connectivity
  • Suspension seatpost and front suspension
  • Spacious rear rack 

Built for Big Loads and Bigger Adventures

Meet the new Abound LR: a reliable and powerful electric bike designed to make your everyday journeys easier. Whether you're commuting, running errands, or just enjoying the ride, the Abound LR delivers efficiency, comfort, and versatility.

 

Equipped with a robust 250W motor, the Abound LR delivers:

 

  • 25 KPH top speed
  • 80Nm of motor torque and 1188W peak power
  • Up to 97 KMS on a single charge

The Abound LR is built to carry cargo and passengers, effortlessly traverse various terrains, and keep you in control at all times.

Abound LR vs. Abound SR: Which One is Right for You?

Both models have the same 200-KG payload capacity, but the Abound LR features a rear rack that is 18 cm longer than the SR, which makes it better suited for carrying bulkier cargo or two passengers. The LR is also 3.6 kg heavier. 

 

If you need more cargo space, the LR is the better choice. On the other hand, the SR offers a more compact design for easier storage and maneuverability.

Ready for Cargo and Passengers

The Abound LR is designed to carry heavy loads, thanks to its long rear rack and an impressive 200 KG total payload capacity, including 64 KG of rear rack capacity. Whether you're carrying groceries, work equipment, or a passenger, this bike is built to handle it all without sacrificing stability or power.

 

For added convenience, a lockable storage bag provides a secure space to store valuables on the go. With a custom three-digit combination lock, you can safely store your essentials while riding or parked.

Enhanced Security with the Aventon Control Unit (ACU)

The Abound LR features the new Aventon Control Unit (ACU), a next-generation security and connectivity system designed to keep your bike protected and you in control.

 

With GPS tracking, 4G connectivity, remote locking, and geofencing, the ACU allows you to track and secure your bike from anywhere. Additional security measures include a passcode protection, an integrated alarm system, and an e-lock kickstand, all ensuring your bike stays safeguarded even when powered off.

 

Through the Aventon app, you can monitor real-time location, check battery status, and adjust motor settings for a personalised riding experience.

New sensor switch

Get the best of both worlds with Aventon’s Sensor Switch. Toggle between Torque and Cadence sensor to match your riding style. Whether you prefer natural pedal power or smooth cruising, the choice is always yours.

Your Comfort and Safety, a Priority

The Abound LR features a gravity-cast frame, adjustable quill stem, front suspension, and a suspension seatpost, which help deliver a comfortable and confident ride, no matter the terrain. The suspension system absorbs shocks from bumps and rough roads, making long rides smoother and reducing fatigue for the rider.

 

An ergonomic handlebar placement makes the Abound LR comfortable for long rides. The step-through frame ensures easy access, while bright LED lighting enhances visibility for safer travel, day or night.

 

Meanwhile, the bike’s responsive hydraulic disc brakes provide confident stopping power, and an intuitive LCD display keeps essential ride information at your fingertips.

Effortless Riding, Customised to You

Adapt your ride with multiple assist levels with Ride Tune, which let you balance power and efficiency based on your needs. Whether you're cruising through city streets or tackling hills, the Abound LR delivers consistent and smooth acceleration.

Experience the Abound LR Difference

The Abound LR combines performance with practical features – perfect for riders who value reliability and ease of use. From daily commutes to weekend adventures, this electric bike makes every ride enjoyable, efficient, and worry-free.

TECHNICAL OVERVIEW

Aventon ebikes are built to the IPX6-rated standard. An IPX6 rating means the bike is protected against high-pressure water streams from any angle. This provides strong water resistance, so you can confidently ride in heavy rain or through puddles and mud. However, IPX6 does not mean waterproof—Aventon ebikes are not designed for full submersion. body_html:
Take your commutes to the next level… introducing the Aventon Level 3! Now featuring the new Aventon Control Unit (ACU) with 4G connection, a keyless battery, Remote Lock, Geofencing, a passcode, more power and a longer range, your ride is smarter and more secure than ever. 

Key Features for 2025:

  • Aventon Control Unit with 4G connectivity
  • Front suspension fork and suspension post
  • Remote Lock, Geofencing and Passcode

Also available in Step Over version

DESCRIPTION

Level Up: Aventon’s Premium Commuter Now Smarter, Stronger, and More Secure

Experience the next level in commuting with the new Level 3, Aventon’s most powerful commuter e-bike yet that’s here to make your rides easier, safer, and more comfortable than ever.

 

Now equipped with ACU technology, the Level 3 offers 4G connectivity, GPS tracking, auto-lock, unusual movement detection, and an alarm system for advanced security. A front suspension fork and suspension seat post smooth out rough terrain, while an adjustable stem and comfortable geometry ensure the perfect fit.

 

With its 500W motor, the Aventon Level 3 can achieve:

 

  • 25 kph top speed (45 kph off-road use)
  • 60Nm of torque and 864W peak power
  • 112 kilometres on a single charge

Look no further if you want a powerful e-bike that handles your commute and does more. Trade traffic for freedom: the Aventon Level 3 is built for any ride.

New ACU with advanced anti-theft features 

The new Aventon Control Unit (ACU) brings next-level protection and connectivity to your ride. With GPS tracking, 4G connection, and cloud sync, you can monitor your bike in real time, wherever you are.

 

You can lock your bike instantly from the Aventon app with Remote Lock, or set custom Geofencing zones to receive alerts if your Level 3 moves beyond a defined area. Features like auto-lock, unusual movement detection, and an alarm system add extra protection to make sure your bike stays safe when you’re not around.

 

Furthermore, you can set a custom passcode with up to six inputs for extra security. Plus, the new Keyless Battery means one less key to carry — just hop on and go. Finally, you can also activate the built-in rear wheel lock to prevent movement when parked.

 

With the smart ACU, your Level 3 is always connected, always protected.

New sensor switch

Get the best of both worlds with Aventon’s Sensor Switch. Toggle between Torque and Cadence sensor to match your riding style. Whether you prefer natural pedal power or smooth cruising, the choice is always yours.

More power, better performance

Enjoy the same top speeds you’re used to: 25 kph on city streets and up to 45 kph with pedal assist off the road. 

 

The Level 3 keeps the reliable 500W rear hub motor from its predecessor but now delivers a higher peak power of 864W – up from 750W on the Level 2. This boost makes it one of the most powerful e-bikes in the Aventon lineup that can deliver strong performance on any route.

Longer range for rides that suit you

The Aventon Level 3 features a 733Wh battery, bigger than the Level 2’s 672Wh battery. This, plus the smarter power management and refined motor tuning, extends your range up to 112 KMS – an improvement from its predecessor’s 97 KM range. 

 

Furthermore, aside from getting you up to 16 extra kilometres per charge, Aventon’s Ride Tune lets you fine-tune your bike’s performance, like adjusting your motor settings, so you can experience the full potential of your Level 3.

Ride comfortably, wherever you go

No matter the road or trail, the Level 3 can take it. A front suspension fork and suspension seat post absorb bumps and vibrations, making rough terrain feel smoother. 

 

On the other hand, its comfortable geometry and adjustable stem let you adjust your riding position for the perfect fit, so you can have a relaxed and enjoyable ride every time.

Ready for the ride

Just like the Level 2, the Level 3 also comes equipped with pre-installed fenders to keep you dry and clean, no matter the weather. A sturdy rear rack lets you effortlessly carry everything from work essentials to picnic supplies. Whether you're commuting or cruising, you’re ready to ride straight out of the box.

Go farther, ride smarter with the Aventon Level 3

With the new Level 3, every ride feels easier. A longer range, more power, intelligent security features, and a comfortable design make it the perfect companion for daily commutes or weekend adventures. Get where you need to go: no stress, just pure riding.
