title: Kaabo Wolf Warrior X Plus Electric Scooter (2026)
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Kaabo Wolf Warrior X Plus packs the power and performance of the Wolf series into a more compact, agile design. Built for stability no matter your speed, it delivers an adrenaline-filled ride with Kaabo’s signature quality and engineering.

 

Key Features:

 

  • New Kaabo Central Display
  • Front & Rear Full Hydraulic Disc Brakes
  • Front Hydraulic + Rear Spring Suspension
  • 10 x 3" Street Tyres

Kaabo Wolf Warrior X Plus: Compact, Capable, Unstoppable

Kaabo has built a reputation for delivering high-performance electric scooters that balance speed, control, and durability. The Wolf Warrior X Plus is no exception, bringing the signature Kaabo ride quality into a more compact and agile form. 

 

It carries all the hallmarks of Kaabo’s engineering: premium build quality, powerful dual motors, precise handling, excellent cornering, and advanced safety features. Designed for those who demand both power and maneuverability, this scooter offers an exhilarating yet stable ride on city streets and rugged paths alike.

New Display and Controllers

The Kaabo Wolf Warrior X Plus (2026) comes updated with Kaabo’s new central display, replacing the previous K1 display. The new 4-inch display boasts great visibility even in direct sunlight as well as a high IP67 water-resistance rating.

The 2026 model also features upgraded V2 60V 30A sine wave controllers that deliver smoother and more consistent power control.

Adjustable Suspension for a Smooth Ride

The Wolf Warrior X Plus introduces an adjustable rear suspension – an industry first for this class. 

 

Modelled after motorcycle-style shock absorbers, it allows you to adjust the damping with a simple twist, so you have the option of either a firm, responsive ride or a softer, cushioned feel. Bumps and rough patches disappear beneath you.

Advanced Safety Features for Confident Riding

Equipped with dual hydraulic brakes and an e-ABS (Electric Anti-lock Braking System) on the rear, the Wolf Warrior X Plus provides precise and reliable stopping power. 

 

On the other hand, the puncture-resistant tyres enhance grip, while the superior suspension keeps the wheels planted during emergency braking. No matter the conditions, you stay in control.

Exceptional Lighting for Night Riding

Kaabo has fitted the Wolf Warrior X Plus with an impressive lighting system to keep you safe and seen at all hours. For excellent visibility, it comes with a high-mounted dual LED headlight that illuminates up to 150m ahead and 40m on either side.

 

LED deck lights add both style and function, enhancing the scooter’s presence on the road. 

High-Powered Dual Motors and Long-Range Battery

This scooter is built for thrill-seekers who want both acceleration and control at their fingertips. With dual 1100W motors, the Wolf Warrior X Plus reaches speeds of up to 70 KPH on private property and carries its rider up hills of 32°.

 

Out of the box, however, the scooter is limited to a moderate speed of 25 KPH for safe commuting in the city. 

 

Furthermore, powered by a 60V 21Ah battery, the Wolf Warrior X Plus delivers up to 70 KMS of real-world range on a single charge. 

Premium, High-Quality Build

Crafted from aerospace-grade alloy, the frame is designed to withstand the demands of daily use and high-performance riding. With a maximum rider weight capacity of 120 KG, the Kaabo Wolf Warrior X Plus offers both strength and stability in a sleek, compact package.

Compact Yet Powerful

The Kaabo Wolf Warrior X Plus is built for riders who want the best of both worlds: high-end performance in a more nimble design. 

 

From its adjustable suspension and powerful dual motors to its long-range battery and advanced safety features, this scooter delivers a thrilling yet refined riding experience. If you want to push your limits, the Wolf Warrior X Plus is ready for the challenge.

FEATURES
  • New Kaabo central display
  • Upgraded sine wave controllers
  • Motorcycle-style front hydraulic shock absorbers
  • Finger throttle and three power modes
  • Dual hydraulic brakes and e-ABS
  • Puncture-resistant street tyres
  • Dual LED headlight
  • Built-in LED coloured deck lights
  • Aerospace-grade alloy chassis

title: Pure x McLaren 2025 Special Edition Electric Scooter
body_html:
Pure x McLaren. Precision + performance. Beyond the racetrack. 

Pure and McLaren have joined forces to brighten up city riding. Available in sleek Black, special edition MP4/4, and limited edition Chrome to accentuate its class-leading design and featuring the ultimate riding position, 62.4-kilometre range and 924W peak power, the Pure x McLaren is the ride of choice in the F1 paddock – and beyond.

Key Features

  • Front-facing position
  • Active Steering Stabilisation
  • Slimline folding design
DESCRIPTION

NOTE: Air pump NOT included

World-class racing meets world-class riding

The racing spirit of McLaren, now on two wheels. Finished in sleek Black, special edition MP4/4, and limited edition Chrome to accentuate its class-leading design, Pure x McLaren have joined forces to set a new standard for urban travel.

 

Three racing-inspired variants


Black: A sleek black finish that highlights the scooter’s sharp design. The Pure x McLaren Black is built for those who prefer understated performance on the track or the street.

 

Chrome (limited edition): A striking chrome edition that nods to McLaren Racing’s iconic legacy. Bold, bright, and unmistakably classic.

 

MP4/4 (special edition): Inspired by the legendary 1988 MP4/4, this edition captures the spirit of one of F1’s most dominant cars. A tribute to precision, speed, and racing history.

 

Ultimate riding position

 

Our new, unique riding position enables the rider to take a natural stance, with feet on either side of the chassis, delivering a more stable, controlled and safer ride. We’ve challenged the traditional approach to e-scooters so you can experience the smoothest ride yet.

 

70% more slimline

 

A slimline design with folding footpads and handlebars. It's 70% slimmer than traditional e-scooters to easily transport and fit into your hallways, taking up a minimal amount of space.

 

Active steering stabilisation

 

Our patented technology gently returns the handlebar to centre after turning. Reducing steering wobble and providing pure control at every corner, even over rough ground.

 

Our most powerful motor and longest range

 

A 924W peak motor power delivers rapid acceleration and easy hill climbing (up to 19%). Meanwhile, advanced battery technology provides 62.4 kilometres of range on one charge, so you can enjoy riding for longer.

 

Maximum visibility

 

Dynamic footpad and handlebar indicators ensure signalling is clear and visible. A bright 150-lumen headlight and upgraded rear brake light help you navigate confidently in all conditions.

 

10” puncture-resistant tyres

 

High-quality tubeless 10" tyres provide significant protection against punctures, without annoying inner tubes, all while giving you a smooth, safe and comfortable ride.

 

More features

title: Segway-Ninebot F3 Series
body_html:
The Segway Ninebot F3 and F3 Pro take the well-loved F Series to the next level with upgraded suspension, a more ergonomic design, and more. Built for everyday commuting, these models offer a smooth ride while staying true to Segway’s signature quality and style – all at an affordable price.

Key Features:

  • Front Hydraulic & Rear Elastomer Suspension
  • SegRide™ Stability Enhancement System
  • Segway AirLock, Apple Find My app
DESCRIPTION

Practical Meets Premium: The Next Generation F Series

Meet the all-new Segway Ninebot F3 series, the upgraded successors to the trusted F2 scooters. 

 

An excellent choice for daily commuters and city riders, they offer more power, better components, and smarter features for a smoother, more effortless ride. With the perfect balance of performance, style, and reliability, they deliver Segway’s signature quality at a price that makes premium riding more accessible.

 

With a 450W motor on the F3 and a 550W motor on the F3 Pro, the scooters can achieve:

 

  • 1000W peak power for the F3 and 1200W for the F3 Pro
  • 70 KM maximum range
  • 20% hill climb for the F3 and 24% for the F3 Pro


 

Take on the city with this powerful ride

 

The new Segway F3 series delivers strong, reliable power for city commuting and hilly streets. The F3 features a 1000W high-torque brushless motor and handles inclines up to 20%. For even more power, the F3 Pro boasts a more powerful 1200W motor, taking on slopes up to 24%. 

 

Both models ensure smooth acceleration and consistent speed, making every ride effortless and enjoyable.

 

Ride longer with SegRange™

 

The Ninebot F3 and F3 Pro keep you riding longer with Segway’s self-developed SegRange™ technology. A 477Wh battery delivers up to 70 KMS of range (50 KMS in sport mode) on a single charge. 

 

The battery also comes with an upgraded BMS 2.0 with 12 features, including overcharging protection, short circuit protection, overcurrent protection, and smart charge scheduling.

 

For covering even greater distances, an optional 460Wh external battery* adds up to 61 KMS of extra range. 

 

*Available for purchase starting Q3 2025.

 

Upgraded suspension and tyres for butter-smooth rides

 

Unlike the F2, which had no suspension, or the F2 Pro, which only had front suspension, the new F3 and F3 Pro scooters deliver better shock absorption for a steadier, more enjoyable commute.

 

With front hydraulic and rear elastomer suspension, the F3 scooters absorb bumps to make rough city streets feel smoother, keeping you comfortable even on brick paths or uneven pavement. 

 

On the other hand, Segway retains 10-inch tubeless self-sealing tyres on these models. These puncture-resistant tyres instantly seal small leaks so you can reduce the risk of flats and keep maintenance to a minimum.

 

Designed for maximum comfort and control

 

The Ninebot F3 and F3 Pro offer a spacious 180 × 510 mm footboard, giving you plenty of room for a secure stance. A sturdy magnesium alloy frame enhances stability, while the curved handlebar is angled for a natural grip. 

 

Shock-absorbing grips provide extra cushioning, so your hands stay comfortable even on longer rides. For effortless rides, a flexible multifunction button allows easy control without letting go of the handlebars.

 

Top-tier technology for stable rides

 

Expect nothing less than precise braking and superior stability from the F3 series. The F3 features a front disc brake and rear electronic brake, while the F3 Pro upgrades to dual disc brakes for faster, more reliable stopping power.

 

SegRide™ Stability Enhancement keeps the ride smooth at high speeds and on slippery roads, while an 80 mm trailing distance and tuned steering damping improve balance and control. The curved handlebar ensures a comfortable grip, and Segway’s TCS (Traction Control System) enhances skid resistance and prevents slips.

 

Brighter lights and tougher build

 

Both scooters feature a powerful 6W automatic headlight that adjusts to lighting conditions, which are thrice as bright as the previous series, with twice the illuminating distance. 

 

With an upgraded IPX6 water resistance rating (an improvement over the previous IPX5-rated models), the F3 series provides stronger protection against rain and water jets.

 

For added security, a dedicated front locking rim at the base of the stem is added so it’s easier for you to use chain or U-locks. 

 

Instant access, easy tracking

 

The F3 and F3 Pro come equipped with advanced features for added convenience and security. The AirLock system, which uses Bluetooth unlocking, allows your scooter to automatically unlock when you’re nearby. You can customise the unlocking distance through the Segway Mobility app.

 

For extra peace of mind, Apple Find My integration lets you track your scooter directly from your Apple devices. Simply activate it through the Segway Mobility app, and you’ll always know where your ride is when you need it.

 

Ride smarter with the new F3 series

 

The F3 and F3 Pro combine upgraded performance, comfort, and smart features for a smoother, more reliable ride. With enhanced suspension, powerful motors, advanced stability, and improved safety, they are here to redefine everyday commuting.

title: Segway Ninebot GT3 Series
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Designed for Ultimate Performance and Precision

Introducing the Segway GT3 – the super scooter redefined! This revolution forces you to rethink what you used to know about electric scooters by pushing the boundaries of speed, range, and cutting-edge technology. 

 

Built for those who demand power and precision, this next-generation ride delivers unmatched performance and control. With an ultra-long range and advanced stability system, it conquers any distance and terrain.

 

With a 700W motor for the GT3 and dual 1700W motors for the GT3 Pro, the GT3 series scooters can achieve:

 

  • 25 KPH (unlockable to 50 KPH top speed for the GT3 and 80 KPH for the GT3 Pro)
  • 73.4 KM range for the GT3 and 138 KMS for the GT3 Pro
  • 30% hill climb for the GT3 and 38% for the GT3 Pro

Be among the first to own the Segway GT3 in Australia. Pre-order now!

 

Unbelievable power and speed

 

A true super scooter, the Segway GT3 reaches incredible speeds of up to 50 KPH (unlocked for off-road use) with a powerful 700W motor (2400W peak) and handles inclines up to 30%.

 

Meanwhile, the GT3 Pro takes things up a notch with dual 1700W motors that produce a peak power of 2 x 3500W and a climbing capability of up to 38%.

 

For both scooters, the Ultra Boost Mode lets you accelerate from 0 to 48 KPH* in just 9.5 seconds for the GT3 and 3.9 seconds for the GT3 Pro. 

 

*top speed unlocked for private/off-road use

 

Range like no other

 

Go further on a single charge with the GT3, which offers a maximum range of 73.4 KMS or enjoy excellent long-range rides with the GT3 Pro, which covers up to 138 KMS.

 

Segway’s SegRange technology improves efficiency and optimises battery performance so you can keep going as the adventure requires. 

 

Dual hydraulic suspension

 

GT3’s dual hydraulic suspension system absorbs bumps and reduces impact to give you a smoother, more comfortable ride. With front and rear hydraulic shock absorbers, it responds instantly to uneven terrain and keeps you in control.

 

The GT3 Pro even features an adjustable front hydraulic system with 15 levels of stiffness. This lets you fine-tune your ride for comfort or precision, depending on the terrain. 

 

Built to excel off-road

 

Equipped with the SegRide Stability Enhancement System, the GT3 ensures better control at high speeds and during sharp turns. Its 11-inch self-sealing tyres offer solid traction on all terrains so you can have smooth, stable rides in various conditions.

 

The GT3 Pro features the same SegRide Stability Enhancement System and 11-inch tubeless self-sealing offroad tyres. Furthermore, advanced features like SDTC 2.0 for skid resistance and the S-ABS system for safer stops ensure maximum stability and control, whether on wet roads or slick surfaces.

 

Ride through wind and rain

 

Both the GT3 and GT3 Pro come with an IPX6 water resistance rating, which means you can ride confidently in slightly wet conditions without worrying about damage. 

 

Whether it’s light rain or puddles, these models are designed to handle moisture without affecting performance, so you can keep going no matter the weather.

 

State-of-the-art security and technology

 

Both super scooters are compatible with Apple’s "Find My" app, so you can easily track the location of your ride anytime. Simply check the app on your iPhone to know where your scooter is.

 

Additionally, both models feature AirLock, Segway’s Bluetooth unlocking technology. With this feature, the scooter automatically unlocks when you’re nearby, so you’re ready to ride as you approach. You can activate this feature and personalise unlocking distance using the Segway Mobility app.

 

The future of riding is here

 

Transform the way you ride with the GT3 Series super scooters and experience the next evolution of electric scooters! Don’t miss the chance to ride the Segway GT3 or the Segway GT3 Pro and enjoy a ride where cutting-edge technology meets pure exhilaration.

title: Altis Sigma Electric Dirt Bike
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Your Next-Level Off-Road Adventure Awaits

Get ready to take on the trails with the Altis Sigma, the electric dirt bike designed for riders who demand more!

 

If racing through rugged trails sounds like your idea of fun, this bike delivers the power and control you need. Plus, it’s packed with premium features that make off-roading more fun and accessible than ever.

 

With its 98V Hairpin motor, the Altis Sigma can achieve:

 

  • 72 Nm of torque
  • 113 kph top speed
  • 80 kilometres on a single charge

Don’t just ride–dominate the trail. It’s time to test your limits with the Altis Sigma.

 

First 98V electric dirt bike on the market

 

The Altis Sigma isn’t just another electric ride—it sets a new standard in the industry as the first 98V electric dirt bike. Its advanced hairpin motor delivers an impressive 22.5 kW of peak power and 72 Nm of torque, which gives you the muscle to tackle steep hills and rugged trails. 

 

Paired with the Altis PowerPack, a high-capacity lithium-ion battery, you’ll enjoy extended rides and quick charging (zero to 80% in just two hours).

 

Incredible raw power and speed
 

Looking for serious power and performance on tough terrain? The Altis Sigma boasts 22.5KW of power that delivers enough torque and speed to handle steep climbs and rugged trails. 

 

On the other hand, the 39T sprocket strikes a great balance, letting you pick up speed while keeping enough torque for stunts and sharp turns. It’s built to handle whatever the trail throws at you.

 

Off-road ready, anytime

 

Ready for the trails right out of the box, the Altis Sigma comes with durable off-road tyres that offer great traction on any terrain. 

 

Meanwhile, its lightweight aluminium alloy frame is strong and stable, designed to handle rugged conditions without sacrificing agility. With 300 mm of ground clearance and responsive suspension, you’ll glide over obstacles and rough terrain easily.

 

Maximum control and comfort

 

Featuring premium brakes, advanced suspension, and a stable geometry, the Altis Sigma is clearly built for rugged outdoors.

 

Its adjustable air-spring suspension system absorbs shocks with 200 mm of front travel and 85 mm of rear travel, keeping you steady on jumps, bumps, and steep descents. You can also fine-tune the setup to match your riding preferences. 

 

The bike features 5 levels of regenerative braking, which provide reliable stopping power while returning energy to the battery. It also lets you adjust braking sensitivity for better control on steep hills or during rapid deceleration. 

 

The best price-to-voltage ratio

 

The Altis Sigma gives you more power and technology for your money compared to other electric dirt bikes in the same price range. With a better price-to-voltage ratio, it’s your best option if you’re looking for serious, unbeatable performance.

 

If value and capability are what you’re after, this bike delivers both.

 

Ready to hit the trails? 

 

The Altis Sigma has the power, design, and durability to handle whatever off-road adventures you’ve got in mind. This extraordinary bike is built to take your riding to the next level, whether you’re tackling steep hills, exploring rough trails, or just racing through the dirt.

 

With top-of-the-line components and impeccable off-road performance, it's the perfect companion for riders looking to push their limits.

Powerful Game-Worthy Performance

 

The Segway Go Kart Pro V2 was designed in tandem with a professional Go Kart racer, and its powerful performance is a true testament to that. Experience the thrills of high-speed riding with the incredible 1.02 G acceleration.

 

Its top-notch brushless motor allows you to zoom through the tracks and even go up hilly terrain of up to a 15° grade. Not to mention that this upgraded motor, paired with the high-grip front tyres and special TPE rear tyres, makes drifting like a pro easy! And if you're still building up your confidence, don't worry! The Segway Go Kart Pro has 4 driving modes that are perfect for any skill level.

 

Premium Racing Look

 

This GoKart features a design setup like supercars with its weight more on the rear than in front. It also has an aerodynamic rear wing which greatly contributes to the stable feel of your ride when you're going fast.

 

As for feeling like the ultimate racer? Well, you can enjoy the premium look and feel of metal pedals, a high-traction steering wheel, and the upgraded racing seat. Not to mention its immersive Bluetooth speaker which emulates fun and thrilling engine sounds for a more immersive experience.

Customisable Design

 

Finally, it’s easy to customise the Riptide 3 to suit your personal riding needs. The included rear cargo rack on the e-bike supports a variety of accessories from surf racks to child seats. 


Great for Every Journey

body_html:
We’re excited to bring you the Xafari, Segway’s new trekking e-bike that is perfectly suited for a variety of terrains. Its components ensure a stable ride with excellent grip, while the smart features bring intelligence to your outdoor explorations.

Key Features:

  • Full suspension system
  • Stepless gear regulation
  • 26 x 3-inch all-terrain tyres
DESCRIPTION

Engineered for the outdoors

The new Segway Xafari trekking electric bike combines thoughtful design with rugged engineering to comfortably handle diverse terrains. Thanks to all-terrain tyres, adaptable suspension, and smart features, you can enjoy stability and control on everything from neighbourhood paths to challenging trails.

 

With its 750W motor, the Segway Xafari achieves: 

 

  • A 50 KPH top speed (unlocked)
  • A 142 KM max range
  • A hill grade of up to 25%

 

By blending technology and durable components, you can expect smooth rides across various landscapes with the Segway Xafari.

 

Smart Power, Natural Feel

 

The Xafari’s robust 750W motor delivers 80Nm of torque and provides reliable assistance that helps you tackle hills and resist strong winds. Meanwhile, a stepless gear system adapts to your pedalling rhythm. 

 

Out of the box, the Xafari's top speed is set to 32 KPH. A special firmware update will be available at a later date that allows you to unlock a higher top speed. When unlocked, the Xafari will reach 50 KPH.

 

In addition, the Xafari is also fitted with a high-energy-density 936Wh battery that offers a good range for exciting outdoor rides.

 

Built for the Real World

 

Thanks to its 26 x 3-inch tyres, the Xafari creates maximum traction and stability on all surfaces. Working with the all-terrain wheel set is a full suspension system—with an 80mm front and 70mm rear wheel travel—that absorbs impacts from rough roads.

 

On the other hand, the trekking e-bike’s attractive yet ergonomic design takes centre stage in giving you a comfortable and easy-to-control ride. 

 

Technology that Matters

 

The Xafari’s smart and adaptive technology enhances your ride. For starters, the headlights intelligently adjust to riding conditions, while proximity sensors automatically lock and unlock your e-bike as you approach or leave. 

 

Plus, a multi-functional dashboard gives you access to real-time updates on your riding speed and distance. It also serves as a navigation aide and a fitness tracker. 

 

Advanced Security and Tracking

 

Your Xafari trekking e-bike is protected by a comprehensive security system. Thanks to Segway AirLock, motion detection alerts, and tracking through Apple Find My and GPS Dual Module Tracking, you can easily locate, monitor, and secure your electric bike.

 

Discover New Paths with the Segway Xafari


With advanced technology, state-of-the-art components, and a sleek and stylish design that’s comfortable at the same time, the Segway Xafari is reliably built for every adventure.

title: Segway Ninebot ZT3 Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Ride fearlessly into your next adventure

Engineered for easy rides whether on city streets or challenging terrain, the Segway ZT3 Pro combines reliable Segway components with new state-of-the-art technology. With breathtaking speeds, extended range, excellent off-road capabilities, and modern functionality, there’s virtually nothing this e-scooter can’t do.

 

With its 650W motor, the ZT3 Pro achieves: 

 

  • 1600W of peak power
  • 25 KPH top speed (Unlockable to 40 KPH on private roads)
  • 60-KM max range
  • Hill grade of up to 25%

Everything about the ZT3 Pro says high-performance, from its 11-inch off-road tyres and dual suspension system to smart features like Airlock, Apple Find My, and SegRide stability system. 

 

Excellence on any terrain

 

Ride confidently, wherever you may go, with the new Segway ZT3 Pro. Equipped with a dual suspension system—front telescopic suspension + rear spring suspension—it delivers a smooth and bump-free ride on rough roads.

 

Meanwhile, the 11-inch off-road tubeless tyres provide solid support and 10% more grip. Plus, an impressive 6-inch clearance ensures you can easily navigate obstacles and uneven ground.

 

But beyond these components, it’s the technology that makes the ZT3 Pro a superb off-road ride. The Segride Stability Enhancement System delivers better control, which results in smoother handling even at high speeds, steadier turns, and stronger grip on any terrain.

 

Unmatched power and performance

 

The Segway ZT3 Pro’s 650W high-torque brushless motor delivers 1600W maximum power output and a swift 25-KPH top speed (unlockable to 40 KPH). Thanks to this motor, you can also enjoy thrilling rides and conquer slopes with a climb angle of up to 25%.

 

With 5,000 kilometres of human-piloted road tests and over 180 quality tests demonstrating its robust quality, the ZT3 Pro’s power gives you the freedom to explore challenging landscapes without slowing down.

 

Enhanced range and BMS

 

Segway-Ninebot's RideyLONG™ technology boosts the ZT3 Pro's standard range by 20%, which allows for longer rides. 

 

But it’s not just about range—the IP7 water-resistant battery pack boasts an upgraded Battery Management System (BMS 2.0), which adds these new features alongside existing protections:

 

  • Easy monitoring of charge time
  • Scheduling of charging during low-cost hours
  • Battery lifecycle and health monitoring

On the other hand, the brand’s self-developed 2x Flash Charge Technology allows you to ride up to 10 kilometres at 15 KPH after a quick 30-minute charge, with a full charge time of approximately four hours.

 

Best-in-class safety features

 

Using proprietary algorithms, the Segway ZT3 Pro’s intelligent traction control system (TCS) enhances rear wheel stability and improves traction on slippery surfaces. Together with the e-scooter’s front and rear dual disc brakes, you are assured of a safe ride all the time.

 

The ZT3 Pro is equipped with a powerful 4W light that ensures you are visible from up to 39 meters away. Additionally, turning indicators and a distinctive “X” running light boost your presence on the road.

 

Furthermore, Segway now makes automatic locking and unlocking possible. With Segway AirLock, the e-scooter detects your distance and locks itself when you’re away. You can easily customise the locking distance through the Segway app.

 

Advanced technology integration

 

As with other Segway-Ninebot e-scooters, locating your Segway ZT3 Pro is a breeze with the Apple Find My network. Simply activate Apple Find My through the Segway-Ninebot app and pair it with your scooter. Then, you can easily track it down using the “Find My” app on your iPhone whenever you need to.

 

Meanwhile, the Segway-Ninebot app serves as your smart riding assistant. Available for both Android and Apple users, the app unlocks various features, like remotely locking and unlocking your e-scooter, switching riding modes, tracking your battery status, performing firmware updates, and more. 

 

The perfect companion for every adventure

 

The Segway ZT3 Pro combines advanced technology, exceptional features, and high-quality components to deliver amazing performance. Whether you're commuting through the city or exploring new trails, the ZT3 Pro is your ideal companion for every ride.

title: Segway Ninebot E2 PRO Electric Scooter
body_html:
The Segway E2 Pro is an excellent choice for reliable daily rides. As the top model of the E2 series, it features the strongest motor, largest tyres, and longest range in the lineup. Whether you’re commuting to work or riding for leisure, the Segway E2 Pro will exceed your expectations.

Key Features:

  • Air-Leakage-Proof tyres
  • Built-in indicators
  • Anti-Skid Traction Control System
  • Lightweight & Portable
DESCRIPTION

A smart and powerful everyday ride

With the highest power and longest range among the scooters in the popular Segway E2 series, the E2 Pro delivers smooth and excellent rides and state-of-the-art features—all at an incredibly affordable price point.

 

With its 350W motor, the E2 Pro achieves: 

 

  • 750W of peak power
  • A 25 kph top speed
  • A 40-km max range
  • A hill grade of up to 18%

Plus, Segway-Ninebot’s RideyLONG technology not only extends range but also improves your overall experience by making your rides smoother, quieter, and more efficient. 

 

Built to support weights of up to 120 kg, the Segway E2 Pro is well-designed with high-quality components. You may come across other electric scooters in the same price range, but the E2 Pro offers a sense of assurance that only comes with a proven track record and a trusted name.

 

City commutes simplified

 

Apart from its moderate specs—speed, range, and power—the Segway E2 Pro makes commutes more accessible through a user-friendly design.

 

With a simple and straightforward interface, all you need to do is press the power button to start your ride, activate the headlight, or select your preferred riding mode. This makes commuting a breeze.

 

That said, multiple riding modes are available for riders of different skill levels. The Eco Mode (E), which is perfect for new riders, limits the top speed to 15 kph, while the Sport Mode (S) achieves the advertised top speed of 25 kph.

 

On the other hand, maintain a moderate ride by choosing the Standard Mode (D), which maintains a 20-kph top speed. 

 

Stability on all types of urban terrain

 

The Segway E2 Pro excels on paved surfaces, like asphalt and tarmac roads. The 10-inch pneumatic tyres are described to be air-leakage-proof, so you don’t have to worry about constant maintenance or unexpected flats interrupting your ride.

 

The e-scooter is also equipped with a great braking system, complete with a front drum brake and an electronic rear brake. The result is superior yet stable stopping power, which allows you to quickly avoid obstacles without losing control of your ride. 

 

For smooth and confident rides, the Segway E2 Pro also features the brand’s anti-skid Traction Control System (TCS), which helps you maintain good handling on the scooter even in rougher road conditions. 

 

Lightweight and portable

 

Tipping the scales at only 18.8 kg, the Segway E2 Pro is one of the best options for lightweight travel, allowing you to effortlessly carry the scooter upstairs or onto various modes of public transportation such as buses or trains.

 

The slender frame also folds up for easy storage in limited spaces, whether it’s in your apartment or in the office building. 

 

Premium safety features

 

Even at this competitive price point, Segway has not compromised the most important safety features.

 

The integrated lighting system includes front and rear LED lights, along with indicator lights located at the ends of the handlebars. These turn signals also emit a loud beep when activated. 

 

Furthermore, the scooter includes a bell on the handlebars so you can alert other road users of your presence and riding intentions.

 

Cutting-edge technology

 

For optimal riding efficiency, the Segway E2 Pro includes a bright and crisp display that shows you important information, such as speed and battery, while you ride.

 

Just like any other Segway e-scooter, the E2 Pro is also paired with the app. When synchronised, the app gives you access to firmware updates and personal ride settings such as speed modes and travel routes. The app even allows you to reach a global community of riders. 

 

With the app, you can also place your scooter in “Guard Mode,” which secures the scooter by activating the electronic brake and locking the back tyre.

 

For further protection, use the scooter’s “Apply Find My” feature to remotely monitor and locate your Segway E2 Pro.

 

A top-tier ride for every rider

 

The Segway E2 Pro prioritises what matters most—a smooth, reliable ride with ample range and all the essential safety elements—and delivers all these at an attractive price point. Get where you need to be with confidence, every time, with the E2 Pro.

title: Kimi Kids Electric Scooter (2026 Version)
body_html:
Looking for a fun and safe way for your little one to experience the thrill of an electric scooter? Look no further than the Kimi Kids Electric Scooter! DESCRIPTION

Fun, Safe Scooting for Young Adventurers

The Kimi Kids Electric Scooter is the perfect way for your young adventurer to experience the thrill of electric riding in a safe and controlled environment.

The Kimi electric scooter is especially designed for riders ages 3 to 9* years old. It is packed with features and functionalities that ensure smooth, convenient, and enjoyable rides all the time.

Give your kids the gift of fun and safe adventures with this parent-approved ride!

*Kimi handlebars only go as high as 81 cm. If your child is on the taller or bigger side, we recommend getting the Segway C2 Pro.


TSA Approved - The Kimi scooters can travel on air planes. Travel to your destination and the kids can hit the ground riding!

Safe and Stable Design

The Kimi Kids Electric Scooter features a kid-friendly three-wheel design that’s ideal for young riders who are still trying to find their balance. Meanwhile, an 8-kph top speed allows your kids to ride safely and securely no matter where their adventures take them.

This kids’ electric scooter also features a thumb sensor, instead of a foot sensor, that safely provides a continuous electric boost.

And when the day is about to come to an end, you don’t need to worry because the electric scooter features a front LED light and LED-illuminated wheels, which keep your kids visible during low-light conditions.

Plus, it's UL-certified!

A Ride That Grows With Your Child

Kids don’t stay little for long, but the Kimi electric scooter has been thoughtfully designed to grow with your champ. Its handlebar adjusts to four different heights: 66 cm, 71 cm, 76 cm, and 81 cm.

Apart from years of enjoyment, the Kimi grants plenty of time for outdoor adventures. Equipped with a high-capacity battery, your child can explore up to 16 kilometres on a single charge!

Convenient and Parent-Approved

The Kimi kids scooter may have been designed for your kids, but it has not forgotten about your own convenience! A featherweight at only 4 kilograms, this foldable e-scooter is a breeze to carry around, transport, and store.

The compact and lightweight Kimi also comes fully assembled (with dimensions of 63.5 in length and 30 cm in height), so the Kimi is ready to ride!

Upping the Fun and Cool Factor

The Kimi Kids Electric Scooter isn’t just about safety and convenience—it’s about dazzling fun, too! The built-in lighting system keeps your child visible, while the light-up wheels add a cool factor that turns every ride into a mini light show.

Plus, with four vibrant colour options—pink, blue, yellow, and now red—the Kimi scooter is sure to grab attention wherever your child rides.

It definitely is the perfect gift for birthdays, holidays, or just because!

title: Aventon Ramblas Off-Road Electric Mountain Bike
body_html:
Set your inner adventurer free with the Aventon Ramblas. Conquer both mountain trails and city streets with the Ramblas' powerful mid-drive motor and comfortable hardtail design. Explore further and experience the thrill of the ride with three pedal-assist levels, a top speed of 45 kph (off-road use), and an impressive range of up to 145 kms. 

Key Features:

  • Intelligent 250W mid-drive motor
  • Sram NX 12-speed drivetrain for more efficient riding
  • Three adjustable pedal assist levels
    Description

    Unleash Your Inner Trailblazer

    Electric Kicks is proud to launch the Aventon Ramblas—the brand’s first electric mountain bike (eMTB) with an intelligent mid-drive motor. Sleek and powerful-looking, the Ramblas efficiently conquers any path, from heart-pounding trails to smooth city commutes.

    But power isn't everything, as the Aventon-designed mid-drive motor lets you personalise your ride. Adjust settings through the Aventon app for a truly customised experience that maximises both thrills and comfort.

    With its 250W motor, the Aventon Ramblas achieves:

     

    • 750W of peak power
    • 45 kph top speed (for off-road use)
    • Up to 145 kms on a single charge

    Thanks to a combination of customisation options and top-of-the-line components, the Aventon Ramblas transitions smoothly between mountain biking and urban riding.

    The Aventon Ramblas is available in four sizes: Small, Medium, Large, and Extra-Large.

    Power over any terrain

    The Ramblas is equipped with an A100 motor for smooth and controlled acceleration and deceleration, while its 100 Nm of torque helps you reach peak power as soon as you need it. Plus, a Sram NX 12-speed drivetrain allows you to follow mountain trails, scale hills, and ride faster on flat surfaces.

    On the other hand, Sram DB8 mineral 4 piston hydraulic disc brakes offer superior braking power, so you can stop whenever you need to.

    Full control over your ride

    Designed to give you full control, the Ramblas features three PAS (Pedal Assist System) levels: eco, trail, and turbo. With this in place, you can customise your ride, whether it’s for adventures or daily commutes.

    On top of that, the Aventon app's Ride Tune technology lets you fine-tune max torque and pedal response for a riding experience that’s truly yours.

    Comfort in every adventure

    The Aventon Ramblas’ reliable hardtail frame translates to easier manoeuvring and better climbing efficiency, especially on steep inclines. Paired with the bike’s suspension— Rockshox 35 suspension with 130mm of travel—no terrain is going to be too hard for the Ramblas.

    Plus, the Ramblas comes with a dropper post that you can adjust for control and comfort. Raise it for more efficient pedalling on flat sections, then lower it for better control and confidence when tackling steep or challenging terrain.

    Safety certification

    Like the rest of the Aventon range, the Ramblas is safety-certified in accordance with UL 2849 standards, ensuring it meets the industry's highest benchmarks for electrical safety and component reliability.

    On the other hand, its IPX6 water-resistance rating means you can cross creeks and ride in the rain without worry.

     

    The mountains or the city, the choice is yours.

    The Aventon Ramblas adapts to every ride. With its powerful motor, customisable settings, and robust components, it's the ultimate electric mountain bike for every adventure. Take control and start your next adventure today with Electric Kicks.

title: Kaabo Wolf King GTR Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The reign of the king continues with the return of the Kaabo Wolf King GTR. Engineered to dominate the streets, the high-performance electric scooter boasts superior power and performance from dual 2000W motors, extended range thanks to its new detachable battery, upgraded suspension and tyres, and more. 

 

Key Features:

 

  • Dual 2000W BLDC hub motors
  • New detachable 72V battery
  • Front hydraulic + rear spring suspension
  • Front + rear hydraulic brakes

Kaabo Wolf King GTR: Engineered for the Extreme

There are very few electric scooters that have attained the Kaabo Wolf King GTR's royalty status. Unleashing power and speed for seasoned riders, the Wolf King GTR is a high-performance beast built to conquer even the most demanding terrains.

Its supreme reign isn’t without reason. The Kaabo Wolf King GTR boasts a fearsome combination of hair-raising top speed and impressive range, both controlled by hydraulic brakes. Meanwhile, a dual-suspension system ensures a smooth and comfortable ride, even when you are pushing the limits.

High-Efficiency Separable Motor

The Kaabo Wolf King GTR features a detachable motor that makes maintenance and tyre changes simpler. At the same time, the high-efficiency motor boasts increased power and carrying capacity thanks to its larger diameter (6.5 to 7 inches). Its improved design has also enhanced heat dissipation for optimal performance and motor protection.

A Massive Yet Portable Removable Battery

The Wolf King GTR’s detachable battery offers an extensive 2419 Wh nominal capacity, which allows the scooter to cover up to 180 KMS on a single charge. It features UL 2271 safety certification and benefits from Kaabo’s advanced Battery Management System (BMS) that protects the battery against:

 

  • Overcharge
  • Over-discharge
  • Short circuit
  • Overcurrent
  • Low temperature
  • High temperature

Suspension to Conquer Any Terrain

The performance scooter takes exceptional handling to a whole new level with its upgraded suspension system with hydraulic in front and spring in the rear.

 

The new system is built to withstand even the most gruelling off-road adventures. 

Dominate With Advanced Safety Features

A bright LED front spotlight, a brake light, front and rear turn lights, and a chassis light compose the Kaabo Wolf King GTR’s lighting system.

This expert-level scooter is built to overcome, with a high IPX5 water-resistance rating that shields it against rain. 

Plus, the Wolf King GTR features five riding modes to suit your current conditions: Sport Mode, ESP Mode, Pedestrian Mode, Anti-Theft Mode, and Gears Memory Mode. 

Newly Designed 2-in-1 Sine Wave Controller

The innovative Kaabo 2-in-1 Sine Wave controller delivers a combination of power and efficiency by increasing output, which then translates to a higher top speed and faster acceleration. Thanks to the double-layer design, smart chips, better algorithms and quicker response time, this controller is a game-changer for competitive riders.

Puncture-Resistant Tyres + Removable Rim

To keep you riding, the Wolf King GTR is equipped with self-sealing and puncture-resistant 12-inch hybrid tyres. Its internal sealant automatically seals up punctures to minimise your downtime.

The Wolf King GTR: Where Power Meets Precision

The Kaabo Wolf King GTR is a force to be reckoned with. With its power, efficiency, and expert-level features, this king is built to dominate any terrain and riding condition.

From its elite suspension system and detachable, long-range battery to its innovative 2-in-1 controller and separable motor, this electric scooter is meticulously crafted to raise the standards of riding. The Kaabo Wolf King GTR is for riders who demand the best—whether it’s for exploring further or leaving the competition in the dust.

Why settle for less? With the Kaabo Mantis Pro, maximise the power and performance of two 1000W motors and a high-efficiency 60V 24.5Ah LG battery PLUS dual hydraulic braking system. Challenging the trails and gliding through city streets have never been this easy with the top of the line model from the Kaabo mantis range.

Conquer the roads with the Kaabo Mantis Pro (60V 24.5Ah LG) 

The Kaabo Mantis Pro is the perfect ride for you if you want a ride that can rush through city streets and crush rough trails. An all-terrain electric scooter such as the Mantis Pro offers you amazing performance thanks to its powerful dual motors, each powered at 1000W.

And because of this, you get to enjoy dashing around towns and forests with top speeds of 60 kph. Now, that's sure to ignite the thrill-seeker in you! Plus, you could go farther distances with the Mantis Pro. Its 60V 24.5Ah LG battery makes it all the more possible for you to reach 90-km lengths in just one charge cycle.

The Kaabo Mantis Pro doesn't just provide A-rated riding, it also prioritises your safety and comfort. This electric scooter has a dual braking system with full hydraulic brakes on both the front and rear, which improves stopping distance and braking reliability. It requires only the slightest effort to operate and performs well no matter the terrain or riding condition.

This electric scooter also has an incredible lighting system that increase your visibility at night. Besides the typical headlight and rear light, the Mantis Pro also has cool under-deck lights that not only illuminate you further; they make you look even cooler during your nightly adventures.

What's more, the Mantis Pro also features a dual alloy-coil spring suspension system, independent of each other, that makes your rides buttery smooth. The wide 10x3 inch pneumatic all-terrain tyres also help keep the experience all the more pleasant!

The Mantis Pro also offers added security through a built-in key lock system. The power key allows you to easily lock and unlock your scooter to prevent unauthorised use.

And as far as convenience goes? The Mantis Pro wins due to its handy LCD mini-motors display. In just a glance, you'd be able to see all the important details of your ride including current speed, range, and battery life. title: Kaabo Mantis King GT Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

The Kaabo Mantis King GT has arrived in Australia, bringing next-level performance to riders who want power without sacrificing portability. Built for both commuters and weekend explorers, it refines the classic Mantis design with advanced technology and agility.

 

Key Features:

  • Front and Rear Adjustable Oil Spring Suspension
  • Front and Rear Hydraulic Brakes
  • Twin 30A Sine-wave Controllers

Kaabo Mantis King GT: Power, Agility, Perfection

The new Kaabo Mantis King GT redefines what an electric scooter can be, blending high-performance power with a sleek, agile frame. Whether you're navigating city streets or setting out on a weekend adventure, this scooter delivers an exhilarating ride. 

 

Designed for serious riders, the Mantis King GT builds upon the Mantis DNA and refines every aspect for a superior riding experience. With intuitive handling, effortless cornering, and advanced engineering, this scooter ensures you stay in full control on any terrain.

Next-Level Suspension for a Smooth Ride

Smooth out every bump with the Mantis King GT’s front and rear adjustable hydraulic suspension. Whether you're gliding through city streets or tackling rougher paths, this feature lets you customise your ride for maximum comfort and stability.

Powerful Acceleration with Twin Controllers

Experience swift acceleration with the powerful twin 30A sine-wave controllers. The Mantis King GT launches from 0 to 30 KPH in under two seconds while maintaining smooth control at lower speeds.

Advanced TFT Display for Real-Time Monitoring

Stay informed of your riding specs with the ultra-bright, custom-built TFT display. It provides clear, easy-to-read data on speed, battery life, odometer readings, and even the time – visible even in direct sunlight.

Precision Control with Thumb Throttle

The thumb throttle, inspired by the Wolf King GT, delivers precise, jolt-free acceleration while keeping your fingers within easy reach of the brakes.

Weatherproof Design for All Conditions

Ride confidently in all weather conditions. With an IPX5 water-resistance rating, the Mantis King GT can handle rain, puddles, and a good wash after your ride.

Superior Braking for Maximum Safety

The Mantis King GT’s stopping power is second to none, with dual hydraulic Zoom brakes and a responsive braking system. The pneumatic tyres and superior suspension maximise traction and ensure safe and controlled stops.

Enhanced Lighting for Night Visibility

Ride day or night with confidence. The high-mounted LED headlight illuminates up to 150M ahead, while deck-mounted front and rear lights enhance visibility. Meanwhile, customisable LED swag lights add both style and safety, with colours that can be adjusted via a mobile app.

Spacious Deck for Comfort and Stability

The extended deck and redesigned rear footrest offer a natural riding stance and make for effortless acceleration and cornering, especially for riders with larger shoe sizes.

Upgraded Folding Mechanism for Easy Transport

Kaabo has completely reinvented the Mantis' folding system, introducing a rock-solid double-clasp clamp with a safety latch. Folding the stem takes just two seconds and locks into place for easy carrying.

Long-Lasting Samsung Battery for Extended Rides

The high-quality 60V 21000mAh Samsung battery delivers up to 90 KMS of real-world range. Even at low battery levels, performance remains strong, so you can ride with confidence on longer journeys.

High-Torque Dual Motors for Effortless Power

Twin 1100W motors provide more than just raw power – they deliver smooth, controlled acceleration with exceptional hill-climbing ability and handle inclines easily. 

Built for Experienced Riders

As a true Grand Touring (GT) scooter, the Mantis King GT is built for experienced riders who are looking for top-tier performance and cutting-edge technology. If you demand precision handling, thrilling acceleration, and a refined ride, this scooter will keep a grin on your face from start to finish.

Fiido Q2: Where Comfort Meets Adventure

The Fiido Q1S carved its own path and made a name as a comfortable, practical ride that made everyday adventures a breeze. Now, the Fiido Q2 takes it all up a notch, preserving its predecessor’s beloved comfort while injecting a dose of enhanced performance.

The Fiido Q2 is an invitation to explore. It is powerful enough to tackle hills and maintain speeds, while its impressive range lets you ride further. Longer Range and Enhanced Battery Safety

The seated electric scooter packs a removable 1253Wh battery under its seat and offers an extended range of up to 100 km. But it’s not just about distance. Fiido’s proprietary battery packing technology ensures the safety of your battery under all riding and charging conditions.

Powerful Hydraulic Brakes

The Fiido Q2 sports high-performance hydraulic brakes that deliver controlled and assured stopping power no matter how fast you’re riding. Conquer hills and navigate city streets with unwavering confidence knowing that the Q2 can bring you to a safe halt afterwards.

Adjustable Height, Foldable Design

The seated e-scooter invites you to ride on your own terms. Its adjustable stem can be adjusted to suit your height and riding style, while the foldable handlebar makes storage easy and efficient, whether it’s inside your car trunk or under your office desk.

The city never sleeps—and neither does the Fiido Q2. Its comprehensive lighting system, which illuminates your path and keeps you visible in low-light conditions, include the following:

  • Integrated turn indicators

Accessory-Ready Design

The possibilities are endless with the Q2’s customisable design. Craft your perfect urban adventure, one accessory at a time, using accessories like bags and lights and modifications to suit your specific preferences.

Power, Performance, Possibilities

The Fiido Q2 is a breath of fresh air, built for those who crave comfort, power, and endless possibilities. Its combination of top-of-the-class features and familiar functionalities stands as a testament to thoughtful design and strikes the perfect balance between relaxed cruising and exhilarating journeys.

Ready to ditch the ordinary and embrace the extraordinary? The Fiido Q2 awaits. Suit up, grab your helmet, and prepare to unleash your inner adventurer.

title: Apollo City Pro V3 (2023) Electric Scooter
body_html:
INCLUDES FREE APOLLO PHONE HOLDER AND MAINTENANCE KIT! (RRP: $200+)
The Apollo City Pro has been the definitive electric commuter scooter since the original 2021 model, but now the City Pro is receiving a significant upgrade in 2023. Introducing the latest Apollo City V3 Pro - the latest in a long line of brilliant commuter e-scooters. 
INCLUDES

Key features

    • Dual Motor Pro Version.
    • Incredible acceleration. Climb any hill.
    • Upgraded battery and higher top speeds
    • Power RBS and puncture-proof tyres
    • Better throttle and an IP66 water resistance rating
    • Handlebar & read indicators
    • Best price guarantee
DESCRIPTION

The new benchmark for modern commuting

The award-winning Apollo City 2023 Pro is here to raise the bar for modern commuting and position itself as the ultimate choice for urbanites and riding enthusiasts alike.

Drawing from the success of its forerunners, the beloved Apollo City 2022 & 2021 models, the new Apollo City pro exceeds expectations in combining design, performance, and functionality.

Brace yourself for exhilarating yet stable rides with the City Pro's increased top speeds, robust design, enhanced throttles and grips, turn signals, and more improved features and mechanisms – all crafted to bridge the gaps of electric commuting.

Performance, Power, and Thrill

Outfitted in the brand's distinctive grey hues, the new Apollo City Pro is constructed from 6061 aircraft-grade aluminium to guarantee maximum durability and resilience. Keeping up with the standards of the entire Apollo lineup, the new City is built to withstand even the most challenging of urban terrains.

The Apollo City 2023 is propelled by two 500W motors, pushing the scooter to reach impressive top speeds of up to 51 kph, giving you swift and smooth rides around the city.

Enduring Battery and an Extended Range

The Apollo City 2023 is now equipped with an upgraded battery that boasts a higher capacity – from 18aH to 20aH – to provide more power and range.

With the City's 48V 20aH battery that utilises advanced 21700 cell technology, the electric scooter can cover an extended range of 64 km (single motor) or 70 km (dual motors) on Eco mode, empowering riders to enjoy longer rides on a single charge.

Self-Healing Tyres and Power RBS

Ride with confidence with the Apollo City's self-healing 10-inch tyres. Designed to be puncture-proof, the tyres feature a gel lining that instantly seals any cuts, ensuring hassle-free commutes without interruptions.

The City is further enhanced with the brand's in-house-designed regen throttle system, the Power RBS. Rigorously tested to three times the industry standard, this system has undergone 300K cycles of testing. This guarantees ultra-smooth and reliable stopping to deliver a level of comfort like no other.

Moreover, the Power RBS is designed to minimise the need for frequent mechanical braking, maximising battery efficiency while reducing wear and tear.

Designed for Safety

Despite its powerful performance and exciting features, the new Apollo City is a safe machine, fitted with a 500-lumen, 20 LUX front headlight and a rear brake light to help you stay visible, particularly during night-time rides.

To effortlessly indicate turns, the electric scooter also features integrated turn signals that are embedded onto the handlebar and deck.

The dual-motor Apollo City V3 is also equipped with a triple spring suspension system, which gives it the ability to conquer difficult city terrain – from potholes and cracks to high curbs and uneven pavement.

A true all-terrain scooter, the Apollo City's strong and reliable suspension delivers smooth and comfortable trips all the time.

Built to Withstand the Elements

Staying true to its promise to elevate commuting standards, the Apollo City 2023 is the first in its class to feature an IP66 water resistance rating for all-season riding. This remarkable quality allows riders to embark on unhindered trips, no matter the weather.

New and Improved Mechanisms

Here are new and upgraded features to expect from the new Apollo City:

  • Zero-Wobble Upgrade: The scooter's folding mechanism has been redesigned to eliminate wobbling and instability.
  • Hook System: It also comes with a new hook system that ensures hassle-free folding and unfolding.
  • Kickstand: The scooter's kickstand is now stronger and reinforced for superior support and security.
  • Throttles: The new City features 8th-gen in-house-designed throttles for smoother operation and improved ergonomics.
  • Grips: These have been enhanced to provide a more comfortable and secure grip.

Ride Smart With The Apollo App

Take rides to the next level with the Apollo App. Use it to adjust your braking and acceleration settings to match your skill and preferences and customise your ride to suit your unique needs.

You can also use the app to access real-time electric scooter range estimates, providing you with helpful information about the battery range remaining in your ride.

To deliver an extra layer of security, the Apollo app also lets you remotely lock and unlock your scooter to protect it against theft and unauthorised use.

Following in the footsteps of its predecessors, the Apollo City 2023 is more than just an award-winning electric scooter; it is a solution designed to address the real-life challenges of daily commutes.

A striking all-rounder with impeccable quality

The Inokim OX Super is a well-rounded electric scooter ideal for riders of all skill levels, delivering speed without sacrificing stability.

Adjustable suspension for smooth rides

The new Inokim OX is equipped with the OX Suspension Adapter Patent (OSAP), a brand-exclusive single-sided adjustable suspension system. This feature allows you to adjust the suspension angle to suit current riding conditions.

The low setting results in a lower centre of gravity that's perfect for city riding. On the other hand, the high setting is ideal for off-road rides on rough and bumpy terrain.

Wobble-free and stable all the time

Constructed from aviation aluminium alloy from its frame to its handlebars, the outcome is an electric scooter that is highly durable and wobble-free.

Plus, the OX Super features a long and wide deck that can accommodate riders weighing up to 120 kg.

New rubber deck carpet for better grip

In the past, users had raised concerns about its plastic deck, which had a tendency to become slippery.

In the 2023 version, a new rubber deck carpet has been added for better grip and sure-footed rides.

Well-designed folding mechanism

A lot of thought has gone into the OX's folding mechanism, which allows you to fold the e-scooter even with one hand. Here are the scooter's dimensions:

  • Open: 122 cm (L) x 59 cm (W) x 130 cm (H)

Created for safe and confident riding

Safety is Inokim's top priority, equipping the OX with a front drum brake and a rear disc brake that promise exceptional stopping power.

And with the low suspension setting in place, the lower centre of gravity means more stability and balance — and fewer wipeouts.

Finally, the 2023 OX has a UL certificate, guaranteeing that it has undergone stringent laboratory tests and passed strict safety requirements.

Why choose Inokim?

Inokim is a global leader in producing high-end electric scooters for adults, releasing updated models every year to address previous issues and fill in the gaps in commuting.

title: Surron Ultra Bee ADR Road Electric Dirt Bike
body_html:
Moving into the limelight with a remarkable stride, the new Sur-Ron Ultra Bee showcases the insight and expertise of the Bee line of dirt bikes, delivering a robust performance that revolutionises the electric off-road experience.

Upgrades include:

  • Fully adjustable suspension
  • Surron Traction Control and Energy Regenerative System
  • Bilateral 4 Piston Hydraulic 240mm Disc
  • 0 to 50 kph in 2.3 sec
DESCRIPTION

A new era of off-road thrills with the Sur-Ron Ultra Bee

Drawing wisdom from the success of its forerunners, Sur-Ron is proud to present the new Ultra Bee: a performance powerhouse that prides itself on lightweight handling, seamless power output, and the brand’s refined off-road traction control system.

The New Ultra Bee stands for cutting-edge design and advanced technology. With its expertly enhanced front and rear suspension, mastery in conquering obstacles, and a significant boost in stopping power, this dirt bike elevates your off-road adventures to new levels of thrill and excitement.

Design and Performance

Crafted from forged aluminium alloy, the new Ultra Bee defines the essence of the brand’s design philosophy, “Balancing on the Cutting Edge.” The result is an ultra-lightweight yet robust construction, achieving a 50:50 front and rear counterweight distribution.

The machine is powered by a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), unleashing a staggering 12.5 kW of power that pushes the bike to reach a top speed of 90 kph. Its highly efficient 74V battery allows it to cover a maximum range of 140 km on a single charge, conquering any kind of terrain with its off-road capabilities.

And in 2.3 seconds flat, the Ultra Bee zooms from 0 to 50 kph, demonstrating lightning-fast acceleration that satisfies your need for speed.

Carefully designed to strike a balance between comfort and prowess, the Sur-Ron Ultra Bee stands as a visually striking electric bike that embodies top-notch craftsmanship and engineering.

New Innovative Powertrain

The new Ultra Bee is a mid-sized marvel that is propelled by Sur-Ron’s 4th generation powertrain, a system that provides precision handling and seamless power delivery.

The bike’s fully isolated electrical architecture prevents any potential interference between high and low voltage circuit components, ensuring smooth rides all the time.

SRTC Traction Control

The Ultra Bee is also outfitted with the Sur-Ron Traction Control System (SRTC), the brand’s latest multi-condition off-road traction control system.

With this refined system in place, riders can effortlessly conquer any obstacle, all while maintaining complete control of the dirt bike no matter the terrain.

High-Capacity, High-Efficiency

The dirt bike comes equipped with a new 4,070 Wh battery pack, designed to offer efficiency through high power density and a better battery cycle life while achieving a lower battery discharge temperature rate. With its enhanced continuous discharge capability, this new system ensures a dependable riding experience.

Quite impressively, despite its capacity, the Ultra Bee’s battery efficiently charges from zero to 100% in just four hours.

Riders will also love the cleverly concealed space underneath the seat that is specifically designed to accommodate the charger. This convenient feature allows riders to carry their chargers and charge their bike wherever there’s an outlet.

Enhanced Suspension

The Ultra Bee showcases a newly-designed suspension system that helps unlock its full off-road riding potential.

With travel front suspension and a TR intersect monoshock rear suspension, both fully adjustable, the electric dirt bike excels in all riding conditions, empowering riders to achieve higher speeds, steeper climbs, and victory over any type of terrain.

Improved Stopping Power

To complete the ultimate riding experience, the Ultra Bee is equipped with a race-inspired braking system that has been refined to offer maximum stopping power on the trails. With front and rear 240-mm hydraulic disc brakes, this dirt bike offers the perfect balance of thrill, safety, and control.

Riding Modes and Reverse Manoeuvring

Thoughtfully designed for versatility, the new Ultra Bee features four riding modes: eco, daily, sport, and reverse. These riding levels offer different, tailored mixes of performance and efficiency. On the other hand, the bike’s reverse mode allows riders to easily back off and manoeuvre their way out of tricky situations.

For easy activation of these modes, the dirt bike incorporates an innovative and ergonomically-friendly switch. With this switch, riders can easily change riding modes even while in motion.

If you’re ready to conquer trails in confidence, the Sur-Ron Ultra Bee awaits you as your new adventure companion.

title: Aventon Sinch 2.5 Off-Road Fat Tyre Folding Electric Bike
body_html:
Introducing the Sinch 2.5: the best-performing all-terrain folding e-bike, now made even better. Retaining the compact portability of the Sinch.2, the 2.5 adds advanced hydraulic brakes for safer rides, a suspension seatpost for smoother journeys, a stylish new look with updated colours, and more.

Key Features for 2025:

  • Tektro hydraulic disc brakes
  • Shimano Altus drivetrain
  • New suspension seatpost
  • 20 x 4-inch fat tyres 
DESCRIPTION

The Best Folding E-Bike, Now Even Better

Aventon has taken the beloved Sinch.2 and made it extraordinary with the new Sinch 2.5. 

 

Alongside a refreshed design and eye-catching new colours, this upgraded folding e-bike features premium upgrades like hydraulic disc brakes, a smoother drivetrain, a suspension seatpost for added comfort, and more.

 

With its 500W motor, the Aventon Sinch.2 achieves:

 

  • 32 kph top speed (off-road use)
  • 60Nm of motor torque
  • 88 kilometres on a single charge

Thanks to these upgrades, which are built into Aventon’s reliable design, the Sinch 2.5 is set to redefine what a folding e-bike can do.

Still more power than your standard folding e-bike

The Sinch 2.5 keeps the same dependable power and performance that set the Sinch.2 apart from regular folding e-bikes. Its 500W rear-hub motor (750W peak) delivers speeds up to 32 kph (off-road use), whether you’re riding on city roads or uneven trails. Aventon’s intuitive torque sensor continues to deliver natural rides that match your pedalling efforts.

 

The integrated 48V battery with LG cells charges quickly and gives you plenty of range (up to 88 kilometres), while 4” fat tyres provide stability and grip for a smooth ride on any surface.

New and improved side display

The new Aventon Sinch 2.5 sports an upgraded side display that combines a stylish look with practical functionality. Inspired by the straightforward design of classic MP3 players, using this display, you can easily navigate your ride settings with intuitive controls right at your fingertips.

 

Plus, the addition of a USB-C port lets you charge your phone on the go, so you can stay connected wherever your journey takes you.

Hydraulic brakes for more powerful stopping

The Sinch 2.5 upgrades from the mechanical brakes of its predecessor to premium Tektro hydraulic brakes. While the older mechanical brakes did their job well, the new hydraulic brakes provide enhanced stopping power and smoother modulation. 

 

Whether you’re commuting or riding on challenging terrain, the hydraulic braking system ensures quick and reliable stops for a safer, more enjoyable ride.

Suspension seat added for better comfort

With the addition of a suspension seatpost and an Aventon-branded large saddle, the Sinch 2.5 offers a smoother, more comfortable ride. The padded suspension seatpost absorbs road impacts, ensuring you experience less jarring and more enjoyment as you ride.

The same convenient, compact design

You'll find it easy to ride the Aventon Sinch 2.5 with its simple step-through frame that allows you to place your leg through the open space in the middle. The frame and handlebars also fold into a small, compact size for easy storage. 

 

The locking mechanism is secure and stable, so you can forget about the anxiety-inducing rattling and clicking noises you hear on most folding e-bikes. 

The pinnacle of folding e-bikes is here

The Sinch 2.5 takes everything you loved about the Sinch.2 and makes it a lot better with upgraded components and improved performance. Whatever your ride entails—whether it’s a simple commute or an adventurous ride on tough trails—you can enjoy unmatched power, comfort, and convenience. 

 

Experience the next level of versatility and performance with the Sinch 2.5.

An IPX5 rating means the bike is protected against low-pressure water jets from any direction. This provides a moderate level of water resistance, allowing you to ride in light to moderate rain or through small puddles. title: Apollo Phantom V4 (2024) Electric Scooter
body_html:
Experience next-level power and performance with the new Apollo Phantom. Designed to surpass and surprise, the new Phantom sets out to redefine what’s possible, pushing boundaries like never before.

Key features

  • Mach 1 controller
  • Quadruple spring suspension
  • Front and rear turn signals
DESCRIPTION

Explore beyond limits with the new Apollo Phantom

The legacy forged by the iconic Apollo Phantom V1, V2, and V3 is a tough act to follow. These remarkable electric scooters amassed a passionate following, earning the esteemed status of a cult favourite among thrill-seekers and e-scooter enthusiasts.

But, as a testament to boundless excellence, the new Apollo Phantom—updated for 2024—has arrived, surpassing expectations with cutting-edge technology, seamless performance, and overall superiority.

Step into the future of electric scooters with the Apollo Phantom 2024. Boasting next-generation features, an impressive top speed and range, quadruple spring suspension, and trademark Apollo quality, the new Phantom empowers you to explore new horizons and push the boundaries of what’s possible.

Experience unparalleled freedom and exhilaration with the new Apollo Phantom 2024, and brace yourself for a ride that will ignite your sense of adventure and leave you yearning for more.

Impeccable Power and Speed

Equipped with a high-capacity 52V battery, the Apollo Phantom 2024 is built to go the distance. With an impressive range of up to 80 km on a single charge, you can confidently explore far and wide without worrying about running out of power.

The new Apollo Phantom is driven by dual 1200W motors that propel it to exhilarating speeds of up to 66 kph on Ludo Mode. Experience the thrill as you effortlessly cruise through any terrain knowing that its quadruple spring suspension system provides unmatched comfort and stability.

You can also conquer even the steepest slopes with ease as the Phantom dominates inclines of up to 25°. Designed to handle challenging terrains, this exceptional electric scooter effortlessly carries a maximum rider weight of 136 kg.

Mach 1 Controller and Ludo Mode

The meticulously crafted Mach 1 controller is the unseen force that propels the Apollo Phantom 2024. Designed in-house, the Mach 1 controller revolutionises efficiency and surpasses stock controllers by 27%.

And with the innovative Ludo Mode, you can unleash your Phantom’s true potential. Activate Ludo Mode to catapult your Apollo Phantom’s top speed from the stock 61 kph to an electrifying 66 kph. Get ready to embrace the thrill of speed and revel in the exhilaration that this riding mode brings to your journey.

Smart Regenerative Braking

Ushering in the future of braking technology, the Apollo Phantom 2024 features a regenerative brake throttle on a high-performance e-scooter. This feature allows you to brake faster, safer, and more efficiently while simultaneously recharging your battery.

By harnessing the power of regen brakes, you can improve your range and battery life and reduce mechanical brake wear-and-tear by 90%, significantly reducing the need for maintenance and repairs.

LX Display – 2x Brighter and Larger

To keep track of your gear modes, including the Ludo Mode, and stay updated about your speed, battery level, navigation, mileage, and more, the new Phantom also features an LX screen that displays important information with stunning clarity.

With a 2x increase in brightness, size, and responsiveness, enhanced with anti-glare technology, the Phantom’s LX display is a remarkable feature that ensures you have access to every essential detail at your fingertips.

360 Safety Lighting – New Front Turn Signals

The Apollo Phantom now features front turn signals in addition to its already impressive set of lighting elements. With a powerful 1000-lumen headlight, rear and front turn signals, and a brake light, the Phantom ensures optimal visibility and helps you stay safe on the road.

Thanks to this lighting system, you can confidently navigate your surroundings while ensuring that you remain easily seen on the road.

Stay Connected With the Apollo App

Finally, explore your Apollo Phantom’s full potential through its ultimate companion: the Apollo app. Using the app, you can unlock a world of personalised preferences that empower you to take full control of your ride.

The Apollo app brings connectivity to the forefront, allowing you to customise your scooter’s brake and acceleration settings to your liking. Enjoy the convenience of remote locking, which allows you to secure your scooter with ease. Access integrated navigation features for effortless navigating and a smoother riding experience.

Get ready to embark on a ride that will leave you in awe as the Apollo Phantom delivers next-level technology and performance, opening up a world of thrilling possibilities.

title: Apollo Air V3 (2023) Electric Scooter
body_html:
Add a touch of luxury to your rides with the new Apollo Air. Thoughtfully designed with the commuter in mind, the Apollo Air 2023 offers a blend of style, comfort, and technology through upgraded components, enhanced functionalities, and exclusive new features.

Key features

  • Front Dual Fork Suspension
  • Power RBS Braking System
  • IP66 Water Resistance
DESCRIPTION

Elevate your commutes with the Apollo Air 2023

There is no doubt about it: the Apollo Air has firmly established its position as one of the premier commuter e-scooters in today's market.

Stepping into the spotlight after its forerunners, the new Apollo Air is here to redefine the commuter e-scooter experience, surpassing even its own predecessors, and ready to take your rides to new heights.

Say hello to remarkable enhancements – from new throttles and self-healing tyres to brighter lights and a redesigned folding mechanism – crafted for better control, visibility, and portability.

With remarkable improvements in performance, design, and functionality, the Apollo Air 2023 is a testament to the brand's commitment to pushing the boundaries of excellence.

Power and Speed Suited for City Commutes

Constructed from aircraft-grade aluminium, the new Apollo Air 2023 is highly durable and resilient, ensuring the scooter's ability to withstand the demands of urban terrain and providing a stable and reliable ride regardless of the cityscape.

The scooter is powered by a robust 500W motor, capable of reaching a peak wattage of 900 W. For those seeking an exciting and fast-paced commuting experience, the electric scooter achieves a maximum top speed of 34 kph.

Extended Range

The Apollo Air 2023 is fitted with a 36V 15aH battery powered by 21700 top quality cells. In eco mode, the electric scooter can cover an impressive distance of up to 55 km, providing riders with extended range and the freedom to explore without worrying about running out of battery.

Self-Healing Tyres and Power RBS

Embrace uninterrupted, hassle-free rides with the Apollo Air’s self-healing tyres. These innovative tyres are designed with a gel lining inside, which acts to seal punctures on the go. Now, you can say goodbye to the hassle of dealing with a flat tyre in the middle of your commute.

The Apollo Air 2023 is also equipped with Power RBS, Apollo’s in-house regen throttle system, which has undergone testing with 300K cycles to ensure a reliable performance. This regenerative braking system is capable of recharging your battery by up to 10%, reducing downtime and maximising efficiency.

Additionally, the Power RBS reduces reliance on the mechanical brake by up to 90%. This reduction significantly reduces wear and tear on the mechanical brake, prolonging its lifespan and lowering maintenance costs.

Brighter Lights and Dual Suspension

Ensure safety and visibility, even in low-light conditions, with the adjustable 500-lumen front headlight and built-in rear brake light of the Apollo Air. At 20 LUX, the new headlight is twice as bright as its older versions.

Additionally, the scooter has indicators embedded into the handlebars, enabling you to effectively signal and communicate with other drivers on the road.

With a front-dual fork suspension system, the Apollo Air 2023 effortlessly glides over uneven surfaces, providing an exceptional riding experience that is free from the discomfort of bumps and vibrations.

Upgraded Features

Always the one to set a new standard, the Apollo Air 2023 is the first electric scooter in its category to feature an impressive IP66 water resistance rating. This ensures smooth rides no matter the weather.

Here are some more of the exciting new features that await you:

  • A new handlebar with new grips for enhanced comfort and ergonomics
  • Sleek, in-house designed throttles with bigger buttons and better spring response
  • A re-designed zero-wobble folding mechanism that eliminates any unwanted movement
  • A new clip-in hook system for hassle-free folding and unfolding

With these new features in place, you get to enjoy the benefits of enhanced ergonomics, precise control, stable folding, and effortless handling.

Ride Smart With The Apollo App

Take full control of your Apollo Air riding experience with the Apollo app. Use it to personalise your ride by adjusting your braking and acceleration settings to match your preferences and riding style.

With the Apollo app, you gain access to valuable information about your battery's remaining range estimate, allowing you to plan your routes more efficiently.

For added security, utilise the app to securely lock and unlock your scooter and protect it against unauthorised use.

With the Apollo app, you have the power to tailor your ride, stay informed, and maintain control at your fingertips.
