title: Segway-Ninebot F2 Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
The Segway-Ninebot F2 Pro is perfect for daily commuting and outdoor exploring thanks to its intelligent functions, improved features, and high performance.

Key Features:

  • 10-inch Tubeless Pneumatic tyres with jelly layer
  • Anti-skid Traction Control System
  • Built-in front and rear indicators
  • Dual brake system
DESCRIPTION

Feature-rich, cost-effective riding

The Segway F2 Pro is perfect for the smart commuter, looking for a daily ride that's packed with useful features. Reliable and affordable, it offers excellent performance with more upgraded components.

Equipped with a Motor for Reliable Speedy Performance

The Segway F2 Pro is fitted with an upgraded brushless motor that can provide up to 900W of power, allowing you to quickly reach a top speed of 25 KPH. It's also a huge reason why the scooter can handle inclines of up to 22%. 

 

What's more, the Segway F2 Pro has three riding modes (ECO, Sport, or Drive) that allow you to customise your riding experience, from longer rides to faster speeds. This electric scooter also features Walk Mode, accessible through the app, which allows you to effortlessly push your scooter when walking in crowded places.

High-Performance Battery for Greater Range

With the Segway F2 Pro, you'll be able to cover a longer distance, up to 55 KMS, on a single charge. This is thanks to the scooter's 460Wh battery.

 

Additionally, it comes with an advanced Smart Battery Management System with 7 protection mechanisms that allow maximum performance for longer, more powerful rides.

Upgraded Self-Healing Tyres Tyres

The F2 Pro features 10-inch self-healing tubeless tyres that reduce the likelihood of severe punctures. Meanwhile, the 55mm width of the tyre allows for better stability and smoother rides. Plus, each tyre contains a jelly layer that makes it harder to puncture, so you can have peace of mind while on the go.


The Segway F2 Pro also features Segway's Anti-Skid Traction Control System whose controller algorithm allows for more precise control and increased traction on gravel and slippery surfaces.

Smooth and Comfortable Journeys

Unlike the other e-scooters in the F2 series, the F2 Pro is equipped with front spring suspension with 35mm stroke lengths. This absorbs bumps and vibrations from the road to keep your rides as pleasant as possible.

 

Furthermore, the e-scooter has been designed for better comfort and stability thanks to wider handlebars that allow more space for accessories, like a phone holder.

Utmost Safety While Riding

Segway keeps safety at the forefront by equipping the F2 Pro with a dual braking system: a front disc brake and an electronic rear brake.

 

The F2 Pro also has a 2.1W high-brightness LED front lights that light up to 13.5m ahead for clear, bright riding. They also have front, side, and rear E-MARK-certified reflectors to boost your visibility during low-light conditions.

 

The lighting system is then completed by built-in front and rear indicators. 

 

Covering all bases, apart from the lights, the F2 Pro is also equipped with a bell. 

Ergonomically Designed Electric Scooter

The Segway F2 has Segway's Traction Control System with a controller algorithm which allows for increased grip and stability on gravel and slippery roads.

 

It also has wider ergonomic handlebars that help you control your scooter while turning. The extra handlebar width also has more space for accessories, such as a phone holder.

 

You'll also get an IPX5 water resistance rating.

In-App Connectivity and Apple Find My Scooter

The Segway F2 Pro can be synced with your smartphone and the Segway app via a Bluetooth connection. With the app, you can update the scooter's firmware, check riding status and remaining battery, unlock/lock your ride, activate Walk Mode, and more.

 

But that's not all.


The F2 Pro is also compatible with the Apple Find My network, so you can easily and quickly locate your e-scooter at all times.

title: Apollo Pro Electric Scooter
body_html:
PRE-ORDER SUPER SPECIAL LIMITED TIME PRICE! SHIPS DECEMBER / JANUARY.

Push your limits with Apollo's strongest hyper-scooter yet. The Apollo Pro delights and exhilarates without compromising on usability and design.

Key features

  • Built-In GPS Technology
  • Quadlock Phone Mount
  • Mach 2 Controller
DESCRIPTION

The perfect balance between performance, innovation, and ease of use

The all-new Apollo Pro is here, a piece of art that seamlessly merges vehicle-grade features with a sleek, contemporary design.

As it takes its place among the most promising and well-rounded hyperscooters available today, the Apollo Pro guarantees unrivaled performance, an innovative design, and utilitarian features for every user and every ride.

In a category where speed and battery size often take centre stage, the new Apollo Pro stands apart by embracing a different approach. It makes thoughtful design choices, carefully prioritising longevity and future-proofing over anything else.

With this, the Apollo Pro emerges as a true champion, providing riders with a hyperscooter that is built to last and adapt to the challenges of tomorrow.

Aircraft-Grade Unibody Frame & Top Water Resistance

The Apollo Pro's streamlined unibody frame is crafted with only two metal blocks made from aircraft grade aluminium, a decision made not only to improve the hyperscooter's aesthetic appeal but also to enhance its strength and durability.

It also showcases an IP66 rating, the highest water and dust resistance rating in performance scooters, guaranteeing smooth rides, rain or shine.

With a maximum load capacity of 150 kg, the hyperscooter is built to accommodate different riders and different needs.

Thanks to its remarkable engineering, resilience, and durability, the Apollo Pro stands as the adventurous rider's ultimate companion.

Vehicle-Grade, Hyper-Performance

Propelled by a powerful dual 1200W motor, the Apollo Pro hyperscooter achieves a top speed of 70 kph and, thanks to its high-capacity 1560 Wh battery, covers an extended range of up to 100 km on a single charge. 

The Apollo Pro 2023 is equipped with Apollo's in-house built MACH 2 controller,which provides precise control and seamless acceleration. To satisfy your need for speed, this technology also enables the Apollo Pro to go into LUDO mode, which unlocks the scooter's potential and allows it to reach 0-50 kph within 4.99 seconds. 

Convenient GPS Technology

The new Apollo Pro is the first hyperscooter with built-in GPS connectivity, smart battery management system, and 10 sensors. 

Its built-in GPS boasts an array of advanced features such as anti-theft capabilities, detailed remote diagnostics, ride recording, location tracking within 10 metres of target, and more. 

Power RBS System & Strong Suspension

A strong hyperscooter requires superior braking system, and the Apollo Pro fulfils this with its Power RBS (regenerative braking system). With a dedicated regen braking throttle, the Pro seamlessly engages the brakes while simultaneously recharging the battery to extend range and improve your battery life. 

Furthermore, the Apollo Pro incorporates an additional layer of safety with the inclusion of drum brakes. While the regen braking system reduces the reliance on mechanical brakes by 90%, the presence of drum brakes serves as backup emergency brakes, providing riders with maximum stopping power when needed.

The Apollo Pro also incorporates front hydraulic and rear rubber suspension to conquer diverse terrains -- from cruising to off roading -- with ease.

High-Performing, Superior Tyres

Working with the dual braking system to offer enhanced durability and road protection are the Apollo Pro's 12-inch tyres. 

Equipped with self-healing technology, these tyres maintain their integrity over time, ensuring a consistent and reliable grip on various surfaces. Additionally, the increased wheel size provides an extra layer of protection against punctures.

360-Degree Lighting System & Intuitive DOT Display

The Apollo Pro comes with an innovative 360-degree lighting system, a crucial feature that ensures maximum visibility and enhanced rider safety, especially during nighttime rides. 

With lighting elements strategically positioned around the hyperscooter, the lighting system illuminates the surroundings from all angles, making the rider highly visible to others on the road.

Taking a no-frills approach, the Apollo Pro's intuitive DOT embodies future-proof technology. It is designed to adapt and evolve over time by being capable of receiving new features via future firmware updates.

Quadlock Phone Mount & Apollo App Connection

The Apollo Pro 2023 also introduces a new feature never before seen in another electric scooter: a phone-as-display functionality seamlessly integrated into the Quadlock phone mount. 

For the first time ever in an electric scooter, riders can utilise their own smartphone as a display, unlocking a whole new level of convenience and versatility.

The Quadlock phone mount provides a convenient and secure solution, ensuring that your smartphone stays charged and easily accessible while allowing you to stay connected to the Apollo App for a seamless and immersive riding experience.

body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Straight from Sci-Fi

**THIS BIKE IS SOLD FOR OFF-ROAD USE ONLY**
**CURRENTLY NOT SHIPPING TO NSW**

The C3Strom Astro Pro is perfect for urban riders looking for the excitement of riding a crossover between rebel motorcycles and cool mountain bikes, and it marries the two styles well.

 

High-speed adventures abound with a strong motor

 

Feel the rush of the wind when accelerating on the Astro Pro. You can reach speeds of up to 50 kph (off-road / private use only) thanks to its strong 750W Bafang Motor that can produce 80Nm of torque and a peak output of 1400W.

 

With this kind of power, accelerating quickly is a breeze. You can even switch between 5 levels of Pedal Assist & throttle-only. 

 

Reach greater distances with a high-performing Samsung battery

 

The Astro Pro carries a high-performance 1040Wh Samsung battery which allows you to reach distances of up to 125 km in a single charge. If you're going full electronic, you'll still be able to go up to 50 km.

 

What's more, the Astro Pro's battery is fully removable so you can swap it with a new one if you have a spare. Charging is also quick at only 4 to 5 hours with the fast charger that comes with the bike.

 

Confident rides with durable tyres and smooth suspension

 

Experience smooth riding even when you're speeding around as the Astro Pro features a front suspension. It also comes with 20 x 4.25" puncture-resistant tyres that soak up bumps and cracks while on the move.

 

Plus, its 4 Piston hydraulic brakes provide you with the best stopping power so you can confidently reach top speed and brake when you need to.

 

Modern riding with a futuristic design

 

The Astro Pro doesn't just look pretty and sleek. It's also functionally designed, with a bright LCD display that shows you real-time data while on the go.

 

All controls are within easy reach on the handlebars so you can quickly and easily customise your ride the way you want.

 

The aluminium alloy frame of the Astro Pro is highly durable, and has a convenient step-over design that makes it stable easy to mount. It even has a long, cushiony saddle for better comfort and balance during your rides.

 

You can also add an optional rear rack for more space for your things (or even for a spare battery to extend your range).

 

What's more, the Astro Pro has a powerful 130 Lux headlight that increases your visibility so you can see clearer and be seen better while on the road. This can also switch between full beam & dipped beam. It also has a bright tail light and convenient turn indicators to up your safety even in low-visibility conditions.

 

Sync up with the C3Strom App

 

The display on the Astro Pro has a USB port where you can connect your phone. You can also download the C3strom app on iOS and Android and sync up your ride via Bluetooth.

title: Segway Ninebot MAX G2 [2024/25] Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

Enjoy a comfier upgraded commute

The Segway Max G2 is perfect for the daily commuter wanting a secure and pleasant ride everyday, with less bumps felt on the road.

 

Speedy Trips with a Reliable Motor

 

Experience enjoyable zippy rides as the Segway Max G2 can reach speed of 25 kph, with the help of its strong, reliable 450W motor. It can also handle climbing up inclines of up to 22%, so you'll worry less if you're in a hilly area.

 

Extend travels, thanks to longer range

 

Long-distance commutes have never been easier with the Segway Max G2, as it can reach up to 70 km in a single charge. That's thanks to its reliable 551Wh battery, which takes just about 6 hours to fully charge.

 

What's more, the Segway Max G2 is powered by Segway's latest RIDEYLONG technology. It coordinates the high-performance brushless motor with the optimized controller algorithm, to make rides smoother, less noisy, and more efficient.

 

The added benefit of long-range formulated tyres paired with this tech can even extend your scooter's range.

 

Comfortable riding with built-in suspension

 

The star upgrade on the Segway Max G2 is its built-in front hydraulic and rear adjustable double spring suspension, allowing for smoother rides than ever before.

 

Pair that with its 10-inch tubeless pneumatic self-healing tyres, and you won't have to worry too much about bumpy roads and small punctures.

 

Your safety is also a top priority while riding, which is why the Segway Max G2 comes with a reliable front drum brake and rear electronic brake for maximum stopping power.

 

Be confident with top-quality Segway design

 

The Segway Max G2 comes in a larger frame size than its sibling, with an anti-skid deck and higher weight capacity, allowing for more comfortable riding.

 

It also features a convenient thumb throttle that makes accelerating easy and more ergonomic.

 

You'll also have no problems seeing and being seen on the road as the Segway Max G2 has a high-power headlight and visible red brake lights. It even has turn indicators on the handlebars to let everyone know where you're going next.

 

Plus, pedestrians and traffic can be alerted with its horn.

 

Sync up with the Segway App

 

Remain updated on firmware, or always have your riding stats handy when you sync up your smartphone and Segway Max G2 with the Segway App via Bluetooth.

 

But that's not all.

 

The Segway Max G2 also has the Apple Find My technology, which allows you to see where you scooter is at all times when it's synced up with your phone. However, it's only compatible with the iOS system.

  • Domino Twist throttle
  • Bright Moto-style headlight
DESCRIPTION

A New Kind of Ride with the EMove Roadrunner Pro

Phenomenal Power, Thanks to Sturdy Dual Motors

Maintaining a luxuriously smooth and zippy ride is easy to achieve on the Roadrunner Pro as its strong 2000W dual motors can provide the power you need to go up to 80 kph. 

Its motor's addictive power is comparable to the Kaabo's Wolf King scooters, which really shows how well-built and performative the Roadrunner is. 

It can even reach 30-degree climb angles, so you can quickly go up hills and make the most of your rides. Plus, this scooter can reach 0 to 24 kph in just 2.3 seconds.

You can even get a shot of adrenaline when you reach faster speeds as the Roadrunner Pro can go from 0 to 48 kph in under 6 seconds, thanks to its dual sinewave controllers.

Indeed, with its insane performance, it's among the most optimal seated scooters for those who want to balance thrills with comfort.

Battery & Range

An awesome feature in the Roadrunner Pro is its large-capacity removable battery, made with LG cells. It provides enough power to get you up hilly places or take you to spots up to 80 km.

Its range even holds up to long distance riding, even when you're on a beastly pace as it can still reach about 50 km at 30 kph to 48 kph.

And if you want to go on for longer, the battery's easy to remove and swap with another one. That way, you won't need to stop riding even while waiting for the 10.4-hr charge time.

Thick Tyres & Awesome Suspension

While most electric scooters offer either tubeless tyres or split rims, the EMove Roadrunner Pro is among the first to have both split rims and tubeless tyres. This allows for bigger tyres that can tackle almost any terrain and feel amazing on the go.

What's more, ride quality is made smoother and enjoyable with the Roadrunner's improved suspension. It features front inverted motorcycle-style forks and rear hydraulic shocks that make even the bumpiest pavements feel buttery smooth.

Design & Ride Quality

While the EMove Roadrunner Pro looks closely like the base, it has a completely redesigned seat tat's longer and more comfortable than the original. Its fabric stays cooler.

It also features an easy twist throttle (just a like a real motorcycle) that makes it easier to hold the speed steady.

The Roadrunner Pro even has a 9-cm bright TFT display that shows all the riding details you need while on the road, including current speed, battery status, riding mode, and a clock.

Safety & Lights

The EMove Roadrunner Pro features huge Zoom full hydraulic brakes with 180mm rotors, a definite upgrade from the semi-hydraulics of the base Roadrunner.

These brakes allow the scooter to stop at only 3.1 metres from a 24 kph speed, almost the same as the base model while weighing twice heavier.

It even has a large motorcycle-style headlight that makes the scooter hard to miss. What's more, the Roadrunner Pro features modern turn indicators at the back of the seat.

While the Roadrunner Pro doesn't come with an official IP rating, Voro Motors does state that its safe under light rain. It is also doubly protected by awesome front and rear fenders. But still err on the side of caution, as the Roadrunner Pro is still an electric ride, and will not withstand water damage well.

Besides that, this seated scooter is a premium, balancing comfort and performance well, so that you can make the most of any trip!

title: Aventon Abound SR Electric Cargo Bike (2026)
body_html:
The beloved Aventon Abound returns as the Abound SR, now with a longer range, upgraded components, and smarter 4G connectivity. Featuring a fresh design and new colours, it enhances everything riders love while maintaining the reliability and versatility of the Abound line. Modern, spacious, and dependable—the Abound SR is ready for anything.

Key Features:

  • Aventon Control Unit
  • Suspension seatpost
  • Longer range
  • Theft deterrence
Description

Power and Space for Your Everyday Needs

Meet the Abound SR: the ultimate cargo e-bike designed to handle whatever life throws your way. 

 

From running errands to transporting your kids, the Abound SR delivers excellent versatility and performance, offering a great upgrade to the already dependable Aventon Abound. 

 

With its 250W motor, the Aventon Abound SR achieves:

 

  • 25 kph 
  • 80Nm of motor torque
  • 97 kilometres on a single charge

With features like an adjustable quill stem, suspension seatpost, and next-gen theft protection, the Abound SR guarantees every journey is smooth, safe, and hassle-free. 

 

Whether you're hauling gear or heading out for fun, this bike is built to keep up with your lifestyle.

Abound SR vs. Abound LR: Which One is Right for You?

Both models have the same 200-KG payload capacity, but the Abound LR features a rear rack that is 18 cm longer than the SR, which makes it better suited for carrying bulkier cargo or two passengers. However, the LR is also 3.6 kg heavier. 

 

If you prefer a more compact cargo e-bike for easier storage and maneuverability, the SR is the better choice. However, if you need more cargo space, go for the Aventon Abound LR.

New ACU and increased theft deterrence

The Abound SR features the Aventon Control Unit (ACU), a smart system designed for ultimate security and seamless connectivity. With GPS tracking, 4G connectivity, remote locking, and geofencing, staying connected to your bike has never been easier.

 

Safety is built in with passcode protection, an integrated alarm, and a smart-lock kickstand. Even when powered off, the bike stays locked down and requires a passcode to reactivate. 

New sensor switch

Get the best of both worlds with Aventon’s Sensor Switch. Toggle between Torque and Cadence sensor to match your riding style. Whether you prefer natural pedal power or smooth cruising, the choice is always yours.

Equipped for hauling with heavy-duty power

The Abound SR is equipped with a 250W motor and 80 nm of torque to reach speeds up to 25 kph and effortlessly tackle hills or heavy loads.

 

Meanwhile, its 708 Wh battery offers up to 97 KMs of range on a single charge, while a 200-KG total weight capacity ensures it can carry everything from groceries to a child seat—without compromising on power.

Designed for your comfort and convenience

A step-through frame and lightweight aluminium design make it easy to hop on and off the Abound SR, so it’s ideal for quick, busy commutes. 

 

Furthermore, a 50mm suspension seatpost ensures a smooth ride over rough terrain, while Tektro hydraulic disc brakes offer strong, reliable stopping power. 

A ride you can customise to suit your needs

Enjoy a personalised ride with the Abound SR’s Ride Tune feature, which lets you adjust pedal assist settings for a smooth, responsive experience. 

 

On the other hand, through the Aventon app, you can fine-tune motor performance with options like Eco, Trail, and Turbo modes, adjusting torque, acceleration, and assistance for a ride tailored to you.

Experience the Abound SR difference

The Abound SR improves on the original Abound with upgraded performance and smarter features. Built to handle everything from daily commutes to big cargo hauls, it offers greater comfort, power, and security.

 

Whether you're navigating through traffic or carrying heavy loads, the Abound SR ensures a smoother, more efficient ride—making every trip easier and more enjoyable.

TECHNICAL OVERVIEW

The Abound SR ebike and battery is UL Certified with UL 2849 for the ebike and UL 2271 for the battery. Aventon ebikes are built to the IPX6-rated standard. An IPX6 rating means the bike is protected against high-pressure water streams from any angle. This provides strong water resistance, so you can confidently ride in heavy rain or through puddles and mud. However, IPX6 does not mean waterproof—Aventon ebikes are not designed for full submersion. Avoid using a pressure washer or sprayer to clean your ebike, as pressurized water can still damage components. *Max range is determined using PAS 1 throughout flat terrain with a rider weight of 73 KG.

title: Anyhill UM2 Electric Scooter
body_html:
DESCRIPTION

A Sleek, Long-Range Ride for Smart Commuters

The Anyhill UM2 is an upgrade to everyday electric scooters, not only for its buttery smooth ride quality and powerful performance. It is also for its improvement in convenience and comfort that allows riders to feel less hassle and more enjoyment while riding around!

A Powerful 450W Motor

Let's start off with the strong 450W motor on the Anyhill UM2 that releases enough power to give you a zippy, exciting ride. Coupled with a balanced throttle response, you're sure to experience smooth gliding while you're on this scooter.

What's more, this electric scooter also features three awesome speed modes that allows you to customise your ride and how fast you're going. If you're in it for the distance, ECO will take you the farthest, and the need for speed will be satisfied with Sport mode.

Ease at Climbing Up Hills

Anyhill UM2 isn't just your typical commuter, as it also has a superior ability to climb steep hills. It boasts of a 20% climb angle capability, and with the way it confidently goes up inclines, there's no doubt about its claim.

Convenient, Swappable Battery

The most notable feature of the Anyhill UM2 is its swappable LG battery. Located on top of its deck, you can easily slide off the battery once it's been unlocked from its place. Then, it's just a matter of switching to a backup battery to continue riding.

Or, you could make charging easier by grabbing just the battery instead of the entire scooter when you want to plug it in. Then, you'll only need to wait around 4 to 5 hours before it's full and ready to go again!

A Wider Deck For Stability & Comfort

A wide deck is another upgrade riders will surely appreciate while on the go. It's easier to stand up and balance yourself on the Anyhill UM2. Plus, this scooter can carry more than other commuters, with a durable maximum load of 136 kg.

And if you need to stop somewhere, there'll be no worries about your electric scooter toppling over, as the Anyhill UM2 has a handy central kickstand that keeps it firmly in place.

That's not all, as the Anyhill UM2 is also easy to bring around with its quick 3-second folding system. All you need to do is unlatch the folding hook and press the stem downwards until it clicks in place.

Easy-to-Access App Connectivity

Get quick access and control on your Anyhill UM2 by connecting it to your phone through the Anyhill App. Here, you'd be able to monitor your scooter's battery, monitor your speed, unlock/lock your scooter, and even activate cruise control, among other features.

DESCRIPTION

Familiar, but New

Aventures have long been hailed as phenomenal electric bikes given their low price point when compared with other fat tyre electric bikes. They were praised for the excellent build quality, firm ride, great features, and top-tier performance. The Aventure.2 Step Over is no different, so everything that makes Aventure’s best-sellers can be found on the latest model.

 

On the Aventure.2 you’ll find the same 750W motor, the same Tektro hydraulic 180mm disc brakes, the same removable battery, the same thumb throttle and five pedal assist modes, a similar shaped 6061 double-butted aluminium frame, and the same stable, shake-free ride quality.

 

However, the Aventure.2 Step Over comes with some new features as well.

Features

Torque Sensor

The biggest change on the Aventure.2 is the new torque sensor. Unlike its predecessor's cadence sensor, the Aventure.2’s drive train compliments your natural riding style by powering the motor based on how hard you pedal. This means you can go faster when you need it, but slow down when you want. The torque sensor provides a natural & responsive ride that offers greater control and smoother acceleration.

Longer 92km Range

As torque sensors dynamically apply power when it’s needed, the motor isn’t as draining on the battery. This means you’ll be able to go further despite the new and old Adventures sharing the same battery.

Included Rear Rack

Unlike most electric bikes on the market, the Aventure.2 Step Over comes with a rear rack included in the box. This rack is capable of supporting 25kg of weight, which is about the same as five 5-litre water bottles, or the average suitcase on a plane.

Indicators & Upgraded Rear Lights

The rear light housing on the original Aventure was only featured on the left, which wasn’t ideal for Australian roads. However, the Aventure.2 Step Over features rear lights that double as brake lights on both sides of the frame. On top of that, the same housing features two indicator lights that auto-cancel after 15 seconds, greatly improving the overall safety of the unit when riding on shared roads.

Motor

The Aventure.2 Step Over shares the same 750W motor of its predecessor. With a peak power output of 1100W, it’s powerful enough to carry riders to 45 kph on its highest pedal assist mode.

Who is the Aventure.2 for?

The Aventure.2 Step Over is an incredibly versatile ride. Its fat 26’ x 4’ puncture resistant tyres provide a grippy & stable ride on all terrain types including loose ground such as sand and snow. While its 35kg weight makes it a little harder to use as a commuter for smaller riders & tight streets, you can do just about anything else with it. Cycle across the beach. Navigate forest & woodland trails. Go where roads don’t take you.

 

If you want a flexible all-rounder electric fat tyre bike with a natural & fluid ride that compliments your own riding style, the Aventure.2 awaits.

title: Segway Ninebot F65 Electric Scooter
body_html:
The Segway F65 is the top-of-the-line F-Series electric scooter, and boasts an appropriately extensive range of features commuters will love. Presenting the most powerful F-Series motor, the highest rider weight capacity, the best climb angle, and indicators, the F65 is an excellent electric scooter for city life at an affordable price

Key Features

  • Low 15.8 kg Weight
  • High IPX5 Water Resistance Rating
  • Rear Indicators
  • 3 Riding Modes
  • Ideal for Commuters & First-Time Riders
DESCRIPTION

Commuter From The Ground Up

Segway designed the F65 with the average commuter in mind. What this has done is allowed Segway to present a scooter with an abundance of features that commuters need at a price that is very reasonable. Coupled with Segway’s signature reliability and durability, the Segway F65 becomes a solid choice for those wanting to shave some time off their commute.

Features

Power & Motor

The F65 features the most powerful motor of the F-Series range, with a normal 400W output that can reach a peak of 700W when required. While the F65 doesn’t have an exceptional top speed, what this additional power brings is better hill climbing ability, and a higher carrying capacity.

120kg Rider Weight Limit

Every Segway produced at this price point until now has had the same weight limit of 100kg. For riders closing on or over that limit, this meant Segway’s were largely unsuitable. The F65’s 120kg limit opens Segway up to a new audience of slightly heavier commuters.

Rear indicators

The F65 is the only model in the F-Series range and the only Segway under $2,000 to feature rear indicators, which are an important safety feature when driving around cars. You’ll also get front & rear lights, and a rear brake light as well.

3 Riding Modes

If you’re going to spend any time switching from pedestrian areas to roads, you’ll find the three riding modes help you moderate your speed and maintain your safety. Switching from Eco to Standard to Sport will restrict or release your speed limit allowing you to easily ride appropriately for your environment.

Puncture Proof Tyres

Most Segway models come with puncture proof tyres, and the F65 is no different. These are great to see on cheaper commuter scooters as punctures can be a costly and time consuming fault to fix.

What is a Global Edition Electric Scooter?

Segway uses the term Global Edition to describe any electric scooter that has not been restricted for sale in a particular country. This means Global Editions scooters are more powerful & faster than their region-specific counterparts, and don’t require any modifications or ‘flashing’ to unlock their full potential.

There’s an F-Series for That

There’s something very special about Segway’s F-Series range of e-Scooters. It’s rare to see a range of e-scooters that spans such a wide range of riders. While predominantly constructed for commuting, it is possible to ‘grow up’ with F-Series scooters. Younger riders can start on the F25, before graduating to the F30 for college or university. From there, they can upgrade to the F40 for the first jobs, and progress to the top-of-the-line F65 for longer commutes & more intricate journeys. It’s the only range of scooters that does this, and given Segway’s reliability, it isn’t surprising to find riders that started with an F-Series years ago and still swear by them today.

title: Segway Ninebot G65 Electric Scooter
body_html:
For many, the fact the G65 is the next iteration of Segway's massively-successful Ninebot Max line is enough to convince them to buy one, but with the G65, Segway has finally given us the Ninebot Max for which we’ve all been asking. It’s time to get excited.

Key Features

  • Front & Rear Suspension
  • Upgraded 450W Motor With 600W Peak Output
  • Increased Carrying Capacity of 120 kg
  • Better Stability & Balance
  • Ideal for Commuting & Regular Riding
DESCRIPTION

International Anticipation

The G65 has a lot to live up to. Its predecessor, the G30P, won the hearts and minds of more e-scooter riders than any other model in history, so there’s a lot of pressure on the G65’s shoulders.

And it wears it well. The G65 takes what made the G65 special and builds on it. You’ll find a generally larger size, and upgraded motor, suspension, and a higher carrying capacity. It is an ideal electric scooter for commuting as it is a generally more comfortable ride.

Features

Suspension

By far the most important addition to the G65 is the front & rear spring suspension. Together, they eat up the bumps in the road, but they also make riding on rougher terrain such as over grass or gravel a little more comfortable as well. This’ll be helpful for those that know of shortcuts they’ve never been able to take before.

Self Healing Tyres

The same self-healing tyres found on the G30P have been used on the G65. As the G65 can handle a little more adventure thanks to its suspension, the self-healing tyres are very effective at keeping the ride going even over rough ground.

Higher Carrying Capacity

Segway increased the G65’s carrying capacity to 120 kg, which is great for riders who were near the 100 kg limit of the G30P, and either found the performance lacking or were put off buying one altogether. This makes the G65 available to a larger audience who were previously reliant on more expensive dual motor scooters to get around.

Larger Dimensions

The G65 is larger in every way than the G30P, which greatly increases stability. You can expect a taller stem, a wider deck, and longer handlebars. Together these work to improve rider balance, which contributes to a comfortable ride.

Softer Deck Rubber

Segway has created a new triple-layer deck rubber that provides a more cushioned ride. With suspension taking on the biggest bumps, the deck can now take a little bit of the firmness out of the ride.

The People’s Ride

There aren’t many people who won’t find the G65 meets most of their needs. It’s not a turbo scooter like Segway’s GT Series, but it is significantly cheaper. It’s a natural evolution of Segway’s commuter scooter range, but a little more versatile than we’ve seen at this price point. You’ll also be getting the same reliability associated with Segway’s entire e-scooter lineup, so expect a low-maintenance ride that never lets you down.

Tough Act To Follow

The Segway-Ninebot Max G30P was an international best-seller. It earned its place as the most popular electric scooter in the world by doing everything it said it could, and doing it well. On top of that, it was reliable and efficient. It won the hearts of commuters around the globe with its long range, reasonable speed, relatively low-weight, low maintenance, and friendly price-point. It was so popular, in fact, that it took three years for Segway to replace it with something else because riders were still snapping it up years after its launch.

But if you asked anyone who owned a G30P how they could make it better, they’d all say ‘suspension.’

Thanks to Segway, that upgrade is finally a reality with the G65. And thanks to that, the Ninebot lives on.

title: Segway P65 Electric Scooter
body_html:
Segway’s latest electric commuter scooter is here. Building on the immense popularity of the Segway Ninebot Max G30P, the P65 comes with a updated, modern design, a 500W motor, and a more integrated bed of technology that makes its debut with the P65.

  • SegPower Self-healing Tubeless Tyres
  • 5 Power & Riding Modes
  • NFC Functionality for Unlocking
  • Built-in Phone Charger
  • Ideal for commuting
DESCRIPTION

The Successor to Success

The Ninebot Max G30P has worked its way into the e-scooter hall of fame, and for good reason. But it’s been around a while now, and while it has received upgrades & updates throughout its lifespan, Segway has decided it’s time for an upgrade. Building on the electric commuter scooter heritage of the G30P, Segway have launched the P65 as the next evolution of e-scooter for those that want a well-built, functional, and reliable ride to get around town.

What is the P65S Global Edition?

The standard P65 comes with a setting that ensures it meets all Australian regulations regarding speed limits for electric scooters. This makes riders much less likely to get caught speeding. The Global Edition, however, has those settings switched off, which unlocks the full speed potential of the P65S (38 kph) without endangering the componentry. Ultimately, the Global Editions are factory standard and go faster as a result.

Features

Automotive-Grade Tyres

Punctures are troublesome on electric scooters, and depending on your ride, you could be waiting for a couple of weeks for a replacement. The P65SE, however, comes with a new type of tyre closer to what you’d find on a car. Self-healing, tubeless tyres on the front and rear now offer much better traction on wet and greasy roads, keeping riders safer in traffic.

NFC Connectivity

E-Scooter manufacturers have been trying to find the best way of securing electric scooters to prevent theft. Some require a key. Some require an app. So far, however, none have used the rider’s NFC card as the key. The P65 brings this feature to the public with its NFC security system. Simply place your card on the handlebars to unlock the ride and get on your way.

Multiple Riding Modes

In Australia, speed limits for e-scooters vary depending on proximity to pedestrians. Fortunately, the P65 has 5 riding modes that adjust the speed limit of the scooter to make sure you’re always going at the right speed in the right place.

Improved Brakes

The P65SE also brings a front disc brake for greater stopping power, while keeping the rear regenerative braking that pushes energy back into the battery when braking for extra efficiency.

Ergonomic Design

The P65 comes with a wider deck than the G30, and thanks to the layout of all the controls on the handlebars, riders will be able to keep their balance easily when swinging around the local roads.

A Steady Commute

The Segway P65 isn’t a performance e-scooter. If that’s what you’re after, turn your attention to the Segway P100SE or the Segway GT Series. What the P65 is is a very capable and technologically-advanced electric commuter scooter. While many of the features found on the P65 exist on other models, none of those rides on the market have all of those features.

Imagine your commute without the threat of punctures. Imagine your commute with better traction and grip in less-than-ideal weather. Imagine your ride being secured and locked to your phone, meaning that thieving hands can’t use it.

Is The P65 The Replacement For The G30P?

The P65 has big shoes to fill. The G30P is not only one of the best-selling electric commuter scooters in the world, but it’s also one of the best-selling electric scooters, period. Due to the immense popularity of the G30 range, Segway have announced that a direct successor will be coming, but news so far suggests this won’t be available in Australia.

title: Segway P100S Electric Scooter
body_html:
The Segway-Ninebot P100 is the most versatile electric scooter ever produced by Segway. It represents a first in Segway’s lineup: a top-tier electric commuter scooter with a great range of features, solid performance, and a new, modern look. If you love the G30P & P65 but wished they did just a little bit more, this is the e-scooter for you.

  • Front & rear suspension
  • Global Edition - Fully unlocked for top speed of up to 48 kph!
  • Powerful 650W motor
  • Self-healing Tubeless Tyres
  • NFC Connectivity
  • Versatile Riding Modes
DESCRIPTION

A Scooter for All Riders

The beauty of the P100 is its versatility. While Segway’s previous e-scooters have been focused on a specific purpose, such as commuting, the P100 is their first e-scooter that covers a lot of areas.

The great thing about this is that it opens itself up to many types of rider. If you want to use it for commuting, you can. Want to go on rougher terrain? You can. If you’ve never ridden an e-scooter before, choose a lower riding setting and get on your way. The P100 will grow with your ability.

Segway has never produced an e-scooter like this, so this is a great option for anyone that loved their commuter range, but just wished they did more.

What is the P100S Global Edition?

The standard P100SE comes with a setting that ensures it meets all Australian regulations regarding speed limits for electric scooters. This makes riders much less likely to get caught speeding. The Global Edition, however, has those settings switched off, which unlocks the full speed potential of the P100S (48 kph) without endangering the componentry. Ultimately, the Global Editions are factory standard and go faster as a result.

Key Features

Range

The P100 offers the greatest range of any Segway electric scooter to date, reaching up to 100KM on a single charge. Even outside of the Segway range, you won’t find many rides at this price that’ll go this distance or further.

Front & Rear Suspension

Like its older brother, the GT Series, the P100 has front & rear suspension to absorb more lumpy terrain. Segway can make some brilliant suspension sets, but this is the first time we’ve seen dual suspension on something other than a ludicrous scooter.

NFC Connectivity

In a new feature for both Segway & electric scooters in general, your NFC card becomes the key to the scooter. Through Near-Field Connectivity, placing your card on the handlebars unlocks the ride adding that extra layer of security.

Automotive-Grade Tyres

E-Scooters are prone to punctures, but the P100 comes with automotive-grade self-healing tubeless tyres that minimise the risk of punctures. Special tyre tread also improves grip and stability on more slippery surfaces such as wet or greasy roads.

Triple Braking System

The P100SE comes with three types of brake: front & rear mechanical disc brakes, and electronic braking. The latter diverts some of the energy lost when braking back into the battery for extra efficiency. The combination of all three means the P100 has some of the best stopping power of the Segway range.

Full Lighting Setup

The P100SE also borrows the Segway GT’s lighting, with front & rear lights, indicators, rear brake lights, and customisable atmospheric lighting.

Jack-of-All-Trades

The P100 is a significant entry for Segway’s line-up as it is the only e-scooter that can do a bit of everything. Need to cut across a gravel path on your commute? Thanks to the dual suspension & self-healing tyres, you can do so without an uncomfortable ride. Want to put down a bit of power and have some fun? Its 48 km top speed lets you do that. Climb a hill? Yes. Carry more than 100 kg? Yes. Commute to work? Yes. Cruise along bike paths? Yes. Withstand a bit of water? Yes.

If you love the idea of owning an e-scooter but want to make sure your ride can handle a variety of circumstances, look no further than the P100.

Best of Both Worlds

Up until the GT Series, Segway had largely focused on practicality, convenience, and reliability over performance. Their e-scooters were fantastic quality and would last for years, but none of them were fast. In fact, if you wanted something with speed, Segway didn’t really have anything for you.

That changed with the GT Series, which was Segway’s first ludicrous e-Scooter. While a technically-marvellous piece of engineering, they came at a cost that many couldn’t justify. This meant there was a gap in Segway’s lineup for a mid-range & versatile electric scooter that was closer to the GT Series in terms of technology & performance, but came at a more friendly price point akin to that of the G30P & P65A.

That’s exactly where the P100SE fits in. It has a swathe of technology, the longest range of any Segway e-scooter to date, and a solid top speed that’ll give you a similar level of fun without being too hard to control for first time riders.

body_html:
A versatile electric scooter that will elevate your commuting experience. The Navee S65 is a feature-rich scooter that doesn’t break the bank of its riders. Its geared motor and built-in suspension system deliver a smooth riding experience with a dash of fantastic performance time and again. The Navee S65 sold by Electric Kicks is the un-restricted, 30kmh Global version.

Key Features

Description

Not Your Ordinary Commuter E-Scooter

When you look at the specs and features of the Navee S65, it’s hard to fathom that it offers so much in all aspects despite its starter price point. But that’s the reality. From its dual suspension system and massive tyres to its speed and range, this is an e-scooter that’s going to take you further with comfort.

Riding the Navee S65 is an experience that you’re going to enjoy whether you need it for short commutes or long-distance trips. This specced-up scooter allows for seamless navigation around bustling cities.

The Features That’ll Take You On Urban Adventures Anytime, Anywhere

500W Geared Motor

Being equipped with a 500W geared motor, the Navee S65 is capable of reaching a peak power output of 1000W. Such power allows it to reach a top speed of 32 km/h and produce torque exceeding 40Nm, resulting in a 25% climb angle. Plus, there’s lower heat generation even as you pick up speed.

Three Riding Modes

This e-scooter provides three riding modes you can choose from to match your skills or situation. Each mode has different speed limits.

  • Sports Mode: 32 km/h
  • Standard Mode: 15 km/h
  • Walk Mode: 6 km/h

Large Capacity Lithium Battery

One of the features that separate the Navee S65 from many entry-level scooters is its long-distance mileage. Its 48V 12.75Ah battery is capable of sending you as far as 65 km comfortably. This is also integrated with a Battery Management System to ensure battery safety and longevity.

Dual Suspension System

A suspension system, much less a dual one, is uncommon in budget scooters. But the Navee S65 takes a different path with its front and rear suspension. Thus, preventing excessive shocks even as you go through rougher terrains.

Massive Tyres

Its 10-inch tubeless tyres serve several purposes. One is to improve the ride quality as it helps absorb paved roads or uneven surfaces. The other is to lessen your worry, thanks to the tyres’ self-healing technology.

Folding Mechanism

As with any commuter scooter, portability is important. The Navee S65 weighs 24.3 kg and can be folded in three easy steps. As such, it's easy to carry and store.

A Futuristic City Electric Scooter

What the Navee S65 offers is beyond what you would expect. Its premium performance will allow you to steer clear of what makes commutes dreading, tiring, and boring. Instead, what you’ll get is a convenient, comfortable, and fun electric scooter. Navigating the suburbs or city centres doesn’t have to be so hard anymore.

A Rising Star

Navee may be new to the e-scooter scene, but it continues to deliver top-notch models that push the boundaries of what can be done at this price point. It’s a rising star that’s not shy to beef up the specs and features of its commuter scooters to give riders the ultimate experience. Its ascent is reflected in how its crowdfunding efforts are a continuous success for every scooter it launches.

The Navee S65 is no different. Its crowdfunding goal was achieved in less than 5 minutes. This latest e-scooter from the brand doesn’t disappoint. It’s powerful enough to allow you to go from point A to point B without worries and headaches.

Zippy. Long-distance. Comfortable. Safe. Convenient. Portable. Enjoyable. Just some of the words to describe what the Navee S65 is all about.

title: Evolve GTR Series 2 Carbon All Terrain
body_html:
With the GTR Carbon All Terrain Series 2, the legacy of the brand and the revolutionary board launched in 2013 lives on. This improved version integrates the most important factors to give you the best riding experience. No matter where your adventures are, this sleek and stealthy board is a worthy companion.

DESCRIPTION

All New, All Terrain Carbon GTR Series 2 by Evolve

When Evolve launched the world’s first carbon fibre electric skateboard in 2013, it became a standard in innovation in terms of design and performance. Now, the GTR Carbon Series 2 is here to continue the legacy but with remarkable enhancements. Adrenaline junkies like you can have a field day with this.

Power and Speed

The GTR Carbon Series 2 comes with dual 3000W brushless sensored motors. Its powerful motors are responsible for its top speed of 38 kph. Plus, it has enough torque to propel you to ramps and small slopes since this has a 25% hill grade.

Battery and Range

With its capable 14Ah, 504Wh battery, you can go speed though for up to 30 km on a single charge. Once you’re out of battery, you can charge it for 4 to 5 hours before it’s fully loaded again.

Controller

As a result of this new controller, acceleration and braking become smoother, which increases safety as well since there’s very little chance you’ll stumble. By having this Bluetooth FOC, the rider can manage the skateboard's vast power.

Phaze Remote

The all-new Phaze remote is designed with a dual trigger, which provides intuitive acceleration and braking. And on the off chance that you drop it, don’t worry as it’s built with a robust aluminium frame. In addition, it has a fully-coloured LCD screen. You can use it to change through the different speed mode settings.

Cooling System

Overheating won’t be an issue as you ride the new GTR Carbon Series 2. It has an air vent system to draw the heat away from the electrics. It helps the skateboard run more efficiently and also protects the components from damage.

Board Design

The GTR Carbon Series 2 is made of the highest-quality carbon fibre. Its board design is a fusion of form and function. The drop-down style of the deck will allow you to have greater balance and stability as you carve your way through the trails.

Simple Yet Powerful

With an all-black colour scheme, the simplicity of the GTR Carbon Series 2 can be misleading. Yet, once it’s on, you can be certain you’ll feel its power. After all, its motors have a 6000W maximum power output. But despite its strength, it’s solid and stable to ride. That’s exactly what you need when you’re going full-throttle. Take it on any terrain you please, and you’ll feel the adrenaline coursing through you without worries.

A Riveting Companion

Evolve Skateboards seems to have the perfect name, doesn’t it? Because of its durable build, cutting-edge technology, and aesthetic design, its e-boards continue to evolve. The brand’s push to continue chasing improvements is commendable and with products like the GTR Carbon Series 2, the results are shining through.

It’s a worthy successor that is bound to be loved by enthusiasts. Most use it to satisfy their need for adrenaline, but this stands to also be an exciting mode of transportation all-around. Its upgrades are notable as it makes the ride quality and experience much better, even as you take a tight turn on those dirt tracks. With GTR Carbon Series 2, immense power is at your fingertips, and you decide how to use it.

title: Evolve GTR Series 2 Bamboo All Terrain
body_html:
Take skateboarding to a whole new level with the improved Evolve GTR Bamboo All Terrain Series 2. Enjoy a thrilling adventure with its combination of fantastic performance, reliability, comfort, ride quality and durability. Refined and improved, everything you loved about the original was made better.

DESCRIPTION

All New, All Terrain Bamboo GTR Series 2 by Evolve

Evolve skateboards are known for their top-tier craftsmanship, and this newly upgraded GTR Bamboo All Terrain is no different. Combining it with cutting-edge technology results in the ultimate electric skateboard. You can explore without worries and enjoy its power on dirt tracks, off-road, and all types of terrain.

Power and Speed

The Evolve GTR Bamboo All Terrain is equipped with dual 3000w-rated 6368 custom brushless sensored motors. It has a maximum power output of 6000W, which results in a top speed of 38 kph. Also, the powerful motors enable it to climb slopes of up to 25%. Three riding modes are available: Eco, Sport, and GTR.

Battery and Range

Its 14Ah, 504Wh battery with 18650 cells provides a maximum range of 30 km on a single charge. For it to be fully charged, it’s going to take 4 to 5 hours.

Controller

A Bluetooth FOC, designed and developed here in Australia, helps the rider to control the skateboard’s immense power generated from its motors and battery. With this new controller, the acceleration and braking process becomes smoother, which also amps up safety. As you make turns and carve, you'll also feel the impact of this upgrade. This new feature is going to be handy, especially on dirt tracks.

Phaze Remote

The Series 2 has no ordinary remote. The all-new Phaze remote is made of a robust aluminium frame that guarantees it’s going to break apart if you drop it. It’s designed with a dual trigger, which provides intuitive acceleration and braking. It also has an advanced interface that allows you to check information such as diagnostics and previous riding data. You can also use it to change control settings.

Cooling System

Riding at high speeds can result in overheating, but not with the GTR Bamboo All Terrain. This skateboard is designed with dual-finned channels at the bottom for maximum heat dissipation. As such, it keeps the electrical components cool so that they can continue to provide efficient performance. Plus, this cooling system helps protect the electrics in the long run.

Board Design

The deck is long and wide to keep you comfortable and steady as you manoeuvre your way through different terrains. In addition, the deck itself is made of layered bamboo and fibreglass, making it flexible. And thanks to its segmented battery enclosure, the flexibility won’t damage the electrics.

The Ultimate Electric Skateboard

The first-generation GTR Bamboo All Terrain was a hit among avid skateboarders, and this upgrade is looking to be a bigger hit with its many improvements. title: Aventon Level.2 Step Through Electric Bike
body_html:
The much anticipated upgrade to Aventon’s flagship commuter ebike, the Level.2 Step Through comes brimming with technology & features that make it one of the most innovative e-bikes on the market. Featuring integrated battery & lights, pre-installed fenders & rear rack, torque sensor technology, front fork suspension, powerful 500W motor and more, the Level.2 Step Through is the new gold standard of commuter e-Bikes with a price that you can afford.

Key Features

  • Torque sensor for more intuitive & responsive power
  • Removable Internal Lithium-ion 48V, 14Ah (672Wh) with Samsung Cells
  • Fenders & rear rack included
  • Independent thumb throttle & 5 pedal assist modes
  • Colour LCD screen & app integration
  • Aventon’s flagship commuter e-Bike

Also available in Step Over version

DESCRIPTION

Level Up With the New Aventon Level.2

The Level.2 has only just been launched and has already been dubbed Aventon’s best eBike to date by Electric Bike Report. The Level.2 presents an exciting opportunity for Australia’s commuters by being practical, efficient, fast, & tooled up with great features that make riding the Level.2 an experience in its own right.

If you’ve been seeking an electric bike to tackle your commute, but have found the prices on the wrong side of expensive, the Aventon Level.2 is for you. You’ll find the same, if not better performance, & technology to match at a lower price than you’d expect.

Features

Power

The Level.2 Step Through comes with a 500W rear hub motor that can actually produce a peak of 750W. This puts the Level.2 as one of the more powerful eBikes in the Aventon Range. Riders won’t struggle for power regardless of their route.

Speed

This motor can power the ride to a top speed of 32 kph when using the throttle on its own, or 45 using pedal assist.

Hill Climb Ability

Like most of the Aventon range, the Level.2 comes with impressive hill climb ability. Not only can it get up most hills in throttle-only mode with an average speed of around 10-15kph, but on pedal assist level 5, you’ll be able to get over any incline significantly faster.

Torque Sensor

While torque sensors aren’t a new concept, this is the first time an Aventon eBike has come equipped with one. These work by measuring how much effort you are putting into pedalling as opposed to how fast you pedal, and it will dynamically adjust its power output to compliment your current riding style. It produces a ride that feels much more intuitive, natural & fluid.

Default Accessories

You can expect front fenders, rear fenders, front & rear lights, and a rear rack all as standard on the Level.2 Step Through. This means that despite the Level.2’s higher price point compared to its siblings, you actually get more for your money.

Throttle

For the Level.2, the throttle has been upgraded to remove the lag found on earlier models. This makes the eBike more responsive. This throttle can also be disabled with the Aventon app, or removed entirely if required.

Frame

You’ll find a double-butted aluminium frame for the Level 2 Step Through, which gives riders exceptional stability. Weighing in at 24kg, the ride produced feels solid, and the bike feels responsive.

Level Up Your Commute

The Level.2 Step Through is designed with commuters in mind, and a healthy middle-ground of the Aventon range. While not as light as the Soltera, you get better hill-climb ability & more power. While not as fast as the Aventure, it weighs significantly less, and the difference in speed isn’t that much. Everything about the Level.2 has been designed to make commuting easier, faster, & more comfortable.

Solve The Commuter Conundrum

Buying a commuter eBike is hard in Australia, notably because it’s hard to know what’s a good price. Other brands produce some great eBikes but at a price point that makes your eyes water. In most cases, affordable e-Bikes make sacrifices that, on paper, seem fine, but can negatively impact your ride. You’ll lack power, or you’ll get an uncomfortable ride, or you’ll find your range limited, or you’ll get stuck on hills. To get what you want, you’ll find yourself tossing up whether $5,000 for an e-Bike is really worth it just to get to work & back.

With the Aventon Level.2, you don’t get that. You get a powerful motor that’ll never leave you wanting for speed. You get a torque sensor to give you a natural ride that compliments your ability, which is something you’ll never find on an e-Bike of this level at this price. You get hydraulic brakes, front suspension, an integrated & removable battery, and a colour LCD screen that shows you how many trees you’ve saved. And that’s not even mentioning the built-in accessories & attachments, & integrated front & rear lights

What the Level.2 represents is more than just a commuter e-Bike. It represents a relative first for Australian commuters - a top-tier commuter e-Bike at mid-tier prices, and that alone makes it one of the most valuable e-Bikes available today. 

Please note: The new Aventon Level.2 electric bike no longer has the quick-release for its front axle. It features a regular thru-axle which can be tightened with an allen wrench.

title: Aventon Pace 350.2 Step Through Electric Bike
body_html:
The first generation Aventon Pace 350 was an instant hit. Reliable performance, great looks, & a very friendly price saw riders gravitate towards the 350 in large numbers. Now, in 2022, Aventon has launched the upgraded Next-Gen 350 Pace, and in doing so, has brought an award-winning electric cruiser bike.

Key Features

  • Throttle-only mode & 5 pedal-assist modes
  • New, Upgraded Full Colour LCD Display
  • Puncture-resistant tyres
  • Voted best affordable e-Bike 2022 by bicycling.com
  • Perfect for commuting & easy rides

Also available in Step Over version

DESCRIPTION

An Above-Level Entry Level e-Bike

If you’ve been after an entry-level electric bike that gets you from A-Z, the Aventon Pace 350 Next-Gen should be top of your list. If you’d like something a little more specced-up, then the Aventon Pace 350 Next-Gen should still be top of your list.

Aventon’s attention to detail, eye-catching design, and mid-power motor have come together to produce one of the most accessible electric cruiser bikes around.

Features

Efficiency

While not as powerful as its older sibling, the Pace 500 Next-Gen, the 350 is just as efficient with a maximum range of 65km on pedal assist level 1. Plus, with its reasonably low weight of 22kg, even if you do run out of battery on your trip, the Pace is easy enough to pedal like a regular bike.

Frame

The Frame on the Pace 350 is exactly the same as that found on the Pace 500. You’ll find the same single-butted aluminium alloy frame with integrated battery that’s capable of carrying up to 136kg in weight.

Speed & Throttle

The Pace 350 has 6 riding modes:

  • 100% throttle only
  • Level 1 - 5 pedal assist

The higher the pedal assist selected, the less effort you need to put into peddling the bike.

Braking

The Pace 350 comes with Tektro mechanical brakes as standard, which are capable of bringing this ride to a standstill from 20kph in just 3.5 metres. The slightly sweeping handlebars make it easy to control the bike during such a rapid stop.

Hill Climb Ability

The Pace 350 is advertised as a cruiser, and its intended use also covers commuting around town. Generally, the 350W motor is enough to get you around most of the hills you’d find in a standard Australia metro environment. Tougher hills are still mountable when using Pedal Assist Level 5.

The Ideal Commuter e-Bike

The Pace 350 cuts out a unique place in the Australian e-bike market. It looks good. It’s fun. It’s efficient. It’s well-made. Cruising around town is comfortable and relaxing, and its well-ratioed pedal assist levels mean that you’ll never really struggle to get the thing moving.

Award Winning Is Just The Beginning

The Pace 350 was voted by bicycling.com as the best affordable e-Bike in 2022, an award well-deserved. For manufacturers, building on a fan-favourite flagship product can be difficult. It attracts stronger scrutiny from those that loved the original, so reviews are judged harder. As such, manufacturers can push the boat out by trying to cram as many new features as possible, but that’s not what has happened here.

Aventon’s speciality involves making quality e-bikes, but it’s the little things such as the colour screen, integrated battery, integrated headlights, & puncture-proof tyres that truly make their bikes front-runners. What’s more, the Pace isn’t an expensive bike for what you get, and that, combined with Aventon’s overall approach to making e-bikes, makes sure you get a very, very good ride.

Engineered for next-level agility and style

The elegant Aventon Soltera 2.5 maintains the streamlined look that made its forerunner an instant hit among riders. 

 

Expect amazing upgrades like hydraulic brakes, faster rolling tyres, and a double-butted aluminium alloy frame (still lightweight at only 21 kg). Meanwhile, advanced technology and integrated turn signals ensure optimal performance and safety.

 

With its 350W brushless hub motor, the Aventon Soltera 2.5 can achieve:

Intelligent torque sensor

A lightweight but durable frame

Integrated lights with turn signals

title: Aventon Sinch Step Through Folding Bike
body_html:
The Aventon Sinch Step-Through folding e-Bike is the successor for the original Aventon Sinch folding bike, but don’t let that fool you into thinking this is merely an upgrade. Outside of the motor and battery, the Since step-through is almost entirely new. The 2022 model of the Sinch is an ebike full of surprises.

Key Features

  • Throttle-only mode & 5 pedal-assist modes
  • Durable folding mechanism
  • Surprising hill-climb ability
  • New, Upgraded Colour LCD Screen
  • Off-road capabilities
DESCRIPTION

The Newest Aventon

The step-through Sinch is Aventon’s newest electric bike. Aventon have gone to great lengths to deliver a folding electric bike that is almost unrecognisable from its predecessor. We see a totally new design with a new range of colours.

What you essentially get is all the performance and gadgetry from a regular e-bike condensed into the frame of a folding bike, and Aventon has merged the two worlds perfectly.

Features

Efficiency

The Sinch comes with a 500W motor & uses it to power the ride to an approximate range of 65km. With the same variety of riding modes and the option to power the bike with the thumb throttle only, this is one of the few electric bikes in the Australian market that you can actually expect to meet its distance rating.

Hill-Climbing Ability

Another of the Sinch ST’s surprises is just how much torque Aventon has pulled from its motor. Even in throttle-only mode, this e-bike can carry a rider uphill for an extended period of time whilst maintaining a 10-15kph speed.

Frame

An aluminium alloy frame holds the Sinch together, with the battery integrated smoothly into the downtube. The weight of the unit is altogether a little higher than the average folding bike coming in at 31kg, so this is a ride that’s designed to be stored in small spaces as opposed to be carried around or up and down stairs.

Folding Mechanism

One of the biggest surprises you’ll find on the Sinch is its folding mechanism. With the Sinch, Aventon has managed to create a very solid, secure, and quiet locking mechanism. There’s no frame wobble or clicking noises from anywhere on the frame, and the ride feels much more like what you’d expect from a solid frame.

Brakes

The Sinch ST uses Tektro mechanical disk brakes for its stopping power. They produce a better-than-average stopping distance, coming to a complete stop in just under 4m from a speed of 32kph. And thanks to the frame’s rigidity, stopping that quickly doesn’t cause a loss of control or instability.

Off-Road Heritage

While the ST doesn’t have the knobbly off-road tyres found on the original, that doesn’t mean you can’t take it onto cycle tracks & dirt trails. While it isn’t designed for extreme terrain or punishment, you can still take the Sinch ST on far-reaching adventures. Easy to fold up and store in the back of your car, tent, or caravan, it’s an ideal companion for holidays to Australia’s countryside.

Add in its sturdy build, high torque, good range, and longer wheelbase than most folding bikes, and you end up with a folding e-bike that rides more like a regular e-bike.

New & Improved

Aventon pride themselves on their attention to detail, and that veritable pedantry can be felt on every cycle. From a solid and quiet folding mechanism, to powerful brakes & surprising uphill performance, the Sinch is a comfortable & stable ride. Its step-through frame makes it a better folding bike for those with limited mobility or those who don’t like more traditional step-over bikes.

title: Aventon Pace 350.2 Step Over Electric Bike
body_html:
The first generation Aventon Pace 350 was an instant hit. Reliable performance, great looks, & a very friendly price saw riders gravitate towards the 350 in large numbers. Now, in 2022, Aventon has launched the upgraded Next-Gen 350 Pace, and in doing so, has brought an award-winning electric cruiser bike.

Key Features

  • Throttle-only mode & 5 pedal-assist modes
  • New, Upgraded Full Colour LCD Display
  • Puncture-resistant tyres
  • Voted best affordable e-Bike 2022 by bicycling.com
  • Perfect for commuting & easy rides

Also available in Step Through version

DESCRIPTION

An Above-Level Entry Level e-Bike

If you’ve been after an entry-level electric bike that gets you from A-Z, the Aventon Pace 350 Next-Gen should be top of your list. If you’d like something a little more specced-up, then the Aventon Pace 350 Next-Gen should still be top of your list.

Aventon’s attention to detail, eye-catching design, and mid-power motor have come together to produce one of the most accessible electric cruiser bikes around.

Features

Efficiency

While not as powerful as its older sibling, the Pace 500 Next-Gen, the 350 is just as efficient with a maximum range of 65km on pedal assist level 1. Plus, with its reasonably low weight of 22kg, even if you do run out of battery on your trip, the Pace is easy enough to pedal like a regular bike.

Frame

The Frame on the Pace 350 is exactly the same as that found on the Pace 500. You’ll find the same single-butted aluminium alloy frame with integrated battery that’s capable of carrying up to 136kg in weight.

Speed & Throttle

The Pace 350 has 6 riding modes:

  • 100% throttle only
  • Level 1 - 5 pedal assist

The higher the pedal assist selected, the less effort you need to put into peddling the bike.

Braking

The Pace 350 comes with Tektro mechanical brakes as standard, which are capable of bringing this ride to a standstill from 20kph in just 3.5 metres. The slightly sweeping handlebars make it easy to control the bike during such a rapid stop.

Hill Climb Ability

The Pace 350 is advertised as a cruiser, and its intended use also covers commuting around town. Generally, the 350W motor is enough to get you around most of the hills you’d find in a standard Australia metro environment. Tougher hills are still mountable when using Pedal Assist Level 5.

The Ideal Commuter e-Bike

The Pace 350 cuts out a unique place in the Australian e-bike market. It looks good. It’s fun. It’s efficient. It’s well-made. Cruising around town is comfortable and relaxing, and its well-ratioed pedal assist levels mean that you’ll never really struggle to get the thing moving.

Award Winning Is Just The Beginning

The Pace 350 was voted by bicycling.com as the best affordable e-Bike in 2022, an award well-deserved. For manufacturers, building on a fan-favourite flagship product can be difficult. It attracts stronger scrutiny from those that loved the original, so reviews are judged harder. As such, manufacturers can push the boat out by trying to cram as many new features as possible, but that’s not what has happened here.

Aventon’s speciality involves making quality e-bikes, but it’s the little things such as the colour screen, integrated battery, integrated headlights, & puncture-proof tyres that truly make their bikes front-runners. What’s more, the Pace isn’t an expensive bike for what you get, and that, combined with Aventon’s overall approach to making e-bikes, makes sure you get a very, very good ride.

title: Aventon Aventure Step Through Electric Bike
body_html:
Bring the adventure to you with the Aventon Aventure Step Over electric bike. Their most powerful motor yet is blended with fat tyres, suspension, & a hydroformed aluminium frame to produce one of the most versatile electric bikes on the Australian market today.

Key Features

  • Throttle-only & 5 pedal assist modes
  • New, Upgraded Backlit colour LCD display
  • Integrated front & rear lights
  • Removable battery
  • Perfect for adventuring & off-road trails

Also available in Step Over version

DESCRIPTION

Aventure by Name, Adventure by Nature

Named after the French word for Adventure, the Aventon Aventure Step Over is bred for those looking to get away from the beaten path with an electric bike. Aventon believes that their attention to detail & small additional features are what makes their electric bikes a cut above the competition, and that’s very evident in the Aventure. Aventon has produced a very solid-feeling fat-tyre electric bike that’s just as capable on dirt tracks & trails as it is on tarmac and roads.

Features

Hill-Climb Ability

A key part of adventuring on a bike involves going up and down hills, and it’s here that some electric bikes begin to suffer performance issues. Fortunately, the Aventon’s 750W motor puts out a lot of torque, so even on hills with a 10% incline can be tackled on the lowest pedal-assist or even the throttle-only mode.

Speed

On smoother surfaces, that motor is capable of pushing a rider to 32kph on the throttle alone, and on the highest pedal-assist setting, you can expect to get up to 50kph. The throttle can be controlled by the thumb as it sits under the handlebars, and the pedal assist mode can be changed using the control panel that sits on top of the bars.

Controls

The LCD screen clearly shows speed & assist mode, but unlike a lot of electric ride displays (scooter & bike), the Aventure Step Over’s LCD display shows the exact percentage of battery you have left rather than a bar that gradually depletes. This is incredibly helpful for planning out longer journeys and making sure you have enough juice to get home. The display can also show you how many trees you’ve saved, and how much carbon you’ve saved by using the Aventure to get around.

Braking

With its 33kg weight, it’s important to be able to stop quickly, and the Aventure’s 180mm hydraulic disk brakes are powerful enough to bring it to a standstill from 32kph in just 3.3 metres.

Frame

The Aventure comes with two frame options: the Step-Over & Step-Through. Both boast a hydroformed aluminium frame, which means that fewer welds are required to piece the bike together. This helps reduce overall weight, and cuts down on potential weak spots in the frame. The result of having a hydroformed frame is a very solid & stable ride.

The Step Through frame is generally more suited to those with limited mobility, or riders that don’t like having to lift their left over the top tube & seat. That said, step-through frames are also helpful for commuters that cycle while wearing regular clothes that may be more restrictive.

A Practical All-Rounder

The Aventure Step Through is a bike built for life. With its reasonably high-weight, it’s never going to be as practical as a mountain bike, but it doesn’t carry the price point of one either. What you get from the Aventure is a bike that can handle 90% of your cycling trips. It’s smooth & fast on roads. It’s smooth & fast on dirt tracks & cycling trails. It’s smooth and fast going up and down hills. Plus, its IPX4 water resistance rating means it can withstand splashes from any direction, including rain. That means that it is a genuinely decent alternative to getting around town.

A Solid Ride In Every Sense

E-Bikes at this price point have a tendency to cheap out somewhere, whether it be plastic fenders, cheap forks, cheap brakes or minimal accessories. As a result, cheaper rides can become clunky, bumpy, and rattle a lot over rough terrain.

However, one of the most positively-reviewed features of this ebike is overall build quality. From review sites such as electricbikereport.com to customer reviews, you’ll frequently find references to just how stable & solid the Aventon Aventure actually is. There’s no ride wobble. There’s no rattling from cheap fenders & plastic components. The suspension & fat tyres absorb a lot of lumps and bumps found on country cycle trails, and the custom-made Aventon seats are very comfortable.

Overall, the attention to detail that has gone into the Aventure Step Through is evident, and with this, Aventon have produced one of the best all-rounder electric bikes available at this time.

title: Aventon Sinch Step Over Folding Bike
body_html:
Despite being one of Aventon’s older e-Bike models, coming onto the market early 2020, The Aventon Sinch is still a powerful contender in the folding e-bike market today. Sturdy, well-designed, and integrated with a lot of little features, the Sinch is one of the most versatile folding bikes available today.

Key Features

  • Throttle-only mode & 5 pedal-assist modes
  • Folding frame design
  • New, Upgraded Backlit LCD Display
  • All-terrain capabilities with fat tyres
  • App integration
  • Ideal for adventuring, camping & caravanning

Also available in Step Through version

DESCRIPTION

Form & Functionality

Folding e-bikes regularly take functionality over form. As such, you can end up with something that looks like several steel pipes welded together on wheels. The Aventon Sinch, however, is one of the best looking folding electric bikes available on the market, and it does this while still being a very adaptable ride.

Its sleek & compact design comes hand-in-hand with Aventon’s attention to details. This brings us features such as an integrated battery in the top tube, cables that run through the frame itself, and a powerful 750W motor.

Features

Efficiency

With 6 riding modes (5 pedal assist modes & throttle-only), the Aventon Sinch can run for a range of up to 65km. This is particularly impressive as the bike weighs in at approximately 31kg. There are some fixed frame electric bikes available that struggle to make that range work, so this is an impressive feat.

Power & Speed

The 750W motor on the Sinch produces speeds of up to 32 kph, but what is more surprising is the torque put out. Able to carry up to 300lbs, the motor is also effective at powering riders uphill with ease on the throttle alone.

Frame

The Sinch is held together by a double-butted aluminium alloy frame. Aventon managed to avoid the doubt-inducing pitfalls found on other folding bikes by constructing a clamp that feels solid and secure. There’s no clicking or rattling sounds. There’s no frame wobble when braking suddenly or going over rough terrain.

Ride Quality

The frame’s sturdiness, combined with the fat 4 inch tyres & front suspension give the Sinch a ride quality that you simply won’t find on another folding bike. It’s smooth, stable, and balanced when being used off road.

Unique in Every Way

The Sinch captured the attention of cyclists and ebike enthusiasts alike because of its unique design & high performance. Its collapsible build makes the perfect companion for adventures. It can fit neatly into the back of most vehicles, and its off road capabilities means you can take it on beaches, campsites, dirt tracks, or use it to commute.

The Test of Time

In 2022, the Sinch was given a younger sibling, the Sinch Step-Through. It built on the Sinch’s popularity & technical performance to build a highly-integrated folding e-bike, but with a step-through frame design instead of the original’s step over.

However, despite the Sinch’s age, it still holds up as a contender, and in many ways is still better than folding ebike alternatives joining the market today.

Just like its younger sibling, the Sinch is a bike full of surprises. A folding bike with the performance of a fixed bike. A smooth, stable ride backed by a lot of torque makes this just as good an e-Bike now as it was a few years ago, so if you want one of the best looking folding bikes on the market, but you still need it to perform, the Aventon Sinch should be the only entry on your list.

  • Folding mechanism with two quick-release clamps
  • Fat Tyres
