title: Segway D38E Electric Scooter
body_html:
Looking for an e-scooter with style and substance? The all-new Segway D38E from the D Series has both in spades. Sporting a red and black colour scheme that is easy to spot, it also has an awesome top speed and maximum range. It’s the ideal partner for commuting around the city or for having a fun day at the park.

Double the range of the Segway Ninebot D18!

DESCRIPTION

Enjoy Seamless Trips Through the City Streets

Segway is no stranger to crafting some of the most reliable and durable electric scooters around, and its latest two-wheeler to impress is the D38E. Starting with its design, this kickscooter is built with a double tube frame that provides a stable structure.

And with such a solid foundation, it allows for a maximum load capacity of 120 kg, which is rare in an entry-level kick. Plus, despite that strong construction, the D38E is made to be portable at only 16.3 kg. It has a 2-step folding mechanism, which is achievable with only one hand. As such, this scooter is easy to carry and store.

As far as its performance specs go, it meets and exceeds the expectations of beginners and commuters alike. It’s equipped with a 350W motor with a peak power output of 500W. Thus, providing this e-scooter with enough power to reach a top speed of 25 km/h.

The D38E also produces enough torque for a climb angle of 20%. Not to mention, it has 3 riding modes plus a walk mode to give you the chance to personalise your riding experience based on different situations or your skillset.

What’s more, it comes with a 367 Wh (10200 mAh) battery that grants it a maximum range of up to 38 km.

Safety is a non-issue for the D38E with its electronic anti-lock braking system at the front and a drum brake at the rear. Together, they work as a unit to provide great stopping power to ensure the safety of the riders and those around. Plus, it has high-powered lights to amp up the visibility level and keep you protected while riding at night.

Comfort is also at the heart of the D38E as you’re guaranteed a pleasant ride around town. Thanks to its huge 10-inch air tyres, you can experience a smooth ride despite some little bumps and cracks on the road. It even has a large footboard to give you plenty of balance space as you manoeuvre your way along the city streets.

Overall, the Segway D38E is a joy to ride whether you’re just learning the ropes of scootering or making your way to work. It’s reliable, zippy, has plenty of mileage, provides great handling, and gives you fantastic stability.

title: Dualtron Eagle PRO Electric Scooter (60V, 22.5ah)
body_html:
Up for a thrilling daily adventure? The Dualtron Eagle Pro (60V, 22.5ah) Electric Scooter has landed to quench your need for speed! With an astounding pace and longer range, your weekend getaways and errand runs are sure to be more exciting. Engineered by a brand that has produced exceptional e-scooters, this latest beast of a ride is here to give you a powerful experience you won’t forget. Enjoy riding this Dualtron scooter in Australia now!

DESCRIPTION

Enjoy A Superb Experience With The High-Performing Dualtron Eagle Pro

Minimotors Dualtron is no stranger to crafting some of the toughest-looking scooters on the market. One of its latest two-wheelers, the Dualtron Eagle Pro, immediately screams durability with just one look. Made with aviation-grade aluminium alloy, this electric scooter is built to be strong and able to withstand simple corrosion. No doubt, riding this feels premium!

Aside from its simple yet intimidating look, the Dualtron Eagle packs a mighty punch with its specs. With a 1200W BLDC Dual Hub motor, you can experience an astonishing 70 kph top speed. And the cool part? There’s barely any noise since it's a brushless motor. Plus, such power will allow you to climb up 25-degree steep hills.

On top of that, this Pro version is equipped with a 60V 22.5ah high-capacity LG battery. You'll have an 55 km maximum range at your disposal, so you can enjoy this for hours without frequenting a charging station. Depending on what type of charger you have, this awesome e-scooter can be locked and loaded between 13 hours (standard charger) and 3.5 hours (1 fast charger).

And you don’t even have to worry about ride quality with the Dualtron Eagle Pro. Featuring a fully adjustable dual suspension, commutes and escapades alike will be a comfortable riding experience. Not only that, this all-terrain e-scooter comes with 10-inch pneumatic tyres that’ll have you conquering more than just paved roads. Pair these two together and you’ll get excellent traction!

Even safety features are top-notch with this Pro! There’s a disc brake system on the front and rear of the scooter which allows for great stopping power. Plus, it’s regenerative so some of the energy used while riding can be utilised for better mileage. Also, its LED lighting set-up is great for better visibility.

For maximum flexibility, you can choose how to ride your e-scooter. From eco and turbo modes to single and dual motors, the power is in your hands for the ultimate experience. And as for its portability? This magnificent kick has a convenient foldable stem and handlebar for easier storage.

With such marvellous specs and features, this Dualtron electric scooter is a powerful alternative to public transit and cars. This city-oriented two-wheeler strikes the perfect balance between quality, performance, and price. Whether you’re going to work or exploring the city on a day off, you can expect the Dualtron Eagle Pro to work its magic here in Australia!

title: Dualtron Thunder 2 Electric Scooter
body_html:
A badass in every way imaginable! The Dualtron Thunder 2 electric scooter is here and it’s bigger and better than ever. With double the power of its predecessor, riding this Dualtron electric scooter on full-throttle is an out-of-this-world experience. And together with a record-shattering maximum range, you’ll be beaming with how exhilarating this is. Hop on NOW if you’re up for an adrenaline-filled adventure!

DESCRIPTION

Double The Power, Double The Fun With The Extremely Powerful Dualtron Thunder 2

Minimotors Dualtron is at it again! Known for creating high-quality and high-performing e-scooters, the brand decided to tinker with its original Dualtron Thunder. The result is a scooter that’s lightning quick and can beat out most of the models in its ludicrous class. That said, there's no doubt that the Dualtron Thunder 2 is the star of the show.

Armed with dynamic 1300W BLDC dual motors, this two-wheeler has no problem sending you to your destination in record time. But that’s just the tip of the iceberg. It also has a double-click throttle that you can activate to reach a whopping power output of 10,080W. Don’t worry, you’re not imagining those numbers. That’s how robust this beast is!

With such commanding force, you’ll be experiencing a remarkable 105 kph top speed. Plus, you can go from 0 to 32 kph in just 2.8 seconds. Riding the Dualtron Thunder 2 electric scooter will wake you up from a stupor without question.

And if you want to mount hilly trails, this kicks has a 35-degree climb angle. Not only that, its enormous rubber deck can certainly push you to be more fearless when crushing those steep inclines as you’re provided with a better grip.

But if that’s not enough to convince you, its groundbreaking maximum range will! A 130 km mileage is at your disposal with the Dualtron Thunder 2 which is above and beyond compared to others. You can have fun for hours on end without needing to charge frequently throughout your trip.

What’s more, the ride quality is just superb. Thanks to its adjustable dual rubber suspension with replaceable cartridges, riding on rough surfaces and taking road bumps won’t give you whiplash. And together with its 11-inch, ultra-wide tubeless tyres, stability and grip on any landscape is a sure thing. Plus, they’re flat-proof due to the flexible soft rubber coating on the inside of the wheels. Bye-bye punctures and high maintenance!

As for safety, the Dualtron Thunder 2 is rigged with a Nutt hydraulic disc brake and a 160mm disc brake with ABS. That means getting a stopping distance of just 3 metres from a 24 kph speed.

Even at night, this Dualtron scooter won't leave any doubt that you're on the streets or trails. Its exceptional lighting system comprises mood lights, brake lights, side deck lights, and warning lights. Pedestrians and other riders alike will definitely see you coming!

From the sleek design and durable build to the outstanding speed and marvellous range, having the Dualtron Thunder 2 in Australia is a game-changer. This scooter deserves all the fanfare because as it stands, this is staying as one of the top dogs of the scooter world.
